Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The role

As an Engineering Manager at Legora, you’ll lead by example—hands-on in the code while guiding a talented team of engineers. You’ll architect and deliver features that make legal professionals’ lives easier, drive technical excellence, and help shape a product used by forward-thinking law firms around the world. This is a role for someone who loves to build, mentor, and scale both people and systems.

What you will be doing:

  • Design and implement end-to-end features across our fullstack platform

  • Contribute directly to the codebase while supporting the growth of your team

  • Lead architecture discussions and technical decision-making

  • Ensure high standards in code quality, security, and performance

  • Collaborate closely with Product and Design to ship value quickly and reliably

  • Review code, give feedback, and mentor engineers at all levels

  • Champion best practices in development, DevOps, and continuous improvement

  • Work with Node.js, React, Azure, AWS and Kubernetes

  • Work every day to ensure your team is healthy and efficient

Who you are

  • A seasoned fullstack or backend engineer with 1-3 years of leadership experience

  • Comfortable being hands-on while also setting technical direction

  • Skilled in building scalable products and owning complex systems end-to-end

  • Strong communicator who leads with empathy and clarity

  • Passionate about mentoring others and helping teams grow

  • Confident working across backend, frontend, and infrastructure

  • Curious, pragmatic, and always looking for smarter ways to build and deliver

  • But most importantly, you are someone who:

    • “Gets stuff done” and understands building a successful company isn’t always glamorous and takes hard work and long hours

    • Proactively and independently solves the most burning problems

    • Thrives in a fast-paced environment where the answers aren’t always clear and processes are few

*Candidates will go through the same interview process as software engineering candidates (including a coding task and a technical interview), with additional interview steps at the end designed for the engineering manager role.

*This is a London Based, 5-day in-office role, we believe building together in person drives better outcomes.

title: AI Security Engineer
description: Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors. We are looking for a Data & AI / ML Evaluation Engineer to own the data collection, mining, curation and continuous evaluation foundation for our various AI security products. High-quality models require high-quality datasets and ongoing enrichment and retraining. In this role, you will build automated data ingestion pipelines from surrogate web traffic and open sources, manage dataset curation, labeling workflows, model training and operate our benchmark and evaluation harnesses. This is a data and AI / ML software engineering role focused on building the data infrastructure that trains our proprietary Prompt Injection SLMs, Shadow-AI detection models, Malicious Macro classifiers, PII, Content Classification engines and more. Outcomes & KPIs Key Outcome(s) Owned: Automated, continuous generation and curation of training, evaluation, and false-positive (FP) datasets across web, file, and macro threat surfaces. Standardized, reproducible evaluation benchmarks that guide model improvements before deployment. Automated data pipeline uptime and ingestion throughput from web/file sources. Size, diversity, and labeling accuracy of threat dataset repositories (PI, Shadow-AI, PII, Macros). Mean time to ingest live false-positive/false-negative feedback into training evaluation loops. Accuracy and benchmark coverage across historical vs. newly trained SLMs. What You'll Do Design and operate automated data collection, mining, and web-scraping pipelines to gather threat samples from surrogate traffic and web sources. Build data processing, annotation, and dataset curation workflows, training and re-training various models, e.g. Prompt Injection (PI) SLMs, Shadow-AI detection models, Malicious Macro classifiers, and PII detection. Build mechanisms to capture false-positive (FP) samples from live user/DDR flows and represent / integrate them into model retraining pipelines. Develop automated benchmarking and evaluation harnesses to continuously test model detection quality, runtime performance, and accuracy against baseline models (e.g., Vertex AI). Build automated pipelines for model training for various models. Work closely with research and software engineering teams to turn raw detection telemetry into ongoing actionable model improvements. Required: 2–4 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or automated QA/evaluation roles. Strong programming proficiency in Python. Adv: C++, SQL. Experience in model training and various ML, AI algorithms. Experience building data pipelines, web scrapers, or automated data processing systems. Familiarity with data structures, storage formats, and database configurations. Methodical approach to dataset labeling, validation, bug logging, and metric tracking. Preferred / Nice to Have: Hands-on experience with ML evaluation frameworks, dataset curation, or annotation tools. Familiarity with text extraction, NLP preprocessing, or document parsing techniques. Understanding of cybersecurity concepts (Prompt Injection, Malicious Macros, DLP/PII). Basic experience with cloud storage, object stores, and basic containerization (Docker). Experience with AWS, GCP, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Linux. Follow us on LinkedIn ! Why Menlo? At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: Proactive Leadership , Straight Talk , United Impact , Elevated Talent , and Customer-Compelled . We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability . TO ALL AGENCIES: Please, no phone calls or emails to any employee of Menlo Security outside of the Talent organization. Menlo Security’s policy is to only accept resumes from agencies via Ashby (ATS). Agencies must have a valid services agreement executed and must have been assigned by the Talent team to a specific requisition. Any resume submitted outside of this process will be deemed the sole property of Menlo Security. In the event a candidate submitted outside of this policy is hired, no fee or payment will be paid. Relay is a technology enabled parcel carrier - we deliver parcels from retailers to end customers but do it much more efficiently than incumbents. It is for growth, from growth-stage investors, and it will be won on evidence. Today a raise runs through the CEO and the CFO alongside their day jobs. It works. It is however, not a system. You will be the person who makes it one. You will not just be the person who holds and runs the Series C transaction, but also be the Head of the Office that will build the systems to raise multiple rounds of capital in the future. Between rounds you keep the map, the materials and the investors warm, so each raise starts from a record, not a blank page. Few roles let you own how a growing company raises the capital it runs on, from the inside, round after round. Who you work with CEO: you report here. The CEO pitches and takes the decisions on a round. CFO: you work together daily. The CFO owns the budget, the forecast, internal finance and any debt. You own equity, the investors behind it, and the investor-facing model built from the CFO's numbers — never a second set. Co-founder and the Extended Leadership Team: the proof a round needs. External & Internal Counsel: terms and the close. Board: updates between rounds and approval on the round. The process start to close: the timeline, outreach, a brief before every meeting and notes after, investor questions answered within a day, and diligence. Put term sheets side by side and show what each costs in the round after. Draw up illustrative analysis and counsel the CEO on the right strategy. Hold the story in one version, drafted with the CEO. The same claims and numbers across the deck, the model and the data room. Own the investor-facing model: scenarios, unit economics and use of funds. Every number ties to one the CFO has signed. Between rounds Refresh the deck, the KPI pack and the data room every quarter. Write investor and board updates. Answer existing investors' questions. Track what we promised them. Build relationships with investors so you can source your own relationships for future rounds Read the market: who invests at our stage, on what terms, and what comparable companies showed when they raised. Put what Relay must show, and by when, to the leadership team in writing. Across both Agree in writing with each function what it produces for a raise and by when. Flag the proof the story needs a quarter early, not the week before. Keep the record: what each investor asked, what we answered, what we promised and what we learned. By the end of your first six months An investor map with a reason beside every name. One version of the story across the deck, the model and the data room. A data room refreshed every quarter, never rebuilt. A written agreement with each function on what it produces for a raise. A clear line of sight to a closed round from a ranked list of investors. What we're looking for You have run a growth-stage equity round from inside a company, or worked on several from the investing side. You want to own the process, with a view to owning the pitch and fundraising function in the future as the company scales. We don't ask for a set number of years or a particular firm on your CV. We ask for evidence. Be ready to walk us through specific rounds and your part in them. Required Round experience: you ran an equity round from inside a company, or worked on several as an investor. You can show the map you built, the order you ran it in and what you would change. Investor writing: you turn the story a founder tells in a room into a page an investor reads alone. Short, plain, in a founder's voice, with numbers that held under diligence. Modelling: you built an investor model from a company's internal forecast and defended it in diligence. Terms: you can put two term sheets side by side and say what each costs in the round after. Data rooms: you built one that answered questions before they were asked. You can name the question you missed. Getting work from other teams: you got inputs from teams that did not report to you, on dates agreed in writing. You can say what arrived late and what you did about it. Market knowledge: you know which funds invest at our stage and which partner leads, or can build that picture in weeks and show your working. Handling no: investors have told you no. You kept the record of why and used it the next time. Nice to have Experience in logistics, delivery, marketplaces or another operations-heavy business. Time at a growth-stage fund, a tech-focused bank or a private-capital adviser before going in-house. Investor relations between rounds at a private company. The hard parts The CEO pitches. You are the investors' contact for everything around the room. You are judged on how the round runs, not on the pitch. The numbers come from the CFO. The proof comes from teams that do not report to you. The market sets the timing, not us. Investors will say no, often. The record has to stay straight. The job keeps going after the close: the map, the materials in quiet quarters and the relationships between rounds. We will agree with you what support you need to do that well. How we hire Talent Acquisition, 45 minutes: the job as it is, a round you ran or worked on, and how you work. An interview with our VP International: 45 minutes: how you work, the evidence and across your whole career The case, about a day on your own time Case review, 75 minutes, with the CEO and CFO: you walk us through it, re-plan live when we change a condition, and take two questions the case cannot reach . References and a decision within a week. An offer comes in a conversation. Tell us at any stage if you need adjustments. Who Thrives at Relay? Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously. Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction. 1% Better Every Day : You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience. All In, All the Time : You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts. People-Powered Greatness : You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success. Grow the Whole Pie : You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we. If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect. Running the transaction with the CEO & CFO

  1. Build the investor map: which funds, which partner at each, why each fits us, in what order we go, and the warm path to each.

  2. The process start to close: the timeline, outreach, a brief before every meeting and notes after, investor questions answered within a day, and diligence.

  3. Put term sheets side by side and show what each costs in the round after. Draw up illustrative analysis and counsel the CEO on the right strategy.

  4. Hold the story in one version, drafted with the CEO. The same claims and numbers across the deck, the model and the data room.

  5. Own the investor-facing model: scenarios, unit economics and use of funds. Every number ties to one the CFO has signed.

Between rounds

  1. Refresh the deck, the KPI pack and the data room every quarter.

  2. Write investor and board updates. Answer existing investors' questions. Track what we promised them.

  3. Build relationships with investors so you can source your own relationships for future rounds

  4. Read the market: who invests at our stage, on what terms, and what comparable companies showed when they raised. Put what Relay must show, and by when, to the leadership team in writing.

Across both

  1. Agree in writing with each function what it produces for a raise and by when. Flag the proof the story needs a quarter early, not the week before.

  2. Keep the record: what each investor asked, what we answered, what we promised and what we learned.

By the end of your first six months

  • An investor map with a reason beside every name.

  • One version of the story across the deck, the model and the data room.

  • A data room refreshed every quarter, never rebuilt.

  • A written agreement with each function on what it produces for a raise.

  • A clear line of sight to a closed round from a ranked list of investors.

What we're looking for

You have run a growth-stage equity round from inside a company, or worked on several from the investing side. You want to own the process, with a view to owning the pitch and fundraising function in the future as the company scales.

We don't ask for a set number of years or a particular firm on your CV. We ask for evidence. Be ready to walk us through specific rounds and your part in them.

Required

  • Round experience: you ran an equity round from inside a company, or worked on several as an investor. You can show the map you built, the order you ran it in and what you would change.

  • Investor writing: you turn the story a founder tells in a room into a page an investor reads alone. Short, plain, in a founder's voice, with numbers that held under diligence.

  • Modelling: you built an investor model from a company's internal forecast and defended it in diligence.

  • Terms: you can put two term sheets side by side and say what each costs in the round after.

  • Data rooms: you built one that answered questions before they were asked. You can name the question you missed.

  • Getting work from other teams: you got inputs from teams that did not report to you, on dates agreed in writing. You can say what arrived late and what you did about it.

Nice to have

About Bolt Pharmacy and AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy

We are building a world-class team.

As a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy (part of AIOS), your fundamental role is to turn prescriptions into treatment patients can count on - safely, accurately and at pace.

You'll be at the heart of our dispensing operation, selecting, labelling and securely packing medicines for patients across the UK. You'll take ownership of your work within your qualified scope, follow dispensing procedures precisely and escalate clinical questions to our pharmacists. Every prescription has a person behind it.

You'll keep quality high as volumes grow. From protecting the cold chain and monitoring storage temperatures to managing stock and checking deliveries, you'll help keep medicines safe and orders moving. You'll report errors and near misses promptly, so we learn quickly and keep improving.

Working alongside pharmacists, fellow dispensers and our stock and customer service teams, you'll help resolve issues before they delay treatment. You'll also support trainee dispensers and spot practical ways to make Bolt Pharmacy's operation more efficient. Your experience will help raise the standard of the whole team.

Great performance means consistently processing 30+ orders per hour while maintaining over 99.5% dispensing accuracy, zero critical errors and full compliance with our procedures. Patients receive the right treatment, colleagues trust your work and we can serve more people with confidence.

This is a full-time, on-site role at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn, UK, working standard business hours with possible shift patterns.

You'll report directly to our Shift Lead and work closely with our Site Operations Lead, Michal Binkowski.

You'll work most closely with Bolt Pharmacy's pharmacists, qualified and trainee dispensers, Stock Control and Customer Service, combining dispensing oversight, shared workloads and patient support.

Key responsibilities

  • Get every prescription right: Select, label and prepare medicines accurately within your qualified scope, following SOPs and escalating clinical queries to pharmacists.

  • Keep treatment moving: Process and securely pack 30+ orders per hour while maintaining accuracy, safety and compliance.

  • Protect every medicine: Maintain cold-chain controls, monitor fridge and room temperatures, and escalate storage deviations immediately.

  • Take ownership of stock: Check incoming deliveries, maintain correct storage and rotation, and support stock takes so medicines are available when needed.

  • Make quality everyone's business: Record errors, near misses and incidents promptly, keep workstations clean and compliant, follow hygiene and PPE procedures, and suggest practical improvements.

  • Raise the team's standard: Guide trainee dispensers, support colleagues and work with Customer Service to resolve patient queries and order updates.

Need to have

  • Dispensing qualification: You hold a valid Buttercups certification or equivalent dispensing qualification.

  • Experience at pace: You've worked in high-volume dispensing and can consistently meet a target of 30+ orders per hour without compromising safety.

  • Attention to detail: You bring exceptional accuracy to medicine selection, labelling and prescription preparation.

  • Ownership within your scope: You organise your workload independently, follow SOPs precisely and know when to involve a pharmacist.

  • Professionalism: You're reliable, punctual and committed to patient safety and regulatory compliance.

Nice to have

  • Qualified experience: You've spent at least a year working as a qualified dispenser.

  • Online pharmacy: You understand the demands of dispensing and dispatching treatment to patients remotely.

  • Mentoring: You've trained or supported junior colleagues and can explain procedures clearly.

  • Stock management: You bring experience in inventory control, stock rotation and keeping a busy dispensary supplied.

  • Patient support: You've handled healthcare queries with care, clarity and professionalism.

  • Pharmacy standards: You're familiar with GPhC requirements and how they translate into everyday practice.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

🎯 "You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

Our compensation package includes equity, giving you the opportunity to share in what we build.

  • Training role: £13 per hour while you complete the required training and sign-off.

  • Qualified role: £15 per hour in total compensation, including equity, once you have completed the required training and are qualified and signed off for the role.

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Personal development: A £400 budget for books, courses and coaching to keep building your skills.

  • Personal wellness: A £400 budget for the gym and health apps to support your wellbeing.

  • GLP-1s: Get free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s, if clinically applicable.

  • Health coaching: Access free biweekly health coaching to help you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: Access free biweekly work coaching to stay sharp and calm.

  • What are we missing? We're still early, so your ideas can help shape our culture.

Seit über vier Jahren lizenzieren wir Kraken und unterstützen Unternehmen bei ihrer Transformation. Dabei übertragen wir nicht nur ihren Kundenstamm auf unsere Kraken-Plattform, sondern verändern auch ihre Betriebsmodelle und Arbeitsweisen. In dieser Zeit hat unser Team wegweisende Migrationen in der Branche vorangetrieben und neue Maßstäbe dafür gesetzt, wie Unternehmenstransformation aussehen kann. 🏠 Deine Rolle bei uns: Du wirst Teil des Client-Delivery-Teams bei Kraken und begleitest europäische Kunden auf ihrem Weg durch die technologische Transformation. Dabei unterstützt du langfristige Migrationsprojekte. Als Client Delivery Lead verantwortest du einen technologischen Fachbereich, beispielsweise Abrechnung, Finanzen oder Kommunikation, innerhalb unserer Kundenprojekte. Dabei geht es entweder um die Migration auf unsere Kraken-Plattform oder um die Betreuung langfristiger technologischer Anforderungen. Du arbeitest eng mit den technischen und operativen Teams von Kraken sowie mit dem Kunden zusammen, um die jeweiligen Projekt- und Geschäftsziele zu erreichen. Als Client Delivery Lead musst du genau verstehen, wie Kraken funktioniert. Du analysierst die vom Kunden gemeldeten Probleme und Anforderungen und konkretisierst passende Lösungen, um bestehende und neue Funktionen optimal zu nutzen. Du bringst Technologie, Menschen und Prozesse zusammen, um innovative Verbesserungen für unsere Kunden zu ermöglichen. Außerdem unterstützt du den Kunden dabei, Arbeitsweisen einzuführen, die zum Entwicklungsansatz von Kraken passen. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Produktmanagern und Entwicklern zusammen, bringst Entwicklungsanforderungen ein und bildest die Schnittstelle zum Kunden. 🚀 Dafür übernimmst du Verantwortung: Du betreust die Beziehungen zu deinen Ansprechpartnern auf Kundenseite, häufig Product Owner und fachlich Verantwortliche. Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für technische Weiterentwicklungen sowie für die Eskalation und Lösung von Problemen in deinem jeweiligen Fach- oder Produktbereich. Du bist die zentrale Wissensquelle dafür, wie Kraken funktioniert und wie wir die Kraken-Plattform bereitstellen. Du sichtest und priorisierst eingehende Anfragen und kommunizierst die Prioritäten der Kunden intern. Du fasst Kundenanforderungen, relevante Rahmenbedingungen und Zeitpläne zusammen und vermittelst sie intern, um die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Kraken-Plattform zu ermöglichen. Du unterstützt das Entwicklungsteam bei der Umsetzung von Produktfunktionen. Du regst Kunden dazu an, technische Entwicklung neu zu denken, und vertrittst unseren Ansatz der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung und Bereitstellung mit Überzeugung. Dies ist eine praxisorientierte Fachrolle ohne Personalverantwortung. Dein Arbeitsstandort liegt in Europa; deine Projekte können in unterschiedlichen Ländern angesiedelt sein. Reisebereitschaft wird vorausgesetzt. Wir sind eine agile Organisation mit flachen Hierarchien und möchten das auch bleiben. Wir suchen aufgeschlossene Menschen, die mit Unklarheiten und einem sich ständig verändernden Umfeld gut umgehen können. Um bei uns erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du eigeninitiativ handeln und bereit sein, selbst mit anzupacken, um Probleme zu lösen. Dabei gehst du regelmäßig über deinen üblichen Aufgabenbereich hinaus, um unsere Kunden und unsere Organisation voranzubringen. Du stehst hinter dem Kraken-Ansatz zur Technologieentwicklung, der auf Einfachheit, Kundennutzen und Effizienz beruht, und begleitest die beteiligten Interessengruppen durch den Veränderungsprozess. Du bist bereit, bestehende Überzeugungen zu hinterfragen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven einzunehmen und bei Bedarf auch über deinen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich hinauszugehen, um den Kunden zu unterstützen. Als Pioniere auf diesem Gebiet begeistert uns, wie Kraken das Leben unserer Kunden verändern kann. Wir sind überzeugt, dass Kraken die beste Lösung ist – sowohl für mehr Effizienz als auch als Werkzeug im Kampf gegen die Klimakrise. Wir suchen Menschen mit ausgeprägter Problemlösungskompetenz und einer durchweg positiven, lösungsorientierten Einstellung. Neue Herausforderungen sind spannend, weil wir durch sie jeden Tag besser werden. Und je größer die Herausforderung, desto größer das Erfolgserlebnis.“ Fundierte Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Kundenprojekten und/oder als Product Owner. Erfahrung mit agilen Umsetzungsmethoden. Überzeugungskraft und die Fähigkeit, traditionelle Denkweisen zu hinterfragen. Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit umfangreichen, komplexen Projekt- und Umsetzungspipelines für Kunden. Geduld und Eigeninitiative: Unsere Kunden durchlaufen tiefgreifende Veränderungen, die Zeit brauchen und unser Verständnis erfordern. Gutes Zeitmanagement und eine tatkräftige, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise. Beratungserfahrung ist von Vorteil. Fließende Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse. title: Data Scientist (Fraud)
description:
Who we are

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest-growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of Naira in transactions monthly. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere.

About this role:

We're looking for a Data Scientist to sit at the heart of how we fight fraud — building the models, experiments, and detection systems that protect millions of customers and merchants across our platform. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of machine learning, product, and engineering, where your work will directly shape how Moniepoint detects and responds to emerging fraud threats.

You are a data-driven, intellectually curious Data Scientist who is energized by hard problems in fraud and financial crime. You'll prototype and ship ML models, design experiments, and uncover new fraud signals across our ecosystem — partnering closely with engineers, product managers, and analysts to turn your work into production-grade systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Prototype, evaluate, and help produce machine learning models for fraud detection; own their ongoing monitoring and retraining cycles.

  • Design and run experiments to measure the impact of fraud interventions, balancing customer experience against loss reduction.

  • Size fraud typologies across our product lines to inform prioritization and investment decisions.

  • Build and maintain anomaly detection systems to surface novel fraud vectors before they scale.

  • Work closely with fraud operations, engineers, product managers, and data analysts to translate model outputs into real-world mitigations.

Experience & Background:

  • A strong foundation in statistics with a degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, or similar).

  • 3+ years of experience in data science, decision science, or risk analytics within fraud, payments, or financial crime.

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment.

  • Fraud, risk, or financial services experience is a strong plus.

  • Solid grounding in data science fundamentals: experimentation, statistical inference, model evaluation, and feature engineering.

  • Comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams with high ownership expectations.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Proficiency in Python and SQL; comfort working across the full model development lifecycle.

  • An investigative instinct — you enjoy digging into data to find patterns others miss.

  • The ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders and translate insights into action.

What Success Looks Like in This Role:

  • Production-grade ML models and anomaly detection systems that effectively surface and mitigate novel fraud vectors before they scale.

  • Well-designed experiments that successfully balance customer experience against fraud loss reduction.

  • Clear sizing of fraud typologies that effectively drives product prioritization and strategic investment decisions.

  • Seamless cross-functional alignment where technical model outputs are consistently translated into real-world fraud mitigations.

Why Join Us?

  • Culture: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We've built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
  • Learning: We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
  • Compensation: You'll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

title: Territory Account Executive, Manchester
description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square’s mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.

This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

You will serve as Square’s presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square’s visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

You will:

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

  • Spend ~80% of your week in the field — walking your territory, engaging local businesses, and driving 50–60 targeted business visits each week.
  • Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square’s full product suite.

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.
  • Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

  • Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.
  • Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.
  • Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You have:

  • 3+ years of sales experience in a full cycle closing role with field sales experience
  • Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals
  • Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment 
  • Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)
  • Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation and live in the market you are serving
  • A collaborative and team player mentality
  • Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent
  • Even better:
    • 2+ years of payment processing OR related technology (i.e. payroll, loyalty, time management)
    • 1+ years of relevant audience experience (experience working in/selling to restaurants, retailers or services based businesses)

title: Senior Partnerships Manager, UK
description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square is seeking a Senior Partnerships Manager to source, negotiate, and scale partnerships that fuel Square seller acquisition, retention, and business growth across the United Kingdom. Partners include referral networks, distributors, service providers, technology platforms, and strategic ecosystems where there is mutual benefit through lead generation, co-sell, co-marketing, and product enablement.

This is a highly visible, hands-on role at the intersection of business development, growth, product, and go-to-market strategy. You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of strategic partnerships — from sourcing and deal structuring through to activation and ongoing optimisation — with a focus on creating partnerships that deliver incredible user experiences for Square sellers. You will work in tight collaboration with Product Marketing to shape partner narratives, positioning, and GTM motions, and partner cross-functionally to drive measurable growth outcomes for the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Sourcing & Deal Execution: Identify, evaluate, and secure high-impact partners; lead negotiations and close large-scale partnership deals and product integrations that advance Square's capabilities and growth.
  • Product Partnership Development: Collaborate closely with Product and Product Marketing to design partnership experiences that delight sellers — ensuring integrations are seamless, valuable, and well-positioned in market.
  • Growth Accountability: Deliver measurable results in lead generation, seller acquisition, and pipeline contribution through your portfolio of strategic partnerships.
  • Activation & Scaling: Launch partnerships with clear GTM plans, co-marketing
    initiatives, and integrated roadmaps; work hand-in-hand with Product Marketing to bring partnerships to life for sellers.
  • Executive Relationship Management: Build and sustain senior-level relationships with partners, ensuring long-term value creation and mutual growth.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Product Marketing, Operations, Marketing, Sales, and Legal to ensure smooth execution and maximum impact. Bring an ownership mentality to how the team operates — actively contributing to team processes, rituals, and ways of working that make us better together.
  • Measurement & Optimisation: Define and track KPIs for partnership success, adjusting strategy and tactics as needed to drive continuous growth.

You Have

  • 8+ years in business development, strategic partnerships, and/or product partnerships, with demonstrated progression in scope and impact
  • Hands-on experience sourcing, negotiating, and closing large-scale partnerships and product integrations
  • Strong collaboration skills with Product Marketing; experience shaping partner positioning, co-marketing, and GTM narratives
  • Demonstrated ability to connect partnership strategy directly to measurable seller acquisition and revenue outcomes
  • Experience working cross-functionally with a broad range of teams, with an ownership mentality
  • Strong negotiation and relationship management skills, with experience engaging at the executive level
  • SaaS, fintech, or payments background strongly preferred.

title: Senior Director, Destination Management, Supply
description:
Senior Director, Destination Management, Supply I Tripadvisor

About Tripadvisor 

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor Experiences is the world's leading marketplace for tours, activities, and experiences. Our mission is to bring more wonder to the world by delivering exceptional experiences to travelers wherever they are. We offer an unparalleled opportunity to be part of the future of the travel experiences industry.


The Opportunity

Reporting to the Chief Commercial Officer, Experiences, the Senior Director of Destination Management leads Viator's global destination management team. You will bring a deep understanding of the global operator community and use it to develop strategies that solve business problems and support our mutual goal with operators: delivering exceptional experiences to travelers. 

This is an operational role. You will be expected to deliver significant business outcomes by leading and motivating a global team, with decisive leadership and a strong bias for action.

Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 2 to 3 days per week in our London Office.

Key Responsibilities: 

Operator Community and Destination Strategy

  • Hold a deep, current understanding of the operator community: its needs, economics, competitive options and pain points. Use it to shape how we win and retain supply.

  • Own the 3 year destination management strategy and translate it into clear regional charters and measurable KPIs, growing revenue and market share in leading destinations.

  • Develop strategies that solve business problems for both operators and Viator, in support of delivering exceptional traveler experiences.

  • Own financial rigor: use fresh business data and pacing to steer the business, and help your team understand the financial impact of its decisions and be accountable for it.

Team Leadership and Talent

  • Act as chief architect of the global destination management organization. Lead and mentor Regional Managers, and design an organization and operating model that fits the business as it evolves.

  • Set and hold the hiring bar, run rigorous and consistent performance management, and calibrate with peers across Supply.

  • Build and retain top talent, and maintain a leadership bench and succession plan for Regional Manager roles.

  • Set the standard for leadership: humble, open to feedback, and skilled at leading teams through change.

  • Be clear on what each person and region owns, and hold them accountable for it. Push decisions to the lowest appropriate level while stepping in personally on cross-regional or cross-functional problems no one else owns.

Data-Driven Decision Making

  • Set the standard for hypothesis quality and test design. Define what the team needs to learn, require evidence and experimentation over opinion, and prioritize what operators and travelers actually do over what they say.

Connectivity

  • Ensure industry-leading connectivity with the features and support operators need. Oversee the connectivity support team and partner with R&D to build enhanced connectivity features.

Innovation and AI

  • Drive innovation by bringing in outside ideas through industry conferences, councils and competitor insight, and share what works across functions.

  • Advocate for and implement AI and automation to transform productivity and quality, including rethinking roles and workflows. Scale proven wins across regions, build team AI skills, and use AI responsibly within our governance and data-privacy guidelines.

  • Monitor competitive dynamics, regulatory environments and industry trends affecting supply.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Align with Supply Sales, Marketing, R&D and Support, and act as an integrator on OKRs and problems that cut across functions, so operators and customers have a seamless end-to-end experience.

  • Partner as one team across Supply and Tripadvisor Experiences, and hold cross-functional partners accountable as well as being held accountable by them.

Skills & Experience

  • Global Leadership: 10+ years leading and scaling global teams in market management, account management or a combination, including leading managers of managers.

  • Operator and Marketplace Expertise: Extensive experience with two-sided marketplaces, a deep understanding of supply-side dynamics, technologies and operator communities, ideally in travel.

  • Strategic Thinking: A track record of setting multi-year strategy and turning it into goals, KPIs and results.

  • Operational Excellence: Data-driven operational leadership with a strong bias for action. Skilled at KPIs, pacing and scalable processes to improve global efficiency.

  • Quality Orientation: Experience defining and enforcing quality standards across a catalog or supplier base.

  • Tech Savvy and AI Proficiency: A proven history of using AI and technology to improve business outcomes and create transformational change.

  • Commercial Acumen: Strong commercial and financial acumen, with advanced negotiation and relationship management skills to build and sustain key operator partnerships.

  • Inspirational Leader: An authentic, humble leader who builds trust, develops talent and cultivates a winning culture.

What We Offer 

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

What You'll Do

You will work with our team of applied research engineers at the intersection of computer vision,  gameplay agents, natural language processing, and machine learning to create state-of-the-art tools to support game developers in our ecosystem with a focus on bots (trained gameplay agents, intelligent NPCs, companions, world modeling), as well as automation of a number key areas (including moderation, security, and QA testing). In this role, you will

    • PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics or related field, or 3+ years of relevant industry experience

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.
  • Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.
  • Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.
  • Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.
  • Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.
  • Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.
  • Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field
  • Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts
  • Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP)
  • Hands-on hardware-software integration: system bring-up, wiring and connectors, and embedded interfaces (UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) at a practical level
  • Structured troubleshooting: you can isolate whether a problem is software, hardware, configuration or RF, often under time pressure in the field

  • Willing to travel and work on-site with customers, including at test ranges and in field environments

Nice-to-have

  • Previous customer-facing or field engineering role, especially with defense or government customers
  • German language skills

raw.title: Growth Partnerships Manager
raw.description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

Zable is about to become the face of Lendable. We’re rebranding the company and product, significantly increasing our D2C marketing investment, and building out a marketing function under our newly appointed CMO. It’s one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, backed by real financial strength, a large customer base and a product people love.

Partnerships and sponsorships will be central to how we grow, and we’re building the team to make that happen. As our Growth Partnerships Manager, you’ll shape the strategy and the budget, not just manage the day-to-day. Reporting to the Head of Growth Partnerships, you’ll define our commercial approach, decide where partnership spend goes, and take every deal from first conversation to live activation: agreeing terms, making sure campaigns land well, and keeping partners engaged. You’ll also make the case for each investment, with the data to back it, to senior leadership.

This is a senior seat for someone who enjoys both the creative and the analytical sides of partnerships. You’ll have real budget responsibility, model payback economics, and bring colleagues with you on the big calls. If you think about CPA, rev share and LTV:CAC as naturally as you think about relationships, you’ll feel at home here.

What we're looking for:

Essential:

  • 5+ years in partnerships, affiliate marketing, sponsorships, BD or growth roles for a consumer brand, including time spent shaping commercial strategy, not just executing it

  • Fluent in core acquisition performance metrics, CPA, Revenue share, LTV, ROI and blended CAC, and comfortable moving between them when structuring a deal

  • Working knowledge of channel economics: payback period, cohort behaviour, and how partnership spend compares against other acquisition channels

  • Direct experience running affiliate and/or influencer partnership end to end, including commercial negotiation (not just relationship management)

  • Track record of running activations end-to-end and delivering measurable results

  • Strong account / relationship management skills

  • Comfortable with the data, channel economics, attribution and ROI

  • Highly organised and detail-oriented, you can run multiple activations in parallel

  • Strong commercial communicator, you can hold your own with senior partners and senior internal stakeholders alike

  • Experience setting and owning a partnerships budget or channel P&L, with the judgement to reprioritise spend as performance data comes in

  • Comfortable presenting strategy and performance to senior leadership, and defending investment decisions with data

  • Demonstrable use of AI in your workflow

Desirable:

  • Experience in fintech or financial services

  • Experience with sport, entertainment, media or large brand sponsorships

  • Experience with an affiliate network or tracking platform (e.g. Impact, Awin, CJ, Partnerize) and reading platform-level reporting unassisted

  • Experience with affiliate, influencer or embedded finance partnerships

  • Some deal structuring experience

  • Experience line-managing or mentoring a more junior partnerships or affiliate executive

You’re a good fit if you’re:

  • A natural relationship-builder, partners trust you, and so does your team

  • A strategic thinker as much as a doer, you can zoom out to set the plan, then zoom back in to execute it yourself

  • Commercially literate first, relationship-led second, you measure success in growth, not vanity

  • A strong project manager, you keep things moving and on-budget

  • Data-fluent , you build your own view on what’s working from raw performance data, not just a dashboard summary

  • Hands-on and resourceful, you make things happen

  • Curious about AI and how it changes the partnerships discipline

What you'll be doing

Leadership & Strategy:

  • Set the partnerships strategy and roadmap, and own the case for investment with senior leadership

  • Mentor and support a more junior partnerships or affiliate executive

  • Represent the partnerships function in senior leadership and budget reviews

Commercial & Performance:

  • Negotiate commercial terms with affiliates, influencers and sponsorship partners – CPA, Revenue share, hybrid and flat-fee structures – and know which model fit the partner

  • Own the partnerships budget and unit economics of every live partnership: track CAC by channel and partner against LTV, and flag anything trending the wrong way before it becomes a budget problem

  • Build and maintain the channel-economics view that lets the team compare partnership spend against other acquisition channels

  • Manage affiliate network/platform relationships (tracking, reconciliation, payout accuracy) and be the first port of call when number don’t match

Activation:

  • Run sponsorship and partnership activations end-to-end, brief, plan, ship, measure

  • Manage the day-to-day with partners: planning, comms, escalations

  • Coordinate across creative, growth, lifecycle and legal

Partner Management:

  • Own the partner relationship, be the trusted operator they call first

  • Manage budgets and timelines across activations

  • Spot opportunities to expand existing partnerships based on their performance data

Performance & Optimisation:

  • Track partnership performance against targets, CPA, CAC, LTV, ROI, Rev Share payout

  • Build the playbooks and tooling that scale the function, including standard commercial terms by partner type

  • Use AI to scale research, brief-writing and reporting

Cross-functional:

  • Partner with creative on activation assets

  • Partner with finance and legal on contracts and accruals and commission reconciliation

  • Report on partnership performance to the Head of Growth Partnerships, with the numbers to back every recommendation

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

  • Create and maintain mobile E2E suites in Maestro, including the scaffolding around them - test data, device configuration, helpers, reporting.

  • Mobile performance and reliability work (crash reporting, startup time, memory and battery awareness).

  • API and contract testing experience, with a point of view on test data and environment strategy.

Backend: Kotlin, PHP 8 (Symfony), AWS, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes.

Tooling and observability: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, Sentry, Grafana.

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the role

As a Sales Director at Faculty, you will lead the sale of large-scale strategic AI engagements, building trusted C-suite relationships and establishing Faculty as the essential partner for the world's largest companies pursuing transformative AI initiatives.

You will drive high-impact growth by navigating complex sales cycles, collaborating closely with key strategic partners like Accenture, and shaping bold, differentiated commercial solutions that empower Fortune 500 and FTSE 100 organisations to harness the full power of artificial intelligence.

What you'll be doing

  • Building and managing a qualified pipeline of high-value strategic opportunities directly across target enterprises and joint Accenture partnership channels.

  • Leading end-to-end sales processes from initial executive engagement through to contract signature, orchestrating technical scoping, solution design, commercial negotiations, procurement, and legal reviews.

  • Developing enduring executive relationships with C-suite sponsors at global enterprise accounts, positioning Faculty as their premier partner for transformative AI initiatives.

  • Collaborating with Accenture leadership to identify joint pursuit opportunities, align go-to-market strategies, and coordinate enterprise deal execution.

  • Achieving quarterly and annual revenue targets while maintaining rigorous forecasting discipline and providing leadership with clear visibility into pipeline health.

  • Partnering with cross-functional technical and delivery teams to shape compelling, credible propositions that solve complex organisational challenges.

Who we're looking for

  • You bring a proven track record of enterprise sales leadership, successfully closing complex, multi-quarter strategic engagements with Fortune 500 or FTSE 100 companies.

  • You excel at C-suite engagement, building trusted relationships with senior executives such as CTOs, CSOs, and CISOs who sponsor enterprise-wide AI and safety initiatives.

  • You possess strong technical sales acumen, comfortably translating complex AI concepts into clear business value while engaging fluently with both technical teams and commercial decision-makers.

  • You bring valuable partnership sales experience, adept at collaborating with consulting firms, systems integrators, and hyper-scalers to co-sell and win major accounts.

  • You master deal orchestration and commercial structuring, with expertise in guiding multi-stakeholder work streams and negotiating sophisticated agreements like MSAs and outcome-based pricing models.

  • You demonstrate exceptional executive presence and resilience, presenting confidently to boards and C-suites while maintaining energy and momentum through complex, high-stakes sales cycles.

The Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 mins)

  2. Introduction call with the Hiring Manager (30 mins)

  3. On site Panel Interview (60mins)

  4. Final interview with one of our Managing Directors (30mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

You'll build our UK sales pipeline and help grow our presence in the market with a focus on generating leads, scoping consultative programmes, negotiating partnerships and managing key customer relationships. You'll also play a leading role in identifying market opportunities, customer needs and emerging trends that can inform Klim’s UK strategy, go-to-market engine, marketing, and product roadmap. This role is based in the UK, and we have a coworking space in London where the team meets to collaborate. Location: You are based in the UK and have the right to work there. Consulting or Enterprise sales: You have 5+ years in consulting and/or enterprise B2B sales, business development or client-facing leadership roles. You have a track record of scoping and leading large complex projects, and / or closing complex, 6- and 7-figure deals with a technical element (preferably within sustainability or procurement) P&L Impact: Demonstrated experience developing and closing commercial partnerships, contracts, or other revenue-generating opportunities. Sector depth: You have experience in the UK agri-food system - e.g. agri-food sustainability, agritech, soil carbon or MRV, agronomy & inputs, or food & drink supply chains. Consultative approach: you diagnose before you pitch, build the business case together with the customer, and are comfortable managing different stakeholders - including senior finance and procurement leaders. Consulting experience is preferred. Sales discipline: Experience with a structured sales method such as MEDDPIC, and CRM tools such as Pipedrive. Ownership: Excited to lead and build out a market with a small local team, with a larger cross-functional support team behind you. Communication: Used to preparing high quality client-facing materials, and confident presenting to boards and at industry events. Nice to have: A background in management or sustainability consulting A network across UK food companies, retailers, grain traders or farming organisations Working knowledge of regenerative agriculture, Scope 3 accounting (e.g. SBTi FLAG, GHG Protocol) or UK agricultural policy Experience in fast-growing start-ups, or growth / marketing / partnership management. What we offer: Impact: a daily, measurable contribution to soil health, the climate and fairer outcomes for farmers. Ownership: the chance to build Klim's UK business, with real autonomy and direct access to our leadership team. Growth: a company scaling across Europe, with room to grow the UK team - and your remit with it. Flexibility: we foster a flexible, remote work approach, with regular get togethers with the team in Berlin and out in the field. Package: competitive salary & commission scheme tied to UK results At Klim, we believe that a thriving workplace is built on the diverse backgrounds, talents, and perspectives of our team. We grow stronger together by embracing and building on each individual’s unique strengths. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. All hiring and personnel decisions are made solely based on qualifications, performance, and the needs of the company - ensuring fairness and equal opportunity for all. raw.description:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the role

We're looking for a Junior Software Engineer to join our engineering team in London. This is a hybrid role, with a minimum of three days a week in our London office. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who wants to grow quickly, work on real production systems, and learn how a high-growth fintech operates from the inside.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers who will support you through code reviews, pairing and mentorship. We maintain a culture of ownership, and we value engineers who are curious about the business and keen to work with stakeholders to improve processes and the customer experience.

There are opportunities across platform engineering, B2B customer integration, conversion optimisation and business process automation. You'll work on a best-in class Open Banking decision-making platform and learn how to build systems that operate with low latency, at scale.

Our technology stack:

Python (including FastAPI, OpenTelemetry, procrastinate, SQLAlchemy, Uvicorn), Java,

React, Postgres, MySQL, Liquibase, Retool, Docker, AWS

What you’ll be doing

  • Build and maintain features in our backend services, which can span any part of the lending lifecycle – from finding and onboarding new customers, to helping underwriters assess affordability, through to paying out and collecting loans

  • Take part in the full software development lifecycle: contributing to designs, writing tests, reviewing code and helping with deployments

  • Write clean, well-tested code in Python and Java, with guidance and feedback from senior engineers

  • Work with colleagues in Product and Design, as well as internal users, to understand requirements and turn them into working software

  • Help troubleshoot and resolve system issues that affect our customers, as part of a supported team rota during business hours

  • Write and improve SQL queries against our Postgres databases

  • Gradually take ownership of parts of the platform as your experience grows

  • Build and improve frontend features in React, and grow your skills across the full stack

Who you are

  • 0–2 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent experience from a degree, bootcamp, internships or personal projects

  • Working knowledge of Java and Python – you don't need to be an expert, but you're comfortable writing and debugging code in both

  • Hands-on experience building frontend interfaces with React

  • An understanding of core programming concepts such as data structures, object-oriented design and writing unit tests

  • Familiarity with SQL and relational databases

  • Comfortable using Git for version control

  • A genuine interest in fintech and how financial products work

  • A sharp eye for detail – in lending, small mistakes can have a real impact on customers

  • You learn fast, pick up new tools and concepts quickly, and enjoy doing so

  • You thrive in a fast-moving environment, are comfortable finding your way around a large, evolving codebase, and take initiative to work things out

  • Good problem-solving skills and a methodical approach to debugging

  • Clear communicator who asks questions, takes on feedback and works well in a team

  • Keen to work across the full stack, from backend services and databases through to the frontend

  • Able to work from our London office at least three days a week

Ideally you'll also have

  • Experience with async Python or frameworks such as FastAPI

  • Basic familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure) or Docker

  • Knowledge of lending products or Open Banking

How we work at Abound

To be successful here, our culture needs to energise you. Here is how we operate:

  • High Bar & Real Ownership: We are a high-performing team, and we hire people who raise the bar and take pride in great work. We own outcomes, not tasks.

  • We Work Hard: We care about impact, not face time. At key moments, we go the extra mile to deliver for customers and the business.

  • MVP & Iteration Culture: We ship fast, learn from real customers, and continuously improve our products and processes.

  • One Team Collaboration: We collaborate deeply across engineering, product, operations, and the wider business.

  • Thrive in Change: Priorities evolve as we learn what works. We value people who use good judgment, adapt quickly, and stay focused on outcomes.

What we offer

  • Everyone owns a piece of the company - equity

  • Hybrid with 3 days a week in the office

  • 25 days’ holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays

  • 2 paid volunteering days per year

  • One month paid sabbatical after 4 years

  • Employee loan

  • Free gym membership through WellHub

  • Team wellness budget to be active together - set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering
