  • Contributing to incident response efforts, production readiness, and reliability initiatives across engineering squads.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

 

The role

We’re looking for a Senior product manager to join the Tax and Recs squad in our European tribe. You’ll own how we reconcile client cash and assets, and how we help our clients report their customers’ tax correctly, as we grow across Europe.

Our European strategy has two parts. First, we’re going deep in Ireland, building a full proposition with the products, tax wrappers and pensions that Irish firms and their clients need. Second, we’re building the foundations to spread at speed into more European countries, with a focused offering for each market rather than a rebuild every time we enter a new one. The Tax and Recs squad makes both possible: we can only grow if our reconciliations hold up under regulatory scrutiny and our tax engine is something clients can trust.

You won’t be joining a finished roadmap. You’ll help define it, with real ownership over the problems that will decide how far and how fast we can grow in Europe. You’ll work closely with our Operations, Compliance and Customer teams, and with key European clients. A reliable tax engine is not just a regulatory necessity, it is a genuine advantage when we sell to new firms, so your work will be felt well beyond the squad.

What you’ll own

  • Scaling our cash and stock reconciliations to meet Client Asset Requirements (CAR) in Ireland, so we can grow volumes with confidence

  • Making sure our Operations team’s processes work in Europe and scale as we do

  • Building the tax reporting and tax engine for Ireland, so our clients can report tax correctly on behalf of their customers across the wrappers that matter to Irish firms

  • Localising that foundation to each wrapper and each country across Europe, rather than starting again every time

  • Connecting directly to tax authorities where a country requires us to pay tax on behalf of our clients’ customers

  • Making our tax engine reliable, transparent and easy to build on, so tax becomes a reason firms choose Seccl

  • Defining and prioritising the Tax and Recs squad’s roadmap, balancing what Ireland needs today with what the next European markets will need

  • Translating regulatory requirements, including CAR and Irish tax rules, into clear product requirements with Compliance

  • Breaking down complex problems like localising a tax engine into clear, actionable plans with engineers and other stakeholders

  • Using quantitative and qualitative data, such as break rates, exceptions and resolution times, to make evidence-based decisions

This role’s for you if...

  • You have a track record of owning a product area end to end, ideally in reconciliations, custody, investment operations or tax in a regulated environment (e.g. fintech, banking, investments, pensions, insurance)

  • You understand client money and money flow

  • You’re comfortable operating in 0→1 or highly ambiguous environments where structure doesn’t yet exist

  • You can bring clarity to complex, undefined problems and turn them into actionable plans

  • You’re highly proactive: you create momentum rather than wait for direction

  • You’re customer-obsessed, with a focus on improving workflows and outcomes

  • You thrive in cross-functional environments, working comfortably with Operations, Compliance, Customer and Engineering, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 As salary between £75,000 and £90,000, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, with some flexibility around bank holidays, plus your birthday off

  • 💙 Two volunteering days each year

  • 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

  • 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

  • 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

  • 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

  • 👪 Enhanced parental leave

  • 💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

  • 📖 Annual learning budget

  • 🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

  • 🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

  • 🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

  • 🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

 

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

 

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

 

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

 

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too.

 

  • First stage – 45 mins competencies-based interview with the hiring manager + team member

  • Second stage – one-hour technical focused interview, we will share a case study task in advance for you to present back to us on

  • Final stage – 45 mins bar-raiser culture-based interview

     

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.

 

Everyone’s welcome

We want to build a diverse and inclusive company full of brilliant people with different skills, experiences and perspectives. All applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

 

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you.

Compensation: £75K – £90K

Hybrid role based in our London office (3 days a week)

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior product manager to join the Account squad in our European tribe. You’ll own the foundations that let us onboard firms, clients and accounts across Europe, and shape the products we build on top of them.

Our European strategy has two parts. First, we’re going deep in Ireland, building a full proposition with the products, tax wrappers and pensions that Irish firms and their clients need. Second, we’re building the foundations to spread at speed into more European countries, with a focused offering for each market rather than a rebuild every time we enter a new one. The Account squad sits at the centre of both.

You won’t be joining a finished roadmap. You’ll help define it, with real ownership over the problems that will decide how far and how fast we can grow in Europe. Working alongside a small, high-impact European team, our Compliance and Commercial colleagues and key European clients, you’ll play a central role in taking us from a deep Irish proposition to a scalable European one.

What you’ll own

  • Launching an Irish Personal Investment Account (PIA). This is a new tax-incentivised product that isn’t yet live in the market, which makes it a genuine first mover opportunity for Seccl and our clients. Moving quickly and getting it right will matter.

  • Introducing jurisdiction into the Seccl platform, so products, rules and regulation can vary by country without rebuilding it each time

  • Building the foundations that let us scale onboarding for firms, clients and accounts and expand at speed across Europe

  • Integrating a third-party pension provider, so Irish firms can offer their clients a fuller suite of products

  • Turning Irish and European regulatory requirements into clear product requirements, working closely with Compliance

  • Defining and prioritising the Account squad’s roadmap, balancing what Ireland needs today with the foundations Europe will need

  • Breaking down complex problems like jurisdiction into clear, actionable plans with engineers and other stakeholders

  • Adapting and extending UK product and engineering capabilities for European markets

  • Making trade-offs across speed, risk and customer value in a highly regulated environment

  • Using quantitative and qualitative data to make evidence-based decisions

This role’s for you if...

  • You have a track record of owning a product area end to end, ideally in account, onboarding or customer lifecycle products in a regulated environment (e.g. fintech, banking, investments, pensions or insurance)

  • You have launched regulated products into European markets and understand how requirements can differ from one country to the next

  • You have experience of integrating with third-party providers, platforms or APIs

  • You’re comfortable in 0→1 or highly ambiguous environments, making trade-offs across speed, risk and customer value

  • You can bring clarity to complex, undefined problems and turn them into actionable plans

  • You’re highly proactive, creating momentum rather than waiting for direction

  • You’re customer-obsessed, focused on improving workflows and outcomes

  • You thrive in cross-functional teams, working with Compliance, Commercial and Engineering and communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Desirable: you’ve launched regulated products into European markets, or integrated with third-party providers, platforms or APIs

This role isn’t for you if:

  • You rely on top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership – it’s up to you to shape your growth and deliver outcomes.

  • You’re uncomfortable in a fast-paced environment. Our ability to move quickly and scale effectively is key to our success – we need people who can adapt and think on their feet.

  • You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who not only think big, but also deliver.

  • You resist change. We’re growing quickly, and the environment can be ambiguous – you’ll thrive here if you see change as an opportunity rather than a hurdle. 

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 As salary between £75,000 and £90,000, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, with some flexibility around bank holidays, plus your birthday off

  • 💙 Two volunteering days each year

  • 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

  • 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

  • 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

  • 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

  • 👪 Enhanced parental leave

  • 💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

  • 📖 Annual learning budget

  • 🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

  • 🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

  • 🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

  • 🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

The role ⚡

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 2 days in the office | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits

The Data Platform team builds and runs the platform that all Funding Circle data teams use. This includes our Snowflake platform, streaming and batch ingestion, orchestration, data contracts and the Data Product Portal.

We are in the middle of a big change. We are moving to Snowflake and to a federated "Data as a Product" model. This role will lead the engineering of that platform

  • Lead the technical direction of the Data Platform. Turn the target architecture into a clear, sequenced engineering plan, and keep the team aligned to it.

  • Own the technical quality of the platform: Snowflake infrastructure and RBAC, ingestion patterns, orchestration (Airflow), CI/CD, observability and cost controls.

  • Make and record technical decisions. Run the decision-document process. Make the final call when the team cannot agree, and escalate cross-domain decisions to the architecture review board.

  • Grow the team. Mentor engineers, spread knowledge so that no system depends on one person, and set a review culture that is fast and deep.

  • Make it easy for domain teams, Data Scientists, Analysts and AI Agents to build on the platform. Define standards and reusable patterns. Make sure that DP reviews do not block the domain teams, and work closely with the teams that use the platform.

  • Lead the platform side of the Athena → Snowflake migration: source landing, reconciliation and cutover evidence, and decommissioning of the legacy platform.

  • Own operational excellence with the Engineering Manager: on-call quality, alert quality, incident follow-ups, runbooks, and disaster recovery.

  • Own security and governance controls on the platform with Security and Data Governance.

  • Manage the technical relationship with platform vendors. This includes support cases, escalations and roadmap input.

  • Explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and data leadership.

  • Set and evolve the team's standards for AI-assisted engineering, so that tools like Claude and Copilot are used safely and consistently.

  • Work closely with the Principal Engineer. The Principal owns the cross-domain architecture. You turn it into the platform engineering plan and make sure the team delivers it.

What we’re looking for 🌱

We value deep expertise, but a growth mindset and good energy are what really make our team click. We’re a group that chooses to lift each other up and think smart every day.

  • 8+ years in Data & Analytics, with proven experience as a Senior/Tech Lead setting architectural direction for other engineers

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of Snowflake, including ideally Iceberg/open table formats and RBAC.

  • Advanced SQL, Python, and enterprise-grade dbt model development.

  • Experience designing end-to-end data pipelines. Combining batch, file-based, and streaming ingestion (Kafka/CDC) managed with Airflow orchestration.

  • A good understanding of data security and governance, including PII handling and access control.

  • Strong infrastructure-as-code skills and CI/CD skills.

  • Track record of writing clear design docs, explaining technical risks to non-technical stakeholders, and making decisions under uncertainty.

  • Able to architect custom AI solutions and smart automated systems that are safe, maintainable, and aligned with our long-term mission

  • Act as a technical bridge and mentor, training “builders" across the company to move from basic AI usage to sophisticated system creation

Skills we’d love to see:

  • Data contracts (ODCS/ODPS), data product portals, lineage tools.

  • Experience in a regulated financial services company.

  • Experience leading a migration or a large platform change.

  • PySpark or other distributed processing experience.

title: Manager CTO Office
description: Wat je over ons moet weten? Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en we willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat. Wat ga je doen? Als Manager CTO Office rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO en geef je leiding aan circa 16 IT-professionals. Het CTO Office is het centrale regie- en ondersteuningsorgaan binnen het CTO-domein. Vanuit het team zorg je ervoor dat het Technology - domein aantoonbaar in control is, met geïntegreerde sturing op onder andere governance, risk, performance, change portfolio en Third Parties. Samen met je team zorg je voor betrouwbare, veilige en klant- en businessgerichte Technology-dienstverlening. Je bouwt aan een professionele, resultaatgerichte werkomgeving waarin continu leren, talentontwikkeling, vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en continu verbeteren centraal staan. Als Manager CTO Office heb je een sleutelrol binnen het MT Technology en rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO. Je verbindt leiderschap en strategisch inzicht met een pragmatische aanpak. Zo zorg je voor samenhangende sturing en beheersing van het Technology-domein, waarbij governance en control bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming en een effectieve IT-organisatie. Sturing en beheersing Je ontwikkelt en implementeert een integrale visie op governance en control, waarmee Athora effectief voldoet aan interne en externe verplichtingen en tegelijkertijd ruimte creëert voor innovatie en groei. Je geeft richting aan governance, quality & risk management, procesmanagement, compliance, performance management, service management en demand & delivery management. Daarbij stuur je actief op kwaliteit, voorspelbaarheid en continue verbetering, zodat managementbeslissingen gebaseerd zijn op heldere inzichten en meetbare resultaten. Verandering en verbetering Je ontwikkelt en bestuurt het change portfolio voor het CTO-domein. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om de organisatie slimmer, eenvoudiger en effectiever te laten werken en zorgt dat veranderingen bijdragen aan de strategische doelen van Athora. Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden: Je leidt het CTO Office, ontwikkelt talent en versterkt vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en een professionele, resultaatgerichte cultuur; Je stuurt het Technology changeportfolio aan en zoekt daarbij actief de verbinding met de betrokken Change & Agility managers en de centrale portfoliofunctie; Je ontwikkelt en verbetert de IT-governance: je verduidelijkt verantwoordelijkheden, versterkt de besluitvorming en geeft richting en waarborgt aansluiting tussen Technology Governance en Data & AI Governance belegd bij het Data & AI Office; Je borgt samen met de relevante stakeholders kwaliteit, risicobeheersing en compliance binnen Technology; Je bereidt namens Technology de overleggen voor met toezichthouders zoals DNB, de externe accountant, Internal Audit en tweedelijns controlefuncties; Je voert de regie over Third Party Risk Management en waarborgt dat risico's, prestaties en compliance van strategische IT-sourcingpartners effectief worden beheerst; Je ontwikkelt en bewaakt de sourcingstrategie en het outsourcingbeleid. Ook organiseer en bewaak je de governance en monitoring van kritieke uitbestede activiteiten; Je levert heldere operationele, tactische en strategische stuurinformatie en versterkt daarmee transparante besluitvorming en een sterke performancecultuur. Je bewaakt budgetten, beheerst kosten en maakt de financiën binnen Technology en de onderliggende dienstverlening inzichtelijk; Je coacht en geeft functioneel leiding aan Product Owners, Release Train Engineers en Scrum Masters binnen Technology. Wat vragen we van jou? Voor deze rol zoeken we een ervaren manager die overzicht weet te houden in een complex Technology-landschap en tegelijkertijd dicht genoeg op de uitvoering zit om daadwerkelijk verandering te realiseren. Dit breng je minimaal mee: WO-werk- en -denkniveau en een relevante opleiding, bij voorkeur in informatiemanagement, IT, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting; Minimaal 10 jaar relevante ervaring binnen de financiële dienstverlening, met een sterk trackrecord op het gebied van strategisch advies, Governance, IT-governance, IT-procesmanagement, quality & risk control en performance-, service- en demand & delivery management; Ruime ervaring met het aansturen, ontwikkelen en inspireren van teams van vergelijkbare omvang, waarbij je medewerkers in staat stelt het beste uit zichzelf te halen; Diepgaande kennis van IT4IT, COBIT en andere toonaangevende IT-standaarden en frameworks, en het vermogen deze effectief toe te passen in een complexe organisatieomgeving; Aantoonbare ervaring met SAFe-principes en Agile werken, inclusief incrementplanning, sprintcadans, backlogmanagement en het succesvol managen van afhankelijkheden tussen teams; Sterke verandermanagementvaardigheden, waarbij je strategische ambities vertaalt naar concrete initiatieven en blijvende resultaten realiseert; Uitstekende stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief samen te werken met senior management, Legal & Compliance, Risk, Internal Audit en externe accountants; Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels, mondeling en schriftelijk. Wat krijg je van ons? Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega’s die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag. Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten. In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten. Salaris per maand: Op basis van cao schaal 19 HAY is de range € 7.872,85 tot € 10.497,13 op basis van 36 uur. Enthousiast? Reageer dan snel via de sollicitatie button! title: Senior Delivery Manager (m/w/d)
description: Kurzbeschreibung Führende Unternehmen wie Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, BMW, Bosch und Rheinmetall setzen auf SPREADs Software, um ihren Ingenieur- und Expertenteams zu ermöglichen, die Komplexität softwaredefinierter Fahrzeuge und Produkte souverän zu beherrschen. Unsere auf EE & SW spezialisierte Datenkontextualisierungs-Software verwandelt komplexe Produktdaten in leicht nutzbare Engineering Intelligence . Vorkonfigurierte Anwendungen und KI-Agenten helfen Teams, entscheidendes Produktwissen gezielt einzusetzen – so können Fahrzeuge und andere komplexe Produkte bis zu zehnmal schneller, zu halbierten Kosten und in besserer Qualität auf den Markt gebracht werden. Das gelingt durch automatisierte Erkenntnisse, die bessere Produktentscheidungen und deren Umsetzung unterstützen und dafür sorgen, dass Zeit-, Qualitäts- und Budgetziele im gesamten Produktlebenszyklus konsequent erreicht oder übertroffen werden. Für seine innovative Technologie hat SPREAD bereits zahlreiche Auszeichnungen erhalten, darunter den SPARK KI-Innovationspreis vom Handelsblatt & McKinsey 2024. Zudem ist SPREAD Teil der EU AI Champions Initiative und zählt zu den LinkedIn Top 20 Startups in DACH. Deine Verantwortung End-to-End-Steuerung von SPREAD-Delivery-Projekten vom Sales-Handover bis Go-Live und Hypercare: Festlegung ambitionierter Ziele und Zeitpläne in Abstimmung mit vereinbarten Erfolgskriterien sowie Sicherstellung der Lieferung im definierten Leistungsumfang, innerhalb von Zeitplan und Budget. Sicherstellung der Delivery durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Engineering und Product Teams sowie Kunden-Teams um das Projekt ins Ziel zu bringen: von der Anbindung von Datenquellen über die Integration in unseren Engineering Intelligence Graph bis zur Konfiguration von Anwendungen in SPREAD Studio und dem Einsatz von KI Agenten zur Lösung konkreter Use Cases mit messbarem Mehrwert. Planung und Moderation technischer und explorativer Workshops sowie Steuerung von UAT , Cutover und Adoption für Zielgruppen, in Abstimmung mit den von Value Engineering definierten Zielen. Koordination funktionsübergreifender Workstreams und Steuerung von Risiken, Annahmen, Entscheidungen und Änderungen mit klaren Executive-Updates und Stakeholder-gerechter Kommunikation. Transparentes Tracking und Kommunikation intern und an unsere Kunden bzgl. des Delivery Status und Reife sowie Value-Trackings und Dokumentation. Systematische Rückführung von Erkenntnissen aus Kundenprojekten in die Produktentwicklung zur Verbesserung von Skalierbarkeit, Performance und Wiederverwendung über Kunden hinweg. Deine Erfahrung Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Durchführung oder Steuerung komplexer Enterprise-Software-Projekte , idealerweise in Engineering-intensiven Branchen wie Automotive, Aerospace, Defence oder Maschinenbau. Erfahrung in Projekten mit Anbindung heterogener IT-Systeme und Abbildung von Entitäten in ein einheitliches Datenmodell sowie Vertrautheit mit APIs und Sicherheitsanforderungen . Fähigkeit zur Durchführung strukturierter Workshops sowie klare schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikation für technische Zielgruppen als auch für die Führungsebene. Souveräne Kommunikation intern und gegenüber Kunden, auch in kritischen Situationen und Eskalationen, mit gezielter Steuerung der Stakeholder und Sicherstellung aller Voraussetzungen fpr einen erfolgreichen Rollout (z.B. Datenkonnektoren). Ausgeprägte Ergebnisorientierung mit konsequenter Verknüpfung von Deliverables zu messbarem Wert sowie Steuerung aller Projektphasen anhand transparenter KPIs. Kollaborative, organisierte und hands-on Arbeitsweise mit der Fähigkeit, Erkenntnisse aus Projekten in standardisierte Komponenten und Rollout-Playbooks zu überführen. Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Warum SPREAD? Innovationsführer : Unsere Agentic‑Engineering‑Intelligence‑Plattform verknüpft Hardware‑ und Software‑Daten zu dynamischen Produkt Zwillingen – darauf agieren KI‑Agenten, die Compliance‑Checks, Abhängigkeitsanalysen und Spezifikationsaufbereitung automatisieren. Das Ergebnis: 10× schnellere Time‑to‑Market und 50% geringere Lifecycle‑Kosten bei OEMs wie VW, Mercedes‑Benz und Rheinmetall. ; Relevanz für die Industrie : Sobald Produkte software‑definiert sind, stößt klassisches PLM an ihre Grenzen. Mit SPREAD führst du Hersteller in die Daten‑ und KI‑Ära – und eröffnest ihnen Einsparungen in Millionenhöhe. H. per‑Wachstum & Ownership : Seit 2019 jedes Jahr zweistelliges Wachstum; Neue Branchen & Regionen bieten Gestaltungsspielraum und Potenzial. Starkes Gesamtpaket : Attraktives OTE, Mobilitätsbudget (Deutschlandticket), Urban‑Sports‑Partnerschaft, 30 Urlaubstage, Workation‑Optionen, Volunteering‑Day und 1.000 € Learning‑Budget. Sicherheit & Flexibilität : ISO 27001 / TISAX zertifiziert, DSGVO‑konform, Deployments in Cloud oder On‑Premises – und ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das sich deinem Leben anpasst. raw.jobDescription:
About Us

At TeamSnap, we believe when the world connects through sports; the world becomes better. TeamSnap is a sports and communication platform dedicated to taking the work out of play in youth sports. We also believe our jobs should excite us, our teammates should support us and our bosses should inspire us. We empower our people to bring big ideas and tiny egos, landing us on Outside Magazine’s list of “Best Places to Work" and Built In’s “100 Best Remote-First Places to Work."

TeamSnap is seeking a Senior Fullstack Engineer (BE-leaning) interested in working across the stack to join our fully distributed engineering team to help us continue our impressive growth from 2+ million daily active users to beyond! Our stack primarily includes Node.js, TypeScript, React.js and SQL.

As an engineering team, we design and build scalable systems using a service-oriented and event-driven architecture that serve millions of daily users and some of the largest youth and amateur sports organizations in the world. Our team values collaboration in a remote culture, so we regularly participate in pair sessions and virtual team swarms to stay connected and improve the team and company.

What You'll Do:

  • Develop engaging experiences for our millions of users across our mobile and web applications.

  • Design and implement scalable apps and services, integrating these into an evolving unified product and system architecture.

  • Brainstorm and evaluate new product features in collaboration with the product and UX team.

  • Collaborate and pair with other developers to develop solutions and teach technical skills.

  • Contribute to our development standards within the team and across engineering to ensure code quality, adherence to standards, and identify opportunities for improvement

  • Champion and implement automated testing practices to uphold the dependability and stability of backend systems, while also taking ownership of the overall reliability of the team's services.

  • Actively engage in on-call responsibilities and contribute to incident management efforts.

  • Evaluate and test new technologies to help TeamSnap move faster or serve our users more effectively.

  • Help teammates overcome obstacles, resolve blockers, and complete work tasks.

What Will Set You Up for Success:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience, leading large projects on high-scale, distributed software systems as a software engineer

  • Proficient in full stack development with Node, Python, Golang, Ruby, Javascript utilizing React or similar.

  • Experience with direct usage of SQL and relational databases such as MySQL / GCP Cloud SQL along with migrations, profiling, and optimization of such databases.

  • Hands-on experience developing APIs, services for mobile applications and web clients at scale.

  • Successfully delivered complex projects including debugging problems that may span a number of systems.

  • Experience working with and architecting APIs, event streams, webhooks, etc.

  • Experience working within and towards a distributed system.

  • Extra points if you’ve built services for livestreaming, advertising, or subscriptions.

Compensation

Additional Information

Got cold feet? If you’re thinking you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying. We’re all humans with special talents that go beyond what’s listed here.

Compensation

We’re committed to equitable compensation for all TeamSnappers. The minimum starting point for this role is $150,000, inclusive of base and bonus, with comp updated based on multiple factors. Our comp is highly competitive in our space and we adjust overall comp based on relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location.

Location

TeamSnap is a fully remote company, so you need to be very comfortable working with people who aren’t in the same time zone as you. We are always expanding, but there is a small list of states we do not hire in, including Alabama, Alaska, Delaware, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Rhode Island, South Dakota West Virginia and Utah and while we love all parts of the world, we can only hire permanent US residents at this time.

Opportunities to Grow

At TeamSnap, we work hard to provide a culture of trust, accountability, inclusivity, and boundless opportunities to grow, along with the chance to make a lasting impact and have some fun while doing it.

Total Rewards

• We're proud to be remote-first. We've been remote since 2009, long before COVID made it cool

• Unlimited PTO and paid parental leave for ALL parents (not just primary or secondary)

• 100% premium coverage of medical/dental/vision for you and your family

• 401K to help you invest for the future

• $1,500 annual learning and development stipend

• Travel to fun locations for all-company meetings and team events

• Generous home office allowance to set you up for success

• TeamSnap SWAG to our store upon starting and a $50 credit on every work anniversary thereafter

• A monthly stipend reimbursement for health & wellness and so much more!

• TeamSnap Total Rewards

Working at TeamSnap

At TeamSnap, you're not a culture fit, you're a culture add. Check out our Culture Playbook and learn how we succeed at being remote-first, what makes our company so unique, and how we're inspired by our people, our customers, and our values.

Inclusion and Diversity

Creativity and innovation can't thrive when we're cookie-cutter images of each other. We’re quickly growing more diverse, but there's always room for improvement. We are committed to inclusion and diversity at TeamSnap, and we hold ourselves accountable for building an environment where everyone feels valued. If you need any disability-related adaptation during the recruitment process, just let us know! We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

Benefits

  • Modernes Umfeld: Sie erwartet eine moderne Arbeitsumgebung, mit neuesten Gerätschaften

title: Principal Cloud Software Architect
description: Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production. Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first. We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien! The Mission We are seeking an exceptional Enterprise Architect to join our growing Cloud Native Applications team and lead delivery on Caylent's largest and most strategically important client engagements. The right candidate has deep expertise in designing and building applications, creating AI-first software solutions, and is energized by the scale, complexity, and stakes that come with our biggest accounts.. Your mission will be to work alongside and lead Caylent’s Software Engineers, Architects, Sales, and Project Managers to deliver for our largest and most complex customers. You’ll be hands-on with the latest technologies, operate confidently amid the ambiguity and competing priorities that large enterprise environments bring, and serve as a steady, senior presence — both for your team and in front of client leadership — when the stakes are highest. Your Assignment Lead software development project teams to deliver AI-first, production-ready solutions in environments with significant scale, technical complexity, and organizational complexity. Lead and own technical requirements gathering, technical decision making, backlog generation and refinement, and all architectural decisions - including where legacy systems, multiple integration points, or ambiguous requirements are in play. Lead discovery sessions with client stakeholders, including senior technical and business leadership to gather customer requirements and formulate them into a workable backlog. Build architecture diagrams to document, communicate, and defend your solution design to both engineering teams and client leadership. Apply your expertise in AI-first software development as a hands-on, contributing member of the technical team. Create, automate, and refine multiple levels of AI-driven testing. Coach and mentor teammates, provide guidance and assistance to software engineers and share practices for leading high-stakes engagements with peer Enterprise Architects and Engineering Managers. Serve as the senior point of escalation on your engagement - identifying delivery risk, technical roadblocks, or relationship friction early, and stepping in to protect both the client relationship and the team. Own status reporting and communication with client leadership on your engagement, including presenting progress, risk, and roadmap in steering committees or business reviews. Collaborate with project managers, peers, and leaders to navigate client, technical, and team challenges with strong conflict resolution and leadership particularly across large, multi-stakeholder client organizations. Support pre-sales efforts through scope development discussions, contract document review, and client presentations when needed with particular focus on large or complex deals. Your Qualifications Core Consulting Qualifications Customer Experience Expertise in confidently addressing complex client questions, including from senior client stakeholders, and identifying gaps in requirements with proposed next steps. Focus on delivering clear, actionable solutions that meet client goals Collaboration Facilitate alignment across a wide range of stakeholders, technical priorities, and deliverables, including in organizationally complex client environments. Navigate differing, and sometimes competing, perspectives with professionalism to ensure shared understanding and progress. Communication Break down and communicate complex technical concepts for technical and non-technical audiences, including senior client stakeholders, in a clear, concise manner. Adapt communication style based on audience and context to improve clarity and decision-making. Technical Qualifications 8+ years of proven experience in software development and cloud-native systems. Experience managing professional services engagements and cross-functional projects, including engagements involving multiple stakeholders, legacy systems, or significant integration complexity. Strong background in established engineering practices and scalable architectures. Experience with more than one backend language such as Python, Node.js, C#, or TypeScript; and familiarity with frontend frameworks such as React, Vue, MVC, or .NET. Broad expertise is a plus, but proficiency across every technology listed is not required. Learning and building with AI both for productivity and for enhancing client solutions. Deep experience and expertise building with AWS. Knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL). Experience in API integrations across applications, vendors, and cloud environments. Understanding of modern application architectures including event-based systems, queues, microservices. Demonstrated ability to build credibility and trust with senior client stakeholders. Desire to integrate innovative technologies into development workflow. Proven ability to lead a workstream and support others while contributing individually, even under the added scale and visibility of large enterprise engagements.. Preferred Qualifications Degree in a computing-related field Experience with: UX/UI, LLMs, AgentCore, GenAI, automated testing, CI/CD, IaC Experience with large-scale system modernization or legacy migration Experience navigating enterprise IT governance processes (e.g., change advisory boards, security reviews, procurement cycles) Benefits Pay in USD 100% remote work Generous holidays and flexible PTO Competitive phantom equity Paid for exams and certifications Peer bonus awards State of the art laptop and tools Equipment & Office Stipend Individual professional development plan Annual stipend for Learning and Development Work with an amazing worldwide team and in an incredible corporate culture This role may require up to 25% travel, depending on business needs. NOTE: This position requires current legal authorization to work in the country where this position is located. Caylent is not able to sponsor visa or work permit applications at this time. At Caylent, we are committed to fair, transparent, and inclusive hiring practices. As part of our recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools or automated systems to assist with the screening and evaluation of applications to help match candidate qualifications with job requirements. These tools are designed to support — not replace — human decision-making. Final hiring decisions are always made by our trained recruitment professionals. If an AI or automated tool is used during your application process, it will only be in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, and your information will be handled in a secure and confidential manner. If you have any questions, please contact talent@caylent.com Caylent is a place where everyone belongs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. So, regardless of how your diversity expresses itself, you can find a home here at Caylent. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you would like to request an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at hr@caylent.com.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform
description: About Juniper Square Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come. Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us! Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. About your role As a Senior Software Engineer at Juniper Square, you're a hands-on individual contributor who designs, builds, and operates production systems powering core workflows for institutional financial clients. You bring deep technical expertise to your team, drive complex projects independently, and collaborate closely with Staff engineers, product, design, and QA to ship reliable, well-designed systems. You'll join the Platform team, building the foundational infrastructure layer that powers all AI work at Juniper Square, both customer-facing (GPX) and internal automation. Every AI initiative at JSQ runs on top of this platform, spanning AI Gateway & Infrastructure, Governance & Security, Retrieval & Data Access, and Agent Framework. What you'll do Build & Operate Production Systems Design, build, and ship production-quality systems, APIs, and services - from foundational platform capabilities to customer-facing product experiences Own projects end-to-end: translating requirements into technical designs, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing iteration Build reliable, scalable, and observable systems that raw.jobDescription:
About Juniper Square

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

About your role

As a Senior Software Engineer at Juniper Square, you're a hands-on individual contributor who designs, builds, and operates production systems powering core workflows for institutional financial clients. You bring deep technical expertise to your team, drive complex projects independently, and collaborate closely with Staff engineers, product, design, and QA to ship reliable, well-designed systems.

You'll join the Platform team, building the foundational infrastructure layer that powers all AI work at Juniper Square, both customer-facing (GPX) and internal automation. Every AI initiative at JSQ runs on top of this platform, spanning AI Gateway & Infrastructure, Governance & Security, Retrieval & Data Access, and Agent Framework.

What you'll do

Build & Operate Production Systems

  • Design, build, and ship production-quality systems, APIs, and services - from foundational platform capabilities to customer-facing product experiences

  • Own projects end-to-end: translating requirements into technical designs, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing iteration

  • Build reliable, scalable, and observable systems that deliver value to customers and enable other engineering teams to move faster

  • Own the production health of the systems you build, including monitoring, troubleshooting, performance, reliability, and issue resolution

  • Build reusable infrastructure, frameworks, tooling, and developer experiences that enable teams across the organization

  • Improve engineering velocity and operational quality through automation, documentation, and continuous improvements

Drive Technical Excellence

  • Contribute to technical design for complex projects, evaluating tradeoffs and proposing pragmatic implementation plans

  • Partner with product, design, and engineering to translate requirements into well-designed technical solutions

  • Help identify and reduce technical debt, reliability risks, and friction in the software development lifecycle

  • Collaborate with Staff and senior engineers to establish reusable patterns and raise engineering standards

  • Participate in code reviews, design reviews, debugging, incident response, and operational support

AI Fluency & AI-Native SDLC

  • Use agentic coding tools and AI-assisted development as a primary part of your workflow, deliberately choosing where AI versus traditional software is the right tool

  • Critically evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, edge cases, and regressions, shipping quality output regardless of how it was produced

  • Build or integrate AI/LLM-powered capabilities in your domain where they add real value (e.g., evaluation frameworks, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows), with clear human-in-the-loop boundaries

  • Contribute to the team's evolving practices around AI-accelerated development, testing, and code review

Collaborate Cross-Functionally

  • Work closely with product, design, QA, and cross-functional partners to meet timelines and align solutions to business goals

  • Provide clear, accessible technical context to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Domain Expertise

  • Grow into a subject-matter expert with a deep understanding of the data, workflows, and customer needs specific to that space

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of experience in backend and/or full-stack software engineering

  • Strong backend engineering experience with Python and frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Pyramid, or Django

  • Experience with relational/NoSQL databases, including schema design, query optimization, and data modeling

  • Experience with cloud-native technologies such as AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD, observability, and operating services in production

  • Comfort working full-stack when the problem calls for it (TypeScript/React experience a plus)

  • Ability to break down complex technical problems and deliver pragmatic, maintainable solutions

  • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to drive projects independently while collaborating effectively across teams

  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to engineering and cross-functional partners

  • Hands-on experience with AI-native development tools (e.g., Cursor, Augment), and demonstrated AI Fluency: a deliberate point of view on when AI is (and isn't) the right tool, adapted code review practices for AI-generated code, and safeguards against over-reliance on AI tooling

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience

  • Hands-on experience building or integrating AI/LLM-powered systems in production (e.g., RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, evaluation workflows, guardrails, prompt/tool orchestration, or model observability)

  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-evolving technical territory where best practices and patterns are still being established

Nice to Have

  • Background in financial services or fintech

  • Experience with API gateway/infrastructure, security & governance tooling, retrieval and data-access systems, or agent frameworks at production scale

At Juniper Square, we believe building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture makes us a better company. If you think this role sounds like a fit, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification.

Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $175,000 - $220,000 and the Canadian base salary range for this role is $165,000 - $210,000 CAD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

Benefits include:

  • Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

  • Life insurance

  • Mental wellness coverage

  • Fertility and growing family support

  • Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

  • Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

  • Retirement saving plans

  • Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

  • Annual professional development stipend

Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.

raw.title: Senior Product Designer (m/f/d)
raw.description:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

UX is our number one priority. As a Series B scale-up, we are investing heavily in the product experience, and you will be central to it. You will own our biggest new product bets: new features, health insights and early vision work across the app. You will bring ideas to life fast, with polished high-fidelity prototypes and motion, then take them to a shipped result.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. Alongside you are a Lead Product Designer and a Lead UX Writer, who keep the whole product consistent and high quality.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

Core responsibilities

Ownership & Outcomes

  • Own your product areas from first idea to shipped result.
  • Set the measures for your work and own whether it succeeds.
  • Turn research, feedback and data into clear decisions.

Prototyping & Design

  • Spin up working prototypes with AI tools and our design system, not just static screens.

Collaboration & Continuity

  • Work daily with design engineers and product managers, and unblock them fast.
  • Take over existing product design work and keep quality high.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • Senior product design experience, ideally in health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
  • 1 to 3 shipped case studies that show the problem, your role, your decisions and the measurable impact.
  • Strong UX and UI craft: visual hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
  • High-fidelity prototypes you can screen-share and walk through (Figma, AI tools such as Claude or Lovable).
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools, and enthusiasm for trying new ones.
  • Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
  • Close work with engineers, and clear, short communication.
  • A public portfolio website (required with your application).

Nice to Have

  • AI-ready design systems, mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

How you work

  • AI first — You'd rather show a working thing than describe one.
  • Builder — You ship, starting from nothing if you have to.
  • Bias for action — You don't need to be told what to do or be chased. You spot what could go wrong, pick the one that matters most and fix it.
  • Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
  • Curious — You want to know why, not just what.
  • Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

This isn't for you if

  • You need a finished brief, all the requirements or all the research before you start.
  • You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
  • You'd rather list risks than own one.

How we hire

  1. Recruiter screen (30 min)
  2. Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min)
  3. Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
  4. Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
  5. Final conversation with senior leadership

What success looks like

  • You take something off our plate and it gets done.
  • If it won't happen, you tell us first.
  • You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
  • You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

UX is our number one priority, and we need a design leader who consistently turns design into business outcomes. As Lead Product Designer, you set the quality bar for our app, own our design system and drive our biggest product bets from first idea to shipped result. You are hands-on: you prototype, you craft, you ship.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. You will be the design partner who keeps the whole product consistent and high quality, together with our Lead UX Writer and a Senior Product Designer.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical, high-visibility role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

Core responsibilities

Direction & Outcomes

  • Set the design direction and quality bar across the app, from new features to health insights and early vision work.
  • Define the success measures for your work and own the business results.

Design System & Prototyping

  • Own our design system, built to work with AI tools, and keep it consistent through tokens and clear decisions.
  • Show instead of tell, with high-fidelity prototypes and motion built with AI tools and our design system.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Raise the bar for the team. Support, coach and unblock other designers, and give clear feedback.
  • Challenge product and engineering with evidence, persuade stakeholders and make clear, documented decisions.
  • Work daily with product managers and design engineers.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • Proven design leadership, with a track record of consistently delivering strong business outcomes.
  • 2 to 3 shipped case studies that demonstrate high impact: the problem, your hypothesis, your decisions, the measured result.
  • Outstanding visual design craft: hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
  • High-fidelity prototypes and videos of your work, ideally built with AI tools such as Claude or Lovable.
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools and experience with AI-ready design systems.
  • Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
  • Strong product thinking: you work with data, hypotheses and measurements.
  • Ideally health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
  • A public portfolio website (required with your application).

Nice to Have

  • Mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

How you work

  • AI first — You are already playing with AI tools and you are excited about what they make possible.
  • Builder — You ship, and you can spin up something from nothing.
  • Bias for action — You are autonomous and self-sufficient. You don't wait for a brief and you don't need chasing.
  • Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
  • Curious — You want to know why, not just what. You can explain who made each decision and how.
  • Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

This isn't for you if

  • You need all requirements, research and data before you start.
  • You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
  • You'd rather list risks than own one.

How we hire

  1. Recruiter screen (30 min)
  2. Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min): visual craft, prototyping, AI fluency
  3. Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
  4. Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
  5. Final conversation with senior leadership (finalists)

What success looks like

  • You take something off our plate and it gets done.
  • If it won't happen, you tell us first.
  • You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
  • You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.
  • The product feels consistent, fast and high quality, and design outcomes show up in the numbers.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

Experience using artificial intelligence coding agents and reviewing their output, or an interest in building these skills in a complex monorepo.   • Collaborate across functions and teams, both asynchronously and synchronously, and involve domain experts when their input will improve the outcome.
  • Use artificial intelligence agents for well-scoped work when they can speed up delivery without sacrificing quality, and critically review their output.
  • Write maintainable code that follows GitLab's standards and contribute to constructive code reviews.

What you'll bring

title: Director, Engineering - Care
description: Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals . About the Role: Hims & Hers is on a mission to empower people to live healthier lives. The Care engineering team builds provider- and support-agent-facing web applications and the backend platforms behind our integrated Care Platform and pharmacy operations. You'll help build the next generation of tools for a modern, patient-centric model of healthcare. As Director of Engineering for Care, you'll own engineering strategy and delivery for the clinician and patient experience, from intake and consultation through prescription. You'll lead the team building clinical systems where speed has to coexist with patient safety, regulatory compliance, and auditability. You'll partner with product, design, data, clinical, pharmacy, and operations leaders, set the multi-year technical and organizational strategy, and develop the engineering leaders who will carry it forward. You Will: Own technical vision, architecture, and delivery for Care, including intake, consultation, clinician workflows, prescribing, care-team and support tooling, and the handoff to pharmacy. Define and deliver the engineering roadmap with product and design, balancing innovation, reliability, scalability, and quality. Lead the shift to a durable domain model with clear boundaries and enforced contracts, moving teams off direct cross-domain database access and toward APIs and published events. Ensure the platform meets requirements for patient safety, clinical guardrails, security, privacy (HIPAA), and state and federal regulation, including controlled-substance prescribing. Set and hold reliability standards (SLOs, incident response) for patient-critical flows. Lead the transition to an AI-first engineering culture, with AI-assisted development, review, and spec-driven workflows backed by measurable goals. Build and mentor engineering managers and technical leaders, with a focus on succession planning and a strong technical bench. Own staffing and organizational strategy, including hiring, headcount planning, and team structure as the domain evolves. Drive alignment across teams and partners, managing trade-offs between speed, technical debt, and innovation. Represent engineering in executive forums, translating strategy, status, and risk for senior stakeholders. You Have: 12+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years managing managers or multiple teams in high-growth environments. A track record building and operating systems that handle clinical or other regulated health data, with working knowledge of HIPAA and compliance-driven design. Experience owning end-to-end user experiences with cross-functional product engineering teams. Strong grounding in modern service architectures (Spring Boot, Kotlin, PostgreSQL) and the judgment to guide design decisions in depth. Experience integrating third-party health and pharmacy systems, such as labs, e-prescribing networks, and pharmacy platforms. Ability to define and execute technical roadmaps tied to product vision and business outcomes. Strong communication skills and executive presence, translating between technical, clinical, and business stakeholders. A demonstrated ability to recruit, develop, and retain high-performing engineering talent. Comfort making risk trade-offs where patient safety and speed conflict. Preferred: experience in telehealth, digital health, or other regulated clinical environments. Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights): Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) 401k benefits with employer matching contribution Offsite team retreats We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match. Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. Hims & Hers is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@forhims.com and describe the needed accommodation. Your privacy is important to us, and any information you share will only be used for the legitimate purpose of considering your request for accommodation. Hims & Hers gives consideration to all qualified applicants without regard to any protected status, including disability. Please do not send resumes to this email address. title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
SingleStore is looking for an accomplished sales professional to join our Sales Team. AI is moving from experimentation into production, and this role is an opportunity to break into AI while doing meaningful enterprise selling.

As an Account Executive, AI Hunter, your job is simple: create new SingleStore customers. You will find companies building AI applications where data access, real-time context, memory, retrieval, or operational scale is becoming a constraint—and turn those challenges into new SingleStore customers. You will own a broad territory, build a majority self-sourced pipeline, create demand in an emerging category, and close greenfield enterprise opportunities.

This is a true hunting role. You will engage customers before they have a defined project, develop customer-specific points of view, create urgency around business and technical problems, work with technical experts to land first production workloads, and build a measurable new-logo business with broad ownership. The ideal candidate is a measurable enterprise hunter who is competitive, curious, technically credible, resilient, and able to sell business outcomes. Direct AI sales experience is valuable, but proven selling ability and technical curiosity matter more than a narrow “AI seller” title.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Build and execute a territory strategy for net-new customer acquisition.
  • Prospect fearlessly across a broad account universe using proactive, persistent outbound, account-based, partner, and market-education motions; stay resilient and effective through rejection and ambiguity.
  • Form account hypotheses, map the buying center, and earn first meetings with relevant points of view tailored to the customer.
  • Engage executive, business, technical, security, and procurement stakeholders.
  • Lead great business-first discovery, connect AI and data challenges to fundable goals, and build quantified ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.
  • Build and develop champions, multi-thread the buying group, earn executive and economic-buyer access, and maintain stakeholder alignment; own the stakeholder plan, mutual action plan, close plan, value case, stage gates, forecast, and commercial outcome.
  • Lead complex sales cycles through technical validation, security, legal, procurement, negotiation, and close.
  • Partner with Solutions and Forward Deployment Engineers and cross-functional teams to validate technical fit and establish the first production workload.
  • Navigate competitive displacement and maintain disciplined activity management, CRM hygiene, reporting, qualification, forecasting, and opportunity management; showcase clear metrics such as pipeline created, meetings, conversion, quota attainment, and new-logo performance.
  • Be AI fluent: use AI and research tools productively and responsibly while applying judgment, validating outputs, and separating facts from hypotheses.
  • Travel within the assigned territory as required. 

Required Skills and Experience

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying B2B enterprise software sales experience, ideally selling to large or technically sophisticated organizations; experience in data, cloud, analytics, AI, or adjacent technical domains is a plus.
  • Repeated, quantified quota success with clear ownership of new-logo wins and self-sourced pipeline.
  • Experience closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving executives, technical evaluators, security, legal, finance, procurement, and partners.
  • Ability to sell measurable business outcomes and build ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.
  • Technical fluency in an adjacent domain such as databases, data infrastructure, analytics, AI/ML, cloud, Kubernetes, developer tools, cybersecurity, observability, or open-source software.
  • Strong qualification, account planning, forecasting, CRM, negotiation, and deal-management skills.
  • Learning velocity and coachability, demonstrated through specific behavior change after feedback; ability to explain technical concepts clearly to technical and executive audiences.
  • Executive presence, customer trust, resilience, intellectual honesty, and excellent communication skills.
  • B.A., B.S. degree or equivalent in a related field.
  • Experience with Fortune 500 or security-sensitive organizations, cloud ecosystems, open-source or consumption-based products, or emerging categories is preferred.
