title: Software QA Engineer II
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

Axon’s RF sensors detect and locate drones so public safety and critical infrastructure teams can protect airspace. You will own the test strategy and independent verification approach for RF sensor capabilities — spanning regression, integration, and real-world validation — so those systems are trustworthy in the lab and in the field. You will work closely with RF Engineering at the intersection of software, hardware, and real-world RF, helping turn technical evidence into confident product decisions.

Work Location: This role is based out of our Kassel, Germany office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the test strategy and independent verification approach for RF sensor software from design through release, adding rigor through regression, integration, and real-world validation.
  • Design and own test strategies spanning feature, regression, integration / interface, system, and field validation. Combine automated coverage with targeted manual validation based on risk and technical feasibility.
  • Develop in-depth functional tests for individual components of the RF sensor software, and keep those tests maintainable as the product evolves.
  • Reproduce, isolate, and characterize issues on real sensor hardware and in test environments; capture clear reproduction steps, logs, and environment details.
  • Build and maintain hardware-backed automated regression tests and supporting test tooling.
  • Monitor and improve development and test systems and test hardware so environments stay stable, observable, and ready for daily use.
  • Partner closely with RF Engineering and independently verify behavior in realistic environments and across system interfaces. Execute system, release, field, and acceptance testing with release stakeholders.
  • Document test results and defects clearly, and contribute to software design reviews and after-action reviews for the work you own.
  • Share knowledge with the wider team, give actionable feedback, and support newer engineers and interns through pairing, reviews, and onboarding.
  • Use approved agentic AI tools regularly to design tests, analyze results, and draft documentation and review AI output against quality, security, and performance standards before you rely on it.

 

What You Bring

  • A degree or vocational qualification in electrical engineering, computer science, embedded systems, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience testing software that runs on or with hardware (embedded products, devices, sensors, or similar systems), including independently owning the test and quality approach for that work.
  • Experience with RF, embedded, sensor, or similarly hardware-integrated systems, with the technical aptitude and curiosity to develop deep expertise in RF sensor technologies.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated tests or test tooling, ideally in Python pytest, with the ability to independently support hardware-backed regression testing.
  • Comfort working in Linux-based systems (SSH, Networking).
  • A collaborative, quality-focused working style: you Join Forces with others, Own It on the quality of the work you take on, and speak up with candor when something is unclear or broken.

raw.title: Deployment Strategist, Public Sector (EMEA)
raw.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As an EMEA Public Sector Deployment Strategist, you will own the post-sale experience for a portfolio of public sector customers across the region, including law enforcement agencies, regulators, and government teams working some of the most complex cases in crypto-related crime. You will own onboarding, adoption, outcomes and the relationship across all TRM products, including Ardence, our newest and fastest-moving product. Your mandate is not just to manage accounts. You will define what success looks like for each customer, prove it with usage and outcomes, and enable the renewals and expansion that follow alongside our Account Directors.

The impact you will have:

  • Onboard and activate your EMEA Public Sector accounts across all TRM products, with a clear onboarding path and measurable hands-on-keyboard usage for every account in your portfolio

  • Use AI to build production CS workflows that pull from ChurnZero, Salesforce, Gong, and product usage telemetry to auto-generate account health summaries and QBR drafts — compressing hours of reporting prep into minutes so you can spend your time on the work that actually requires human judgment

  • Define and track adoption benchmarks across the portfolio — hands-on-keyboard usage, consumption rates, and account-specific success metrics — and surface at-risk accounts before renewal decisions are made

  • Develop new use cases with investigators and analysts that deepen usage across TRM products, including Ardence, and feed what you learn back into onboarding and enablement for the wider team

  • Run executive business reviews and QBRs with senior stakeholders at public sector agencies and regulators across EMEA — building the trust and credibility that turns TRM from a vendor into a mission-critical partner

  • Partner with ADs, who own the commercial motion, to enable renewals and expansion: bring account health, adoption evidence, and a structured path to proving value for every customer with an expiring or at-risk contract, and take accountability for the GRR and NRR outcomes that adoption drives

  • Close the feedback loop between customers and Product — synthesize adoption blockers, feature gaps, and new use case opportunities into prioritized, actionable input that informs the roadmap

  • Work as one team with EMEA colleagues across languages and time zones, sharing the playbooks, workflows, and account plans that work so coverage is consistent across the region

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years in customer success, deployment, or post-sale roles with proven accountability for GRR, NRR, and adoption outcomes — you have the track record, not just the title

  • Domain credibility in law enforcement, public sector, cyber, national security, financial crime, or blockchain intelligence — you can walk into a room of investigators and earn their trust in the first meeting, not the fifth

  • Comfort with ambiguity — you have worked in fast-changing product environments, can ship a working v1 without waiting for a perfect playbook, and can point to the specific outcomes it drove; Ardence is still evolving and your accounts may shift as it matures

  • Production AI fluency — you have built real, repeatable AI workflows (not just experiments) that synthesize data from multiple sources into outputs that run consistently and have measurable results; you can show the workflow, explain the data logic, and articulate where human judgment stays in the loop

  • High level of independence — you set your own agenda, operate without needing constant direction, and ship v1 before you have all the answers

  • Strong executive presence — you can run a QBR with a senior government or public sector stakeholder and command the room through substance, not just polish

  • Based in the UK or Europe and comfortable working with customers across EMEA; additional European languages are a plus

About the Team:

  • The EMEA Public Sector team supports law enforcement, government, and regulatory customers working on complex cases involving crypto-related financial crime, cyber threats, and national security risks

  • You will join the EMEA Deployment Strategy team, which covers the region by geography and language (DACH and Eastern Europe, the UK, and SPLATAM), alongside Customer Experience. This is a net-new seat that adds coverage across our accounts, with high autonomy and meaningful influence on how we serve the region

  • The broader TRM CS organization operates distributed, not distant — async-first communication through Slack, strong documentation, and intentional synchronous time for key decisions

  • You will work directly with the Head of EMEA Deployment Strategy and the Head of Customer Success, with close day-to-day collaboration with the AD team and Product

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • As a globally distributed team, members may observe different timezones. However, most of the team will overlap between the hours of 7am-5:00 pm PST for meetings and collaboration.

  • Our Customer success Team is fully remote, thriving on asynchronous communication and collaboration through Slack channels and detailed documentation. We hold weekly Customer Syncs, bi-weekly health syncs, join our associated POD calls, and regularly engage with our customers. As experts in our craft, we focus on providing support, driving value, and building meaningful relationships with our customers as trusted advisors. We are on the front lines of TRM, ensuring our customers get the most out of the product and bringing valuable insights back to the team.

  • Moves fast and iterates — v1 ships before it is perfect, and feedback is expected to be direct and specific

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Ownership: While there is no formal hourly rotation, you will be the primary lead for your area and responsible for customer success. This requires a high degree of agency and a commitment to seeing mission-critical tasks through to resolution, including the flexibility to handle urgent needs outside of standard hours or on weekends when they arise.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within 30 days of joining, you have met every account in your portfolio and shipped a working onboarding and adoption plan for your first 2–3 accounts — not a slide deck, but a live document with measurable adoption benchmarks that the account team is already using to set customer expectations

  • Within 6 weeks, you share a draft success metrics framework at 50% complete with the account team and key customers to validate direction — getting real signal on what drives credit consumption before investing further in building out the full playbook

  • Within 60 days, you identify the highest-impact use case or adoption play for your portfolio — presenting a concrete recommendation to leadership on what to prioritize and why, grounded in actual account data

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

title: Staff AppSec / Product Security Engineer
description: 🌀 The Company Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action. Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action. At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative. As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future. 🎯 The Role We're looking for a Staff AppSec / Product Security Engineer to join our Digital Security team, and make security a built-in quality of everything we ship across the XTM platform (OpenCTI, OpenAEV, XTM One, XTM Hub). You'll work closely with the R&D team: the VP, Staff and Principal Engineers, Engineering Managers, Product Owners and the Product Manager. You'll help keep our open source and enterprise products trustworthy for the 6,000+ organizations that defend themselves with them. This is not a solo audit role. As a Staff engineer, you advise the CISO on product security and turn their strategy into day-to-day practice in the product teams. You lead security as a cross-cutting concern, and coach engineers so they own security in their own scope. And of course, you still code: critical security fixes, PR reviews, pair programming and the shared security components that make the secure path the easy one. 💼 Your Responsibilities Leverage AI tools and methodologies to boost productivity and impact Contribute to building AI capabilities into internal workflows Advise the CISO on product security strategy across the XTM platform, and lead its operational implementation in the product teams: turn priorities into concrete actions, and track security technical pains to resolution. Lead threat modeling and security reviews in feature refinements with Product Owners: authentication and RBAC, multi-tenancy, connectors, the GraphQL API, and AI and agent features. Ensure the security quality of the stack through critical PRs, fixes and code reviews, and build shared, secure-by-default components (authorization, secrets, safe outbound calls, input handling). Drive secure SDLC and supply chain tooling in CI (SAST, SCA, secret and container scanning, Renovate, Snyk, SBOMs, signed releases), tuned so teams trust the results. Run product vulnerability management: intake from the open source community, researchers and bug bounty, coordinated disclosure, CVEs and advisories, remediation SLAs, and the product side of security incidents. Mentor engineers and grow security champions through pairing, workshops and continuous feedback. Document security architecture decisions so they stay consistent across teams. 🤝 Who You’ll Work With Reports to: the CISO, as part of the Digital Security team. Key collaborators: the R&D team, including Staff and Principal Engineers and Engineering Managers across the product teams, and Product Owners during refinements, Platform Engineering on infrastructure, compliance (SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001:2022, FedRamp) and incidents, and Customer Success on customer security questions and pentest findings. Community: the OpenCTI and OpenAEV open source contributors and the security researchers who report vulnerabilities to us. Mentorship: no direct reports. You'll act as the security technical reference and mentor for engineers across all teams, and grow a network of security champions. 🧬 Profile We’re Looking For Strong interest in AI and its applications in cybersecurity Comfortable working with and leveraging AI-powered tools (LLMs, automation, copilots, etc.) to improve workflows and productivity Master degreee in computer science and or cybersecurity with 8+ years of experience in software engineering and application or product security, including at least 3 years as the security technical reference for a SaaS or enterprise product Comfortable working in a remote, async-first environment Strong engineering and security skills: you write production code fluently in at least two of Python, Node.js, TypeScript, Java or Rust, and you know web and API security in depth (GraphQL, OIDC/SAML, RBAC, multi-tenant isolation, SSRF, injection), CI/CD security tooling, and container and Kubernetes security A track record of influence without authority: you led a cross-team security initiative, coached engineers, and got standards adopted with pragmatism and clear priorities Autonomy, ownership, and team spirit Bonus: AI and LLM security (prompt injection, agent permissions), open source contributions or published CVEs, bug bounty program experience, knowledge of STIX 2.1 / MITRE ATT&CK or hands-on use of OpenCTI or OpenAEV 🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job. We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company , and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation . You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem. ⭐ Be part of something bigger We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative. 💻 Work at the edge of what’s next We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice. 🌍 Global opportunity without borders Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us. 🧭 A culture grounded in CORE Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching. 💰 What you can expect Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen 🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture. At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status. What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify. 🚀 Ready to Join Us? Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

raw.jobDescription:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey.

  • We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
  • We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
  • We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

We want you to join us full-time as a Staff Backend Engineer. You will work remotely first (from Central & Eastern Europe), but we are more than happy to meet you in our nice offices in Bratislava, Brno or Prague. The Pulsar team builds platform and admin services that all Bloomreach SaaS products rely on. In your first year, you’ll develop features used by thousands of customers and deliver fast, consistent, and high-energy (but low-drama) product releases. We all work remotely from the US, India, and Europe.

Examples of our services:

  • Central services to publish Model Context Protocol APIs for external AI agents
  • Multi-product customer provisioning and licensing orchestration
  • Integrated user management, authentication, and authorization
  • High-availability, centralized configuration management
  • Tools for new customer integration & product tuning

Why you’ll love your work

  • Technical Variety: Cloud-native services with diverse tech stacks offer learning and experimentation.
  • Impact: Our services are used by customers and teams across the company – engineers, product managers, services consultants, and even executives.
  • Autonomy: Senior engineers design, build, and deploy complete projects and are experts in our services.
  • Teamwork: Your teammates are also high performers and will support you with learning our systems, brainstorming & design review, and running high-reliability production deployments.

Your typical day

Your day begins with review of a teammate’s GitLab merge request. It has already been reviewed by Claude, but you’ll think deeply about the business problem, alternative solutions, and future needs.

Then you spend a few undisturbed hours “in the flow,” working on a technical design doc for a new project. Once you’ve completed a draft, you send it to another teammate for feedback, then decide to jump on a Zoom call to talk it over and refine it.

After lunch, you join the team for a quick standup via Zoom to discuss current work and the plan for the next few days. You mention that you’re finishing up a small improvement to improve the logging and alerting for one of our components that requires high uptime. A teammate offers to review your changes. It has some complex behavior, so you walk through it together and make a few improvements.

Soon, the new unit tests are green. With a few keystrokes, you create a merge request, spin up a dev instance, and deploy your change. After some quick smoke tests, you and your teammate decide to merge the change. Your improvement will be deployed in production with the release in a few days.

Next, you respond to a Slack request for advice on integrating with the authorization API. You draft a short tech design doc that links the API spec, code examples, and optimization tips. You discuss it on the team channel, and your manager forwards it to another team that’s also starting a new service.

Your day ends with a chat with a product manager about questions that came up while drafting the tech design. With their feedback, you refine the proposal to deliver the core feature more quickly, while the product manager will work with customers and decide how much more to invest. Tomorrow, you’ll break down the tasks in Jira and decide what you’ll complete yourself and what you’ll ask teammates to complete….

Our tech stack(s)

  • Languages & Frameworks: Python, Java / Spring, Go – occasionally TypeScript, Angular, React
  • Data: Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka
  • Cloud: AWS & GCP (RDS, Redshift, Pub/Sub, BigTable, DataFlow, etc), Docker & Kubernetes (via EKS & GKE)
  • Tools: Jira, Gitlab CI/CD, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenSearch

Our expectations

  • Flexible intelligence: Stretch your technical skills in a distributed cloud environment, making changes across systems built with various tech stacks to meet challenging requirements.
  • Drive: Rapidly ship product improvements that affect thousands of users in a low-drama and high-trust way.
  • Security & Reliability: Balance risks and benefits of change with discipline and agility.
  • Communication: Organize technical work and maintain trust/respect across multiple teams, geographic regions, and departments.
  • Knowledge Sharing: Proactively share expertise, guide less experienced team members, and document work for long-term sustainability.

The ideal candidate’s experience

  • Active user of AI coding tools such as Cursor and Claude Code
  • Developed backend services with Python using a variety of data systems (5+ years)
  • Understands web security principles (OWASP), Authentication, and Authorization practices
  • Designed APIs for a SaaS product
  • Operated services in production on public cloud infrastructure
  • Some experience with Java / Spring or Go
  • Exposure to web frontend development (Angular / React)

#LI-KP1

The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above.

Base Salary Range

1 520 000 Kč—1 900 000 Kč CZK

More things you'll like about Bloomreach:

Culture:

  • A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one.

  • We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication.

  • We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.

  • We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents.

  • We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead.

  • We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*.

  • The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5

Personal Development:

  • We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions.

  • Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.*

  • Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins.

  • Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)*

Well-being:

  • The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.*

  • Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.*

  • We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones.

  • We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other.

  • Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.*

Compensation:

  • Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.*

  • Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.*

  • We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000!

  • We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!*

(*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.)

Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences!

If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful!

As a Clinical Database Programmer (internally referred to as Database Programmer), you will support the development, testing and maintenance of Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems used in clinical trials.

Working within a collaborative and innovative technical team, you will be involved in building clinical studies, developing electronic Case Report Forms (eCRFs), configuring edit checks and supporting data integrations, primarily using Medidata Rave.

You will also have opportunities to contribute to new initiatives, explore AI-driven solutions and support continuous improvements in study development and operational efficiency.

  • Collaborate with Data Management, project teams and sponsors to ensure successful study delivery.

  • Contribute to process improvements, automation and innovative solutions, including the use of AI.

  • Support multiple clinical studies and progressively take ownership of study builds.

  • Degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

  • Previous experience in clinical database development, EDC programming or clinical study builds.

  • Previous experience within a CRO or pharmaceutical environment.

  • Knowledge of eCRFs, edit checks, database testing and clinical data management processes.

  • Understanding of programming principles, logic and database development.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills.

  • Experience supporting EDC integrations, technical initiatives or bid defence activities.

  • Proactive team player with excellent communication skills and a continuous improvement mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Medidata Rave, including study builds and configuration.

  • Knowledge of C# programming and development of custom functions within Medidata Rave.

  • Experience with AI tools, automation or AI-assisted programming to improve study development and efficiency.

  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)

  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting

In the afternoon, you review a prototype from Alice, PM of the Learner Experience Squad, for a new upgrade flow that moves AI for HR Academy users to a Team Access license. In the afternoon, you join the Learner Experience Squad's refinement to get feedback on the technical feasibility of a new bootcamp design. Based on what you hear, you set up a follow-up with the engineers, including Aliia, Front-End Engineer, to dig into the details.

  • The opportunity to shape your own day-to-day work;

title: Medior / Senior Data Analyst
description: SQL in BigQuery? Gesneden koek. Een dashboard in Looker Studio? Staat er zo. Maar jij wil meer. Je wil weten welk verhaal er achter de cijfers zit, en je vertelt dat verhaal net zo graag. Met een advies waar klanten en collega’s echt iets mee kunnen. AI zet je daarbij vanzelfsprekend in, om sneller en slimmer tot de kern te komen. Wij zijn Follo: een snelgroeiend, award-winning digital agency (ontstaan uit de fusie van vier topbureaus) waar data de basis is onder alles wat we doen. Als Medior Data Analist werk je zelfstandig voor een eigen set klanten en projecten, samen met onze Data & Analytics Consultants en de specialisten in Search en Social. Je levert niet alleen de cijfers, je vertelt ook wat ze betekenen en wat er moet gebeuren. Wat je gaat doen Je analyseert data uit onder andere GA4, advertentieplatformen en CRM- en e-commercesystemen en ontdekt zo trends, kansen en knelpunten. Je zet AI actief in om sneller patronen te herkennen, hypotheses te toetsen, SQL te schrijven en grote datasets te doorgronden, zonder je kritische blik op de uitkomsten te verliezen. Je presenteert je bevindingen aan klanten en collega’s en vertaalt ze naar heldere, commerciële aanbevelingen. Je komt zelf met verbetervoorstellen voor marketing, meetopzet en businessprocessen, en kijkt verder dan de vraag. Je schrijft SQL in BigQuery en bouwt aan schone, herbruikbare datamodellen (bijvoorbeeld in Dataform), zodat databronnen goed gekoppeld zijn en iedereen met dezelfde definities werkt. Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt overzichtelijke dashboards en rapportages in onder andere Looker Studio, en bepaalt mee welke KPI’s er echt toe doen en hoe je die het best visualiseert. Je bewaakt de betrouwbaarheid van data, signaleert afwijkingen en spoort de oorzaak op, of die nu in de tracking, de koppeling of het model zit. Je maakt terugkerend werk slimmer met automatisering en AI, en deelt je kennis met het team. Wat je van ons mag verwachten Een salaris tussen de €3.250 en €5.000, afhankelijk van je ervaring. Een ambitieus team waarin verantwoordelijkheid en samenwerken voorop staan. 26 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de mogelijkheid om er 5 bij te kopen. Een eenmalig thuiswerkbudget tot €1.000 om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten. Een goed geregeld pensioen, zonder eigen bijdrage. De vrijheid om hybride te werken, zodat jij het best tot je recht komt. Interne kennissessies, events en brainstorms, van AI en automatisering tot data deep-dives. Dit ben jij Je bent een analist met oog voor detail die het grotere plaatje blijft zien. Je werkt gestructureerd, bent nieuwsgierig en vindt het leuk om complexe data begrijpelijk te maken voor anderen. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende: Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring als data analist of in een vergelijkbare rol. Je bent communicatief sterk: je legt een analyse net zo makkelijk uit aan een marketing manager als aan een developer, en je durft met een onderbouwd advies te komen. Je beheerst SQL goed; ervaring met BigQuery is een grote pré. Je hebt ruime ervaring met dashboarding in Looker Studio, Power BI of een vergelijkbare tool. Je kent GA4 en begrijpt hoe online marketingdata tot stand komt. Ervaring met Google Tag Manager is een pré. Je gebruikt AI al in je dagelijkse analysewerk, of hebt de sterke ambitie om dat te doen. Kennis van Python of ervaring met Dataform of dbt is mooi meegenomen. Waarom Follo? Bij Follo is data geen bijproduct van marketing, maar het fundament eronder. Van Search en Social tot Marketplaces en CRO: elke strategie begint bij betrouwbare data en scherpe inzichten. AI is bij ons geen buzzword, maar onderdeel van hoe we dagelijks werken. Minder handwerk, meer tijd voor analyse, advies en impact. Data als fundament: met de FolloEngine, ons eigen platform voor data intelligence, datakwaliteit en automatisering, start je met een voorsprong. AI in je dagelijkse werk: je werkt met de nieuwste tools en technieken, van AI-gedreven analyse tot geautomatiseerde workflows. Sterke merken, echte vraagstukken: jouw analyses sturen de beslissingen van ambitieuze adverteerders. Werken aan internationale, award-waardige cases in een bureau met Europese ambities. title: Meeloopstage Cash Control/ Finance
description: Wil jij ontdekken hoe de financiële motor achter een internationale logistiek dienstverlener draait? Ben je nauwkeurig, analytisch en krijg je energie van cijfers die kloppen? Dan is deze meeloopstage iets voor jou! Voor ons Cash Control team in Rotterdam zoeken we een stagiair(e) die meedraait in het dagelijkse cashmanagement. Je helpt bij het tijdig toewijzen van betalingen, het verwerken van bankafschriften en het bewaken van openstaande posten. Je werkt nauw samen met Credit Control, Invoicing en Accounts Payable en doet zo praktijkervaring op met cash application, reconciliaties en werken in ERP-systeem Exact. Waar ga je werken? Royal Den Hartogh Logistics is een internationale, toonaangevende logistiek dienstverlener voor de chemische, gas-, polymeer- en voedingsmiddelenindustrie. Ons familiebedrijf bestaat al sinds 1920 en heeft veiligheid en duurzaamheid stevig in het DNA verankerd. Met 54 locaties in 27 landen en ruim 2.600 collega's wereldwijd werken we continu aan slimme, toekomstbestendige logistieke oplossingen. Ons finance team in Nederland telt 20 collega's, verdeeld over onder andere Credit Control, Invoicing, Accounts Payable en Cash Control – en daar kom jij als stagiair(e) terecht. Wat ga je doen? Je bewaakt de dagelijkse Unallocated Cash : je houdt het overzicht bij, volgt openstaande posten op en rapporteert de belangrijkste KPI's. Je zoekt niet-herkende ontvangsten en niet-gematchte betalingen uit en helpt ze oplossen. Je boekt en verwerkt dagelijks bankafschriften in Exact, voor meerdere bankrekeningen en entiteiten (inkomend en uitgaand). Je matcht klantontvangsten en leveranciersbetalingen aan de juiste facturen. Je helpt bij bankreconciliaties en spoort verschillen op tussen bankafschriften en de administratie. Je denkt mee over verbeteringen om het toewijzen en afletteren efficiënter te maken. De ideale kandidaat Je volgt een mbo4- of hbo-opleiding in een financiële richting, zoals Finance & Control, Bedrijfsadministratie, Bedrijfseconomie of Accountancy. title: Senior R&D Engineer Trainingssystemen (m/v/x)
description: Ben jij een ervaren bèta-academische professional die klaar is voor een nieuwe uitdaging? Wil je bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van 's werelds meest innovatieve simulatie- en trainingssystemen binnen de militaire (en civiele) luchtvaartwereld? Wil jij je technische kennis en ervaring inzetten voor het initiëren en realiseren van complexe, multidisciplinaire projecten in een high-tech omgeving? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Wat ga je doen? Als senior R&D Engineer Trainingssystemen richt je je op het initiëren en realiseren van innovatieve, multidisciplinaire ontwikkelingen en het opzetten, uitvoeren en managen van grote, complexe projecten. Een belangrijk onderdeel van deze functie is het optreden als Subject Matter Expert (SME) in je vakgebied, waarbij je je kennis en expertise deelt met collega's, klanten adviseert en bijdraagt aan de ontwikkeling van innovatieve oplossingen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het leiden van projectteams, het adviseren van klanten en het opbouwen en onderhouden van een extern nationaal en internationaal relatienetwerk. Je takenpakket omvat onder andere: Het initiëren en realiseren van innovatieve, multidisciplinaire ontwikkelingen, waaronder het genereren van ideeën voor nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en het realiseren van samenwerking met andere disciplines; Het opzetten, uitvoeren en managen van grote, complexe projecten, waaronder het uitwerken van projectplannen, het inventariseren en analyseren van projectrisico's en het adviseren van klanten over alternatieven; Het leiden van projectteams, waaronder het geven van leiding aan projectmedewerkers, het bewaken van de voortgang en resultaten van de projecten en het zorgen voor de kwaliteit van de uitvoering; Het opbouwen en onderhouden van een extern nationaal en internationaal relatienetwerk, waaronder het initiëren en onderhouden van samenwerkingsverbanden, het creëren van mogelijkheden en het uitbrengen van proposals; Het adviseren van klanten, waaronder het opbouwen van een zodanige relatie met de klant dat de klant kan worden ondersteund bij een verscheidenheid aan vraagstukken en het geven van advies over alternatieven; Het bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van afdelingsbeleid, waaronder het realiseren van innovatieve, multidisciplinaire ontwikkelingen en het adviseren van afdelingsmanagement en businessmanager. Je werkt samen met collega's uit andere teams aan diverse soorten projecten die hoogwaardige technologische simulatie- en trainingsoplossingen leveren aan eindgebruikers in de luchtvaartoperatie. Je hebt frequent contact en interactieve werksessies met hen om tot grensverleggende totaaloplossingen te kunnen komen. Jouw enthousiasme en de wil om je te verdiepen in de operationele wereld van deze gebruikers is daarbij een must. Dat doe je niet enkel vanaf je bureau maar ook bij de operationele gebruikers op locatie, en regelmatig samen met industrie en kennispartners wereldwijd! Wat breng je mee? Een afgeronde WO-opleiding in Informatica, Lucht- en Ruimtevaarttechniek, Technische Natuurkunde, Werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbare studierichting; Ruime (>10 jaar) werkervaring in een technische of wetenschappelijke discipline, met een focus op simulatie, training of een verwant gebied, zoals luchtvaart, ruimtevaart, defensie of andere industrieën waarin complexe systemen en processen worden gesimuleerd. Sterke affiniteit en ervaring in het militaire domein is een pre; Affiniteit met innovatieve M&S technologie, zoals real-time simulatie technologie, AR/VR/MR, IoT, data- en softwarearchitecturen en netwerken; Interesse of ervaring in het verbinden van systemen en het waarborgen van interoperabiliteit, bijvoorbeeld door het werken met netwerkprotocollen of architecturen; Kennis van softwareontwikkeling (zowel de implementatie als procesmatig); Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, in de Nederlandse en Engelse taal; Ervaring met projectmanagement, leidinggeven aan projectteams en het schrijven van proposals. Wat bieden wij jou? Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten. Naast dit alles bieden wij jou: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5400 en €7100 (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) , afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring; 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek); 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%; De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer. Een tegemoetkoming in jouw zorgkosten; Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof; De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en cursussen die passen bij jouw ambities. Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving Bij de afdeling Training & Simulatie werken experts op het gebied van simulatie, informatica, opleiding en training, kunstmatige intelligentie, psychologie, en lucht- en ruimtevaart. Het team waarin je terecht komt is het team Trainingssystemen. We zijn expert op het gebied van de volledige life-cycle van simulatiemiddelen – van verwerving, tot ontwerp en ontwikkeling, tot VV&A en kwalificatie, tot uiteindelijke operatie – gedreven vanuit een diepgaande kennis van M&S-technologie en –gebruik in combinatie met operationele expertise en klantdomeinkennis. De afdeling beschikt over onderzoeksfaciliteiten zoals een Battle Lab en een laboratorium dat zich richt op AR/VR innovaties. De sfeer binnen de afdeling is informeel en collegiaal en we vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zich thuis kan voelen bij ons! Wat betekent werken bij NLR? Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties. Bij ons werken meer dan 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt. Wil jij meer weten? Bel of mail dan met Pien Moller (recruiter) via 0611443915 of Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal . Solliciteren? Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button. Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Als senior R&D Engineer Trainingssystemen richt je je op het initiëren en realiseren van innovatieve, multidisciplinaire ontwikkelingen en het opzetten, uitvoeren en managen van grote, complexe projecten. Een belangrijk onderdeel van deze functie is het optreden als Subject Matter Expert (SME) in je vakgebied, waarbij je je kennis en expertise deelt met collega's, klanten adviseert en bijdraagt aan de ontwikkeling van innovatieve oplossingen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het leiden van projectteams, het adviseren van klanten en het opbouwen en onderhouden van een extern nationaal en internationaal relatienetwerk.

Je takenpakket omvat onder andere:

  • Het initiëren en realiseren van innovatieve, multidisciplinaire ontwikkelingen, waaronder het genereren van ideeën voor nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en het realiseren van samenwerking met andere disciplines;

  • Het opzetten, uitvoeren en managen van grote, complexe projecten, waaronder het uitwerken van projectplannen, het inventariseren en analyseren van projectrisico's en het adviseren van klanten over alternatieven;

  • Het leiden van projectteams, waaronder het geven van leiding aan projectmedewerkers, het bewaken van de voortgang en resultaten van de projecten en het zorgen voor de kwaliteit van de uitvoering;

  • Het opbouwen en onderhouden van een extern nationaal en  internationaal relatienetwerk, waaronder het initiëren en onderhouden van samenwerkingsverbanden, het creëren van mogelijkheden en het uitbrengen van proposals;

  • Het adviseren van klanten, waaronder het opbouwen van een zodanige relatie met de klant dat de klant kan worden ondersteund bij een verscheidenheid aan vraagstukken en het geven van advies over alternatieven;

  • Het bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van afdelingsbeleid, waaronder het realiseren van innovatieve, multidisciplinaire ontwikkelingen en het adviseren van afdelingsmanagement en businessmanager.

Je werkt samen met collega's uit andere teams aan diverse soorten projecten die hoogwaardige technologische simulatie- en trainingsoplossingen leveren aan eindgebruikers in de luchtvaartoperatie. Je hebt frequent contact en interactieve werksessies met hen om tot grensverleggende totaaloplossingen te kunnen komen.

Jouw enthousiasme en de wil om je te verdiepen in de operationele wereld van deze gebruikers is daarbij een must. Dat doe je niet enkel vanaf je bureau maar ook bij de operationele gebruikers op locatie, en regelmatig samen met industrie en kennispartners wereldwijd!

Wat breng je mee?

  • Een afgeronde WO-opleiding in Informatica, Lucht- en Ruimtevaarttechniek, Technische Natuurkunde, Werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbare studierichting;

  • Ruime (>10 jaar) werkervaring in een technische of wetenschappelijke discipline, met een focus op simulatie, training of een verwant gebied, zoals luchtvaart, ruimtevaart, defensie of andere industrieën waarin complexe systemen en processen worden gesimuleerd. Sterke affiniteit en ervaring in het militaire domein is een pre;

  • Affiniteit met innovatieve M&S technologie, zoals real-time simulatie technologie, AR/VR/MR, IoT, data- en softwarearchitecturen en netwerken;

  • Interesse of ervaring in het verbinden van systemen en het waarborgen van interoperabiliteit, bijvoorbeeld door het werken met netwerkprotocollen of architecturen;

  • Kennis van softwareontwikkeling (zowel de implementatie als procesmatig);

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, in de Nederlandse en Engelse taal;

  • Ervaring met projectmanagement, leidinggeven aan projectteams en het schrijven van proposals.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten.

Naast dit alles bieden wij jou:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5400 en €7100 (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;

  • 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek);

  • 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer.

  • Een tegemoetkoming in jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en cursussen die passen bij jouw ambities.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Bij de afdeling Training & Simulatie werken experts op het gebied van simulatie, informatica, opleiding en training, kunstmatige intelligentie, psychologie, en lucht- en ruimtevaart. Het team waarin je terecht komt is het team Trainingssystemen. We zijn expert op het gebied van de volledige life-cycle van simulatiemiddelen – van verwerving, tot ontwerp en ontwikkeling, tot VV&A en kwalificatie, tot uiteindelijke operatie – gedreven vanuit een diepgaande kennis van M&S-technologie en –gebruik in combinatie met operationele expertise en klantdomeinkennis. De afdeling beschikt over onderzoeksfaciliteiten zoals een Battle Lab en een laboratorium dat zich richt op AR/VR innovaties. De sfeer binnen de afdeling is informeel en collegiaal en we vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zich thuis kan voelen bij ons!

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties.

Bij ons werken meer dan 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt.

Wil jij meer weten?

Bel of mail dan met Pien Moller (recruiter) via 0611443915 of Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

Solliciteren?

Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.

 

Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD.

title: Business Development Manager
description: Grosse Veränderungen beginnen mit Menschen, die mehr erreichen wollen. Wie kommen Mitarbeitende zur Arbeit? Warum stehen Firmenautos ungenutzt herum, während Parkplätze knapp sind? Und wie wird nachhaltige Mobilität zur attraktivsten Wahl? Bei Urban Connect machen wir aus diesen Herausforderungen konkrete Lösungen. Wir verbinden geteilte E-Bikes und Firmenautos, öffentliche Verkehrsmittel, Mobilitätsbudgets und digitales Parkplatzmanagement auf einer Plattform. Damit helfen wir Unternehmen, Kosten zu senken, Ressourcen besser zu nutzen und ihren Mitarbeitenden mehr Freiheit zu geben. Unternehmen wie Roche, Google, SWISS und Lonza setzen bereits auf uns. Unser Anspruch geht weiter: Wir wollen die Art verändern, wie Unternehmen Mobilität organisieren. Und wir bieten das Betriebssystem, das dies möglich macht. Um diese Vision zu verwirklichen, suchen wir eine neugierige, unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Energie und gutes Urteilsvermögen mitbringt und mit uns das Unternehmen und die Mobilitätsbranche voranbringen möchte. Deine Rolle: echte Verantwortung, spürbare Wirkung Du möchtest ein Unternehmen mitgestalten, anspruchsvolle Probleme lösen und sehen, was deine Arbeit bewirkt. Als Business Development Manager arbeitest du eng mit unserem Sales- und Account-Management-Team sowie mit Product, Technology und Operations zusammen. Du entwickelst aus Kundenbedürfnissen, Daten und Marktkenntnissen überzeugende Mobilitätslösungen und konkrete Wachstumschancen. Du verantwortest Projekte, bringst eigene Ideen ein und treibst ihre Umsetzung voran. Wir erwarten, dass du von Anfang an durchdachte Fragen stellst, erkennst, wo du einen Beitrag leisten kannst, und ins Handeln kommst. Dabei unterstützen dich Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die wollen, dass du erfolgreich bist. Was du bei uns bewegst Aus Daten Chancen machen: Du analysierst Nutzungs- und Marktdaten, etwa zur Auslastung von Fahrzeugen und Parkplätzen, und entwickelst daraus umsetzbare Empfehlungen für bessere betriebliche Mobilitätslösungen. Eigene Projekte vorantreiben: Du verantwortest Projekte wie Produktanalysen, die Bewertung von Geschäftschancen und die Entwicklung betrieblicher Mobilitätskonzepte. Du definierst nächste Schritte, bringst die richtigen Menschen zusammen und erzielst Ergebnisse. Das Produkt verstehen: Du entwickelst ein praxisnahes Verständnis unserer Plattform, der Kundeneinrichtung, Buchungen, Abrechnungen und Integrationen. So gestaltest du Lösungen mit, die wirtschaftlich und operativ funktionieren. Mit KI besser arbeiten: Du setzt KI-Tools gezielt ein, testest neue Anwendungen und verbesserst die Qualität und Effizienz unserer Recherchen, Analysen und Prozesse. Wachstum vorantreiben: Du identifizierst potenzielle Kunden, verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und arbeitest mit dem Commercial-Team daran, neue Kunden zu gewinnen und bestehende Partnerschaften auszubauen. Überzeugend argumentieren: Du erstellst klare Präsentationen, fundierte Business Cases, überzeugende Angebote und aussagekräftige Kundenreviews, die den Mehrwert unserer Lösungen sichtbar machen. Für Fortschritt sorgen: Du setzt klare Prioritäten und hältst Kundeninformationen und nächste Schritte in HubSpot aktuell. Du hältst Zusagen ein und gehst Hindernisse frühzeitig an. Teams verbinden: Du klärst technische und kommerzielle Fragen gemeinsam mit Product, Operations und Technology und leitest daraus verständliche Empfehlungen für Kunden und das Team ab. Den Status quo hinterfragen: Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenzial, hinterfragst Annahmen und machst aus kreativen Ideen konkrete Verbesserungen. Was du mitbringst Einen sehr guten akademischen Leistungsausweis, beispielsweise in Betriebswirtschaft, Volkswirtschaft, Data Science oder Ingenieurwissenschaften. Wissbegierde, Kreativität und nachweisbare Leistungen sind uns wichtiger als eine bestimmte Studienrichtung. Relevante praktische Erfahrung im Business Development, in der Beratung, in einem Technologieunternehmen oder im unternehmerischen Umfeld. Du kannst zeigen, welche Projekte du verantwortet und welche Ergebnisse du erzielt hast. Bei Urban Connect machen wir aus diesen Herausforderungen konkrete Lösungen. Unternehmen wie Roche, Google, SWISS und Lonza setzen bereits auf uns. Unser Anspruch geht weiter: Wir wollen die Art verändern, wie Unternehmen Mobilität organisieren. Und wir bieten das Betriebssystem, das dies möglich macht.

Um diese Vision zu verwirklichen, suchen wir eine neugierige, unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Energie und gutes Urteilsvermögen mitbringt und mit uns das Unternehmen und die Mobilitätsbranche voranbringen möchte.

description: Die besten SAP-Spezialisten der Schweiz suchen keinen Job, sie wollen angesprochen werden. Zusammenarbeit mit den Key Account Managern Projektarbeit in enger Abstimmung mit unseren Key Account Managern Bei Eignung Einbindung in die Kundengewinnung und -betreuung, etwa durch Teilnahme an Briefings und Kundenterminen Was du mitbringst Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der SAP- oder IT-Personalberatung, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Direktansprache Einen nachweisbaren Track-Record im Ausstrahlung und Hartnäckigkeit, am Telefon wie im persönlichen Gespräch Eine Art, die Menschen öffnet: Kandidaten rufen dich zurück, weil sie gerne mit dir sprechen, und hören dir auch nach dem dritten Nein noch zu Humor, Drive und die Gelassenheit, auch in hektischen Phasen den richtigen Ton zu treffen Stilsicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch Was wir dir bieten Ein stabiles Umfeld in einer gefragten Nische, mit gefülltem Pool und etablierten Beziehungen statt Kaltstart Erfahrene Mentoren mit über 10 Jahren SAP-Headhunting-Erfahrung, die dich mit viel Engagement, Know-how und Freude an anders, die Pace ist hoch, und Kandidaten wie Unternehmen erwarten eine Beratung auf höchstem Niveau. raw.jobDescription:
About Us_
// At Masabi, we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel.

Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit.

Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what.

The Role_

// At Masabi, we're powering the journeys of millions by making public transport payments simple, accessible, and seamless.

We're looking for Backend Developers to help build and evolve the services at the heart of our Justride platform. You'll work on cloud-native, event-driven systems that run at scale for transit agencies around the world, from fare and ticketing logic to the APIs and integrations that connect riders, operators and partners.

As part of a cross-functional team, you'll work closely with engineers, testers and product partners to take features from idea to production. What you build will shape the experience of riders every day.

Location_

// This is a fully remote contract role for people based in Romania

Responsibilities_

  • Build and maintain backend services and APIs that power core parts of the Justride platform

  • Contribute to the design of scalable, secure and resilient distributed systems

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver features from concept through to production

  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code and contribute to code reviews and shared engineering standards

  • Build and support integrations with internal services and third-party systems

  • Monitor and improve the performance, reliability and observability of the services you own

  • Contribute to technical discussions and help shape solutions and best practices

  • Take ownership of your work and support team outcomes

About You_

  • Clear, confident communication in written and spoken English

  • Solid commercial experience building backend systems in Java or Kotlin

  • Understanding of distributed systems and how to build for scale and reliability

  • Comfortable designing and working with REST APIs and service-based or event-driven architectures

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, ideally AWS

  • A thoughtful approach to code quality, testing and maintainability

  • Collaborative and team-oriented, happy to share knowledge and learn from others

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset

  • Able to explain technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues

We don't expect you to tick every box. What matters most is curiosity, a willingness to learn, and the motivation to take ownership of your work.

What You'll Learn_

  • How a global fare payment platform works at scale, used by transit agencies and millions of riders

  • Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture, Kafka, AWS and infrastructure as code

  • How to deliver in a cross-functional, international team where developers help shape the technical direction

Our Stack_

  • Java/Kotlin (nice to have)

  • Event-driven architecture, RESTful APIs

  • AWS (DynamoDB, S3, SQS, EC2, ECS etc.)

  • Kafka

  • Terraform

  • Grafana

  • Gradle, Maven, Git

Careers at Masabi are for people going places - driven by a mission to make transit fair and accessible for all.

// We are a network of innovators from all walks of life, passionate about making a difference. At Masabi, we operate with openness and trust, creating an environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their whole, authentic selves to work.

Whoever you are, just be yourself.
// We welcome applications from underrepresented groups, including disabled and neurodivergent people, and can make adjustments at any stage of the process. You’re also welcome to share your pronouns whenever you feel comfortable. Together, we simplify journeys, remove barriers, and improve daily life for millions.

Why Join Masabi?

  • Driven by Purpose – We believe in journeys made simple. The work isn’t always easy, but the best things never are.

  • Encouraged to Accelerate – Masabi is going places and our people are in the driving seat. Whether you’re taking the direct route or exploring new paths, we support your journey.

  • Advancing with Empathy – We put people first and foster a culture of learning, not blame. No matter your cargo, we share the load.

We’re already powering journeys - are you ready to join us?

title: Senior Key Corporate Sales Manager
description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. 

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

The Senior Key Corporate Sales Manager is responsible for developing and executing Lucid Motors’ European B2B sales strategy, driving sustainable growth across key accounts, enterprise customers, leasing companies, rental operators, and fleet and mobility partners.

This role identifies new business opportunities, develops strategic partnerships, negotiates commercial agreements, and delivers sales, revenue, and profitability targets. The role also leads and develops a team of Corporate Sales Managers and supports Lucid’s importer markets to ensure consistent execution across Europe.

Key Responsibilities

Corporate Business Development

  • Identify, develop, and secure new business opportunities with enterprise customers, corporate fleets, leasing companies, rental operators, and mobility providers.
  • Position Lucid as a preferred premium electric vehicle partner and develop strategic account plans that support sustainable growth.

Sales Strategy & Commercial Performance

  • Develop and execute the European corporate sales strategy in line with Lucid’s growth objectives.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop competitive vehicle, financing, and service propositions.
  • Deliver sales, revenue, profitability, and market share targets.

Strategic Account & Partnership Management

  • Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers at major corporate accounts and strategic partners.
  • Understand customer fleet and mobility requirements and provide tailored commercial solutions.
  • Manage relationships with leasing, rental, fleet, mobility, and importer partners across Europe.

Commercial Negotiations

  • Lead complex negotiations and contract discussions with strategic customers and partners.
  • Structure commercial agreements that create long-term value for Lucid and its customers.

Market Intelligence & Reporting

  • Monitor industry trends, competitor activity, fleet market developments, and emerging mobility solutions.
  • Provide regular performance reporting, customer insights, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

Leadership & Customer Experience

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Corporate Sales Managers.
  • Promote accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and commercial excellence.
  • Ensure a consistent premium customer and partner experience throughout the sales lifecycle.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in automotive B2B sales, fleet sales, corporate sales, key account management, or mobility solutions.
  • Proven experience developing business and managing strategic accounts across multiple European markets.
  • Strong knowledge of fleet sales, leasing, financing, electric vehicles, total cost of ownership, and mobility trends.
  • Demonstrated success in delivering revenue growth, profitability, market share, and customer retention.
  • Proven experience leading and developing high-performing sales teams.
  • Experience negotiating complex commercial agreements and strategic partnerships.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, supported by a data-driven approach.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience with CRM and sales performance systems; Salesforce experience is preferred.
  • Results-oriented and entrepreneurial, with a strong interest in innovation and electric mobility.
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are advantageous.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
 

Lucid Motors is committed to maintaining a safe and trustworthy environment. As such, a background check may be required during the hiring process. This will be performed in line with European data protection laws, and candidates will be informed and asked to provide consent before the check is conducted.

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.  

Equal Opportunity: At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations. 

Accessibility: Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need any accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at . This email address is designated solely for accommodation requests and is not monitored for job applications or resume submissions. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website.

Candidate Data Privacy: By submitting your application, you understand and agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. 

To all recruitment agencies: Lucid Motors does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Lucid Motors. Lucid Motors is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lead the design, development, and adoption of AI systems within a strategic business domain.

As the AI technical lead for your domain, you will drive architecture decisions, engineering excellence, and AI adoption across teams and stakeholders. Examples of domains include: Sales, GTM and Marketing or Finance & Legal

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

Annual gross salary range (package): €90,000 – €100,000

This range is provided for transparency purposes and reflects our internal compensation grid for this role level. The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

  • Design and build production-grade AI systems

3. Drive Adoption & Business Impact

  • Work closely with end users
  • Measure adoption and outcomes
  • Accelerate AI transformation across your domain

4. Establish Technical Excellence

  • Promote best practices for evaluation, testing, guardrails, and observability
  • Review designs and mentor engineers
  • Raise the quality bar across initiatives

5. Grow AI Capability

  • Mentor AI Engineers and Agent Builders
  • Share knowledge and reusable components
  • Build AI expertise within your organization

Success Metrics

  • Business impact delivered by AI initiatives
  • Adoption within the domain
  • Technical quality and reliability
  • Team capability growth

 

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL
  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models
  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases
  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

 

You'll Love This Job If you have
