We need software developers to work on a wide range of technologies including, but not limited to: distributed systems, user interfaces, mobile and cloud computing. As a developer, you will help make dreams a reality. We are looking for software developers who have a passion for technology and code. Beyond code, developers are expected to collaborate closely with others including technical product managers, designers and QA. raw.jobDescription:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Developer Relations Engineer based in San Francisco to join our team and to help more developers discover, learn, and build with Supabase. You’ll create high-impact content, build real-world projects, and represent Supabase across communities and events. If you’re equally energized by writing code and teaching others, this is the role for you.

Why this role matters

Supabase is growing fast with 350,000+ developers, 1,000+ OSS contributors, and a thriving open source ecosystem. Our users are builders, startup founders, weekend hackers, and engineers scaling to millions of users. DevRel is how we meet them where they are: through content, community, and code.

We’re building a community of communities that brings together developers from many backgrounds, including first-time open source contributors. As a DevRel Engineer, you’ll be a bridge between Supabase and the broader developer ecosystem, helping people get started, go deep, and feel connected.

What you'll do

  • Make content

    Publish compelling technical content, especially video, to help developers learn Supabase quickly

  • Build demos and tutorials

    Ship real-world apps using Supabase and tools like Next.js, React, and Stripe. Write guides that others can follow and remix

  • Represent Supabase

    Speak at meetups, livestream builds, and engage with the developer ecosystem. You’ll be a visible and trusted voice of the platform

  • Support and grow the community

    Celebrate contributors, answer questions, highlight cool projects, and bring developer feedback to the team

  • Collaborate across the company

    Work with engineering, product, and growth to amplify launches, prioritize content, and reduce friction for new users

You might be a fit if:

  • You’ve built full-stack apps and enjoy sharing your knowledge

  • You create content that makes people want to open their code editor

  • You’re equally comfortable writing a video script and TypeScript

  • You’re energized by community whether it’s on Discord, Twitter, YouTube, or in person

  • You’re self-directed, organized, and excited to contribute to open source

Requirements

This role is based in San Francisco to support regular in-person devrel video shoots, attend local events, and be an active presence in the SF tech ecosystem.

  • Strong engineering skills, especially with JavaScript or TypeScript, Postgres, and modern frontend frameworks (React, Svelte, Vue, etc.)

  • Experience creating technical content (written or video)

  • Comfortable representing a product publicly (on camera, on stage, or online)

Bonus points if you have:

  • A growing audience on YouTube, Twitch, or Twitter

  • Prior experience in DevRel or open source

  • Have used (and loved) Supabase

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

For detailed qualifications, see our contributor qualifications document . raw.jobDescription:
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

We're looking for an engineer to help build the future of distributed Postgres. You'll work on Multigres, our open-source distributed database system that brings horizontal scaling to Postgres.

In this role, you'll architect and implement critical distributed database infrastructure including sharding, consensus protocols, and materialization systems. You'll collaborate closely with our Postgres, networking, and infrastructure teams to push the boundaries of what's possible with distributed databases.

What You’ll Be Responsible for:

  • Design and implement query routing logic for sharded databases

  • Build consensus and replication systems to support distribute durability

  • Develop materialization pipelines for migrations and change data capture

  • Contribute to connection pooling infrastructure and intelligent workload isolation

  • Collaborate with the open-source community on Multigres development

You Might Be a Good Fit If You have:

  • This role requires deep technical expertise in distributed databases and systems. For detailed qualifications, see our contributor qualifications document.

    Key areas of expertise:

    • Database sharding, relational algebra, and Postgres internals

    • Consensus protocols (Raft, Paxos, FlexPaxos) and distributed transactions

    • Stream processing, materialization, and change data capture

    • Building robust, performant distributed systems with strong observability

    • Low-latency infrastructure and network protocol optimization.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

raw.title: IoT Embedded Systems Engineer
raw.description:
• Take ownership of the development of IoT systems, with a focus on embedded software, system architecture, and hardware and firmware integration

  • Design and develop robust, efficient, and scalable embedded software for IoT products based on microcontroller platforms and, optionally, Linux based systems

  • Provide technical guidance for hardware development in collaboration with external partners, including reviewing and challenging PCB designs to ensure functionality, quality, and manufacturability

  • Collaborate closely with mechanical, software, and cloud engineering teams to ensure seamless end to end system integration

  • Define and refine product requirements from initial concept through to mass production in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders

  • Develop and integrate prototypes and support the transition from development into serial production together with manufacturing partners

  • Contribute to the continuous evolution of the embedded platform, including MCU based solutions as well as optional Linux and Yocto based components

  • Develop pragmatic testing strategies to ensure the functionality, reliability, and quality of both hardware and firmware

  • Support development and manufacturing partners with debugging, technical documentation, and production ramp up

  • Provide Level 3 technical support for complex system, firmware, and hardware related issues

  • Travel approximately 5 to 10 percent to support development partners, product validation activities, and product launches


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience

  • Several years of hands on experience in embedded development, including firmware development and hardware related engineering

  • Strong understanding of hardware design and PCB layouts, with the ability to review design decisions and collaborate effectively with hardware development teams

  • Strong expertise in embedded firmware development and software architecture for microcontroller platforms such as ARM Cortex, ESP32, or STM32

  • Experience with sensor integration and wireless communication technologies such as BLE and WiFi

  • Experience with embedded Linux systems, particularly Yocto, is an advantage, especially in environments combining System on Modules with MCU based architectures

  • Broad system level understanding of mechanics, sensors, actuators, and their integration into robust IoT products

  • Hands on experience with hardware testing, debugging tools, and automated production testing

  • Familiarity with certification standards such as CE and FCC is an advantage

  • Fluent in German and English, with additional languages considered a plus

title: IAM Software Engineer
description:
As an IAM Software Engineer, you’ll focus on Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions. Your work combines technical analysis, platform configuration, low-code implementation, integration, testing, and troubleshooting, with custom coding where needed. You’ll work closely with engineers, architects, consultants, and customer teams to deliver secure, reliable solutions. 

You’ll join an engineering delivery team of around 8–12 people, working across customer assignments in two-week sprints, often with a specific sprint focus. Our ‘you build it, you run it’ approach combines implementation, ongoing improvement, and troubleshooting after delivery, supported by senior engineers in your own and neighbouring teams doing similar work. 

What you’ll do as an IAM Software Engineer 

  • Design and deliver IGA solutions that help customers govern access, using standard platform capabilities, low-code tools, and integration standards, with C#, SQL, and APIs where needed. 
  • Translate customer needs into technical designs and engineering tasks, working with architects, security engineers, and customer stakeholders to meet security, compliance, scalability, and maintainability requirements. 
  • Troubleshoot complex IAM issues, identify root causes, and implement lasting improvements that reduce recurrence and security risk. 
  • Improve automation and delivery practices, using PowerShell and CI/CD where appropriate to make implementation and ongoing changes more reliable. 
  • Share knowledge and support junior engineers through mentoring, design sessions, and reviews of configurations, integrations, and code. 

The impact you’ll have 

Your engineering work will help leading organizations manage access confidently, protect sensitive data, and comply with evolving regulations. By building reliable IAM solutions and improving delivery practices, you’ll contribute to technical strategy and help the team deliver more effectively—strengthening client security and trust in the digital landscape.

Autonomy in your work and support for your career development.

description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

Lunar Sales:

The Celonis Lunar Sales is a fast-track, 2-year development programme designed for ambitious professionals who want to accelerate their career at the intersection of AI, enterprise technology, and strategic sales.  If you have experience solving complex problems in a client-facing role, in management or strategy consulting or a leading industry strategy function and you are ready to bring that expertise into enterprise sales, this is your launchpad.

If you're an innovative thinker who thrives on overcoming challenges, our Top Talent Sales Program will provide strategic significance, arming you with the knowledge and tools to address complex problems, create meaningful change and excel as an Account Executive. 

Onboarding Period of 1-3 months with the whole Lunar Cohort one-site at the Celonis Munich Office.


The Role:

Fast-track your growth in enterprise sales through our exclusive top talent program. You will gain hands-on experience selling AI-driven business transformation, build relationships with industry leaders across Celonis verticals, including Automotive, Manufacturing, Banking, FSI,  Life Sciences, Consumer Goods, Retail, Energy and Public Sector and develop the leadership skills needed to drive real change for enterprise customers.

Strategic Business Development & Executive Relationship Building

Tailored Solutions & Strategic Alignment 

  • Position Celonis Context Model and AI capabilities to address critical business needs, delivering measurable impact and expansion.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Orchestrate cross-functional teams, including Value Engineers, Service Consultants, Marketing, BDRs, and external partners.
  • Partner directly with a senior Account Executive in a dedicated 1:1 mentorship model to accelerate your professional growth.


The work you’ll do:

  • Understand the strategic and operational business needs of your target accounts and effectively communicate how Celonis and its AI-powered Process Intelligence Platform, will meet those to create real opportunities.
  • Responsible for delivering revenue in your allocated account patch by creating new business opportunities. 
  • Identify key stakeholder personas, cultivate strategic relationships, and build an internal network of champions to drive customer success and account expansion.
  • Engage cross Line-of-Business at C-level and below within your target organizations 
  • Become proficient in driving the sales process, following a structured, staged, programmatic flow through prospect, initial call, qualify, pitch to close.
  • Collaborate with Value Engineering or personally conduct comprehensive presentations and demonstrations tailored to specific use cases, including Celonis AI, Process Intelligence Graph and industry-specific solutions, showcasing the value of our platform.
  • Forge strong partnerships, particularly with leading consulting firms, tech partners, and the Big4.

  • Stay current on AI trends, process automation, and digital transformation to position Celonis as the intelligent backbone of enterprise operations.

The qualifications you need:

  • Proven Track Record in Client-Facing Roles: You bring 2–3 years of professional experience from a top-tier management consultancy, corporate strategy/transformation function, or leading enterprise technology company. 
  • Strong Academic Foundation: You studied Business Economics, Engineering, Informatics, or a related discipline. A Master's degree is preferred, but exceptional graduates with solid foundational knowledge are encouraged to apply.
  • Sales Drive & Career Acceleration: You're ready to accelerate your career in sales. You have a genuine interest in applying your professional experience to a dynamic sales environment and are excited to build expertise in enterprise software solutions and client success.
  • Business Acumen & Process Intelligence Expertise: You have a sharp ability to quickly understand how companies operate, identify inefficiencies, and recognize where Process Intelligence and AI unlock real value and drive transformation.
  • AI-Forward Mindset: You're genuinely curious about AI and emerging technologies, driven to deepen your business acumen, and passionate about understanding business processes and KPIs—particularly in Finance, Supply Chain, or operations.
  • Industry Edge: You bring familiarity or hands-on experience in Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer Goods, Retail, Financial Services, Telecommunications, or Utilities. This foundation helps you quickly grasp client contexts and add immediate value.
  • Communication Excellence: You communicate complex, strategic ideas with clarity and confidence in Business English. Fluency in Dutch is a strong plus.
  • Analytical & Independent Thinker: You bring a forward-thinking mindset with analytical capabilities. You think strategically, operate independently, and are comfortable owning challenges and driving solutions.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.

  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. Join the journey

Wat ga je doen?

Jij zet technische best practices op voor klanten en (interne) collega's. Als Technical Architect ben je de motivator voor de technische collega's van het klantteam. Als digital leader naar de klant ben je in staat om breder te kijken dan de oplossing die wij leveren en zie je deze in het totale end-to-end klantproces.

Als Technical Architect ben je verantwoordelijk voor het technische deel van de oplossing. Daarnaast:

  • Ben je betrokken in de designfase en bepaal je welke technologieën kunnen worden gebruikt in welke scenario's;

  • Samen met de Product Owner stel je een roadmap op voor technische verbeteringen.


Wat vertellen onze huidige technische architecten over deze rol?

“Het werk als technische architect is heel erg uitdagend en gevarieerd. Je werkt samen met hele leuke collega’s op projecten. Op het project ben je verantwoordelijk voor de algehele kwaliteit en samenhang van het IT-landschap. Primair binnen de kaders van het project. Echter doordat je implementatie altijd samenhangt met andere systemen ben je ook veel bezig met het landschap buiten het Microsoft project. Als je het leuk vindt is er ook altijd ruimte om op de inhoud in te gaan. Als je dat doet ben je vooral bezig met de complexe onderdelen van het project en dat is erg leuk en uitdagend. Naast de projecten houd je je bezig met de best practices van HSO. Je krijgt daardoor altijd de nieuwe ontwikkelingen mee en krijgt de kans om daar wat mee te doen.”

  • Je bent inhoudelijk, analytisch, ondernemend, kwaliteitsbewust en creatief.

 

Wat bieden we jou?  
Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden wij:  

  • Een competitief salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties;

Vrijheid, flexibiliteit en fun  
Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met professionals met verschillende nationaliteiten. Een flexibele werkweek van 40, 36 of 32 uur behoort tot de mogelijkheden omdat wij van mening zijn dat jouw manier van werken bij jouw levensstijl moet passen. raw.title: Enterprise Account Executive III - Netherlands
raw.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to build Camunda’s Dutch Government market. This is a territory-building role for a disciplined, consultative seller who can create demand, shape strategic opportunities, and guide complex buying groups through to executive-level decisions. You will own the full sales cycle across a focused set of government accounts, from account strategy and first conversation through business case, procurement, negotiation, close, and expansion.

You will combine commercial ownership with public-sector credibility. The successful candidate will be comfortable engaging senior civil servants, CIO and transformation leaders, procurement, security, architecture, and business stakeholders. You will translate government priorities into a compelling value case for process orchestration, automation, and agentic workflows, while navigating formal procurement processes and the governance expectations of public-sector customers.

What you will own

  • Own the Dutch Government territory and create a clear account and coverage strategy across priority national and public-sector organizations.

  • Build and maintain a healthy, self-generated pipeline, targeting at least 2.5x pipeline coverage through focused outbound activity, executive engagement, partner collaboration, and market development.

  • Develop relationships across complex buying groups, including CIOs, CTOs, transformation leaders, enterprise architects, process owners, procurement, security, legal, and executive sponsors.

  • Lead the full enterprise sales cycle: discovery, qualification, value engineering, technical evaluation, business case, procurement, commercial negotiation, and close.

  • Apply MEDDICC consistently to create deal clarity, strengthen qualification, identify gaps early, and improve forecast reliability.

  • Build business cases connected to public-sector outcomes such as service quality, operational efficiency, transparency, resilience, compliance, and cost control.

  • Coordinate account teams across Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Professional Services, Marketing, Product, Legal, Finance, and leadership.

  • Developa partner-first motion with relevant global system integrators, regional partners, and public-sector specialists.

  • Expand successful customer relationships by identifying adjacent processes, departments, agencies, and use cases after the initial land.

  • Maintain accurate account, contact, opportunity, and forecast data in Salesforce as the single source of truth.

  • Share market intelligence on government priorities, procurement dynamics, competitors, partners, and customer needs to improve Camunda’s Dutch public-sector go-to-market strategy.

What success looks like

First 30 days

  • Build a working understanding of Camunda’s platform, value proposition, sales methodology, customer evidence, pricing approach, and public-sector references.

  • Align with internal stakeholders on territory priorities, account ownership, partner coverage, and available sales resources.

  • Produce an initial account segmentation and stakeholder-mapping plan for the Dutch Government territory.

  • Establish a repeatable operating cadence for pipeline creation, deal inspection, forecasting, and cross-functional account-team collaboration.

First 90 days

  • Complete strategic account plans for the highest-priority government accounts, including business priorities, buying groups, whitespace, partners, competition, and next actions.

  • Create qualified pipeline through a balanced mix of net-new opportunities, partner-sourced activity, executive introductions, and expansion plays.

  • Develop a strong network of relevant government and ecosystem stakeholders, with clear relationship and meeting objectives.

  • Demonstrate consistent MEDDICC qualification and accurate Salesforce hygiene across active opportunities.

  • Identify the most relevant public-sector use cases and value narratives for Camunda’s Dutch market development.

First 180 days and beyond

  • Establish a credible, repeatable pipeline engine for the Dutch Government market.

  • Progress strategic opportunities through well-defined qualification, value validation, technical evaluation, procurement, and commercial stages.

  • Win new government logos and create expansion paths into additional departments, agencies, or processes.

  • Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors and public-sector ecosystem partners.

  • Contribute actionable market insight that improves Camunda’s positioning, messaging, partner strategy, and investment decisions in the Netherlands.

  • Deliver against quota while protecting long-term customer value, adoption, and expansion potential.

What you will bring

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of success in a quota-carrying enterprise software or SaaS Account Executive role, owning complex deals end to end.

  • Demonstrated experience selling into the Dutch Government or another highly regulated public-sector environment, with a clear understanding of formal procurement, security, legal, and governance requirements.

  • A track record of creating pipeline through proactive outbound activity and converting multi-stakeholder opportunities into material, preferably multi-year, contracts.

  • Strong command of MEDDICC or a comparable enterprise sales methodology, with the discipline to qualify rigorously, manage mutual action plans, and forecast accurately.

  • Executive presence and communication skills in Dutch and English, with the ability to connect operational problems to strategic, financial, and citizen-impact outcomes.

  • A collaborative, customer-focused, and resilient approach aligned with Camunda’s FAITH values and global-first way of working.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience selling process automation, workflow, orchestration, integration, business transformation, or adjacent enterprise technology.

  • Existing relationships across Dutch ministries, executive agencies, municipalities, provinces, public-service organizations, or government-focused partners.

  • Experience working with global system integrators, regional implementation partners, or public-sector framework agreements.

  • Familiarity with Camunda, BPMN, DMN, process orchestration, cloud platforms, or agentic automation.

  • Experience creating quantified value cases for service modernization, compliance, operational resilience, or cost reduction.

Why this role matters now

Dutch public-sector organizations are under pressure to modernize services, improve efficiency, operate securely, and coordinate increasingly complex technology and regulatory environments. Process orchestration gives them a way to make that complexity visible and manageable while connecting people, systems, and automation.

This role is an opportunity to shape a market rather than inherit a mature patch. You will have the ownership and visibility to define where Camunda can create the greatest public value, build the ecosystem around those opportunities, and establish a durable foundation for growth in the Netherlands.

You will join a global, distributed team that values initiative, transparency, customer impact, and practical collaboration. The role offers the chance to work at the intersection of public-sector transformation, enterprise technology, process orchestration, and the next generation of agentic automation.

Jouw rol Bij Heras krijg je de kans om als stagiair bij te dragen aan het Nimble-programma: een strategisch verbeterprogramma gericht op het vereenvoudigen en automatiseren van bedrijfsprocessen. Als stagiair werk je aan het verbeteren van processen binnen domeinen zoals sales, projecten in nieuwbouw en finance. Je analyseert hoe processen vandaag werken en vertaalt dit naar slimme oplossingen met behulp van Power BI en Power Automate. Je levert concrete procesverbeteringen, procesbeschrijvingen, automatiseringen en Power BI dashboards voor operationele en financiële sturing aan alsmede werkende Power Automate flows. Tenslotte lever je een meetbare bijdrage aan efficiëntie (bijv. tijdbesparing of minder fouten). Jouw werkzaamheden In kaart brengen van huidige processen en knelpunten. Automatiseren van handmatige processen met Power Automate. Ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages in Power BI (zonder daadwerkelijk programmeren). Verbeteren van datakwaliteit en inzicht in KPI’s. Samenwerken met business teams en IT-specialisten. Benieuwd naar de ervaringen van een stagiair bij Heras? De eerste indruk: dynamisch in plaats van stoffig - Heras Nederland Wie zijn wij? Heras is een vooraanstaand Europese totaalleverancier van permanente perimeter protection oplossingen. Wij opereren vanuit meer dan 24 landen en hebben meer dan 1100 hoogopgeleide experts in dienst. Opgericht in 1952, vervult en overtreft Heras de beveiligingsbehoeften van klanten in heel Europa. Het is dankzij deze staat van dienst, samen met het blijvend groeiende vakmanschap van onze medewerkers, dat wij ons experts in perimeter protection kunnen noemen. Onze cultuur, werksfeer & waarden Wij hebben binnen Heras een informele, open en toegankelijke cultuur. We zijn trots op ons werk, producten en dienstverlening. We hebben een no-nonsense mentaliteit, tonen ondernemerschap, zijn energiek en werken allemaal gedisciplineerd volgens de drie kernwaarden; betrokkenheid, betrouwbaarheid en deskundigheid. Heras is gewaardeerd op een Ecovadis Zilveren Ster en dat plaatst ons bij de duurzaamste 15% bedrijven van Nederland. By creating reusable infrastructure, improving developer experience and removing unnecessary complexity, you will help teams move faster without compromising reliability or security. Along the way, you will collaborate with engineers, influence technical direction and leave the platform in a significantly better state than you found it. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Luscii is part of OMRON DH ; together we built for the long term. To work on making healthcare better. Most important benefits Salary : Naturally, this depends on your background, experience, and relevant expertise. The ideal candidate… … probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex technical challenges, makes pragmatic engineering decisions, and is excited about helping others succeed along the way. You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust. title: Principal Engineer, Duo Agent Platform
description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. About the role We are looking for a Principal Engineer to help build GitLab Duo Agent Platform, the agentic orchestration layer that runs AI agents and flows across the entire software lifecycle. Principal Engineers at GitLab are recognized experts across multiple technology domains and represent the senior technical leadership within their organization. In this role you will set technical direction for a significant part of the Agent Platform, working across several teams to turn agentic capabilities into something engineering organizations can actually depend on: predictable, observable, governable, and fast enough to sit in the critical path of real development work. The Agent Platform is not a single service. It spans agent execution and orchestration, flow definition and event-driven triggering, the AI Catalog through which customers discover and manage agents, model routing and evaluation, and the governance surface that decides which agents may act where and under whose identity. It runs on GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, and Self-Managed installations, including deployments that use self-hosted models to meet compliance requirements. You will work on the parts of that system where the hard architectural questions live, and you will do it hands-on. This role reports into the VP of the AI Engineering organization and works closely with Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, Product Management, Infrastructure and Security. What you'll do Define the technical direction for a significant area of Duo Agent Platform across several teams, and partner with Engineering Managers and Product to turn it into a roadmap with a six-month horizon. Build the orchestration layer that makes agents and flows reliable: session lifecycle, tool invocation, context assembly, concurrency, retries, timeouts, and failure modes that degrade gracefully instead of stalling a developer's workflow. Hands on work on driving topics throughout the whole organisation from POC level, architecture to full implementation. Participate in Incident Management on-call rotation, to help meet availability goals for GitLab.com. Strong product builder and ownership mentality. Understanding of product strategy, technical strategy, delivering customer value and iteration towards a successful product Write clear, opinionated design documents, architecture narratives, and decision records that let other teams make aligned decisions. Ensure the architecture holds across multi-tenant GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments, including self-hosted model configurations, and respects data governance boundaries in each. Use the platform on our own work, find where it falls short of what we claim, and feed that back through improvements into the product. Mentor Staff and Senior Engineers, and raise the bar for experimentation rigor and cross-team collaboration. Work across the whole platform on different projects, features and teams. This reaches across: Design the extensibility surface so customers can build custom agents and flows, connect their own tools and internal systems, and bring external agents such as Claude Code and Codex into GitLab workflows without weakening the platform's guarantees. Drive down the cost and latency of agentic requests, and work with Product on how model selection, routing, and credit consumption behave as usage grows. Define the evaluation practice for the platform: offline benchmarks and online experiments that measure task completion, correctness, tool-call accuracy, latency, and cost per task, and that catch regressions before customers do. Build the governance and safety surface with Security and Compliance: policy-driven controls over which agents and models may run where, permission and identity semantics that align to existing roles and group structure, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, traceability of every flow session, and audit that stands up to enterprise review. Complete Interview Training and participate in hiring for the department as a technical interviewer or panel member. What you'll bring 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years at Staff, Principal level or equivalent senior technical leadership. Hands-on production experience building on large language models: agent loops, tool calling, context management, retrieval, prompt and model evaluation. Experience shipping this to real users, not only prototyping it. Strong background in distributed systems, including service decomposition, fault tolerance, observability, and operational resilience under multi-tenant load. A track record of defining evaluation frameworks and using benchmark and experiment results to make architecture decisions, rather than shipping on intuition. Experience designing human-in-the-loop controls, safety guardrails, and responsible AI practices for systems that act on a customer's behalf. Ability to drive alignment across Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, and Security on problems that start out ambiguous. Experience mentoring senior engineers and shaping technical direction across multiple teams without direct authority. Comfort working in one or more of Ruby, Go, Python, or TypeScript, and willingness to work across the stack the platform spans. Excellent written and asynchronous communication, and the ability to work effectively in a fully remote, globally distributed organization. About the team The AI engineering organisation is building the product and infrastructure that make GitLab an effective environment for running agents across the software development lifecycle. We’re distributed across the world and partner with teams throughout GitLab to help the GitLab Duo Agent Platform become the backbone of GitLab's AI features. You will report directly to the VP of Engineering for AI and especially work together with all the teams, the engineering management and other principal engineers in the AI department. This is an opportunity to lead a consequential group as AI changes how software is built. The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity . Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application. Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. In this role you will set technical direction for a significant part of the Agent Platform, working across several teams to turn agentic capabilities into something engineering organizations can actually depend on: predictable, observable, governable, and fast enough to sit in the critical path of real development work.

The Agent Platform is not a single service. It spans agent execution and orchestration, flow definition and event-driven triggering, the AI Catalog through which customers discover and manage agents, model routing and evaluation, and the governance surface that decides which agents may act where and under whose identity. It runs on GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, and Self-Managed installations, including deployments that use self-hosted models to meet compliance requirements. You will work on the parts of that system where the hard architectural questions live, and you will do it hands-on.

This role reports into the VP of the AI Engineering organization and works closely with Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, Product Management, Infrastructure and Security.

What you'll do

  • Define the technical direction for a significant area of Duo Agent Platform across several teams, and partner with Engineering Managers and Product to turn it into a roadmap with a six-month horizon.
  • Build the orchestration layer that makes agents and flows reliable: session lifecycle, tool invocation, context assembly, concurrency, retries, timeouts, and failure modes that degrade gracefully instead of stalling a developer's workflow.
  • Hands on work on driving topics throughout the whole organisation from POC level, architecture to full implementation.
  • Participate in Incident Management on-call rotation, to help meet availability goals for GitLab.com.
  • Strong product builder and ownership mentality. Understanding of product strategy, technical strategy, delivering customer value and iteration towards a successful product
  • Write clear, opinionated design documents, architecture narratives, and decision records that let other teams make aligned decisions. Ensure the architecture holds across multi-tenant GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments, including self-hosted model configurations, and respects data governance boundaries in each.
  • Use the platform on our own work, find where it falls short of what we claim, and feed that back through improvements into the product.
  • Mentor Staff and Senior Engineers, and raise the bar for experimentation rigor and cross-team collaboration.
  • Work across the whole platform on different projects, features and teams. This reaches across:
    • Design the extensibility surface so customers can build custom agents and flows, connect their own tools and internal systems, and bring external agents such as Claude Code and Codex into GitLab workflows without weakening the platform's guarantees.
    • Drive down the cost and latency of agentic requests, and work with Product on how model selection, routing, and credit consumption behave as usage grows.
    • Define the evaluation practice for the platform: offline benchmarks and online experiments that measure task completion, correctness, tool-call accuracy, latency, and cost per task, and that catch regressions before customers do.
    • Build the governance and safety surface with Security and Compliance: policy-driven controls over which agents and models may run where, permission and identity semantics that align to existing roles and group structure, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, traceability of every flow session, and audit that stands up to enterprise review.
  • Complete Interview Training and participate in hiring for the department as a technical interviewer or panel member.

What you'll bring

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years at Staff, Principal level or equivalent senior technical leadership.
  • Hands-on production experience building on large language models: agent loops, tool calling, context management, retrieval, prompt and model evaluation. Experience shipping this to real users, not only prototyping it.
  • Strong background in distributed systems, including service decomposition, fault tolerance, observability, and operational resilience under multi-tenant load.
  • A track record of defining evaluation frameworks and using benchmark and experiment results to make architecture decisions, rather than shipping on intuition.
  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop controls, safety guardrails, and responsible AI practices for systems that act on a customer's behalf.
  • Ability to drive alignment across Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, and Security on problems that start out ambiguous.
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and shaping technical direction across multiple teams without direct authority.
  • Comfort working in one or more of Ruby, Go, Python, or TypeScript, and willingness to work across the stack the platform spans.
  • Excellent written and asynchronous communication, and the ability to work effectively in a fully remote, globally distributed organization.

About the team

The AI engineering organisation is building the product and infrastructure that make GitLab an effective environment for running agents across the software development lifecycle. We’re distributed across the world and partner with teams throughout GitLab to help the GitLab Duo Agent Platform become the backbone of GitLab's AI features. You will report directly to the VP of Engineering for AI and especially work together with all the teams, the engineering management and other principal engineers in the AI department. This is an opportunity to lead a consequential group as AI changes how software is built.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range

$250,000—$325,000 USD

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements.   • Design and build scalable software solutions across specific product areas or multi-component systems

Identify and eliminate manual efforts for cross-functional teams and replace them with scheduled, auditable automation. For example, automating patching, certificate and secret rotation, environment scaling, and recurring reports Implement GitOps-based continuous delivery - declarative, Git-driven deployments with automated reconciliation, drift detection and rollback. Automate line-of-business environments end to end, provisioned and torn down on demand across every Azure service and application involved. Automate business continuity and disaster recovery through backup validation, restore and failover, recurring DR drills, and measured RTO and RPO. Ensure Helm and Terraform are easy to upgrade by charting reuse and configuration validation, versioned modules, and state boundaries that limit how far an upgrade reaches. Run in-cluster platform services deployed through Helm, harden workloads for availability and capacity: health probes, replica counts, and right-sized requests, limits and autoscaling. Ensure that the Terraform configuration is regularly maintained. Build and maintain Build Agent images for streamlining tooling available for the builds. Automate the guardrails such as policy-as-code, security and IaC scanning in the pipeline, and alerts and dashboards defined as code. Implement AI-assisted engineering in the platform teamâs day-to-day work Contribute to the departmentâs AI enablement, package knowledge into reusable skills and runbooks in the shared skill library. Work with the development and operations teams to find automation gaps, prioritize them, and close them. Troubleshoot production and staging issues and document what you automate so others can operate it. Requirements: 6+ years of hands-on cloud engineering, DevOps and/or platform engineering experience, including at least 1-2+ years with infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation on Microsoft Azure in production. Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar and/or equivalent work experience. Practical in-depth knowledge and expertise in Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps pipelines, and GitOps delivery (Argo CD or Flux). Strong Terraform skills including, but not limited to, experience with module design, provider version management, state management and refactoring. Expertise in Helm chart authoring and refactoring, including recent experience with Kubernetes and AKS. Demonstrated knowledge across Azure (AKS, Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, networking, identity) and observability as code (Azure Monitor and/or Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry). Hands-on experience automating backup, restore and failover with measured RTO and RPO. Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent), keeping confidential data out of them and reviewing what they produce. Hands-on experience running, hardening and right-sizing production workloads on Kubernetes Hands-on Kafka operations: topic and partition design, consumer group sizing, and throughput and latency trade-offs. Experience migrating between Kafka platforms (HDInsight, Confluent, MSK or self-managed) is a strong asset. Strong Python and Bash skills, able to build maintainable tooling, not glue scripts. A demonstrable record of replacing manual processes with automation. FinOps practice and Azure Cost Management, an asset. Regulated environment experience (healthcare, PHI), an asset. Certifications: HashiCorp Terraform Associate; Microsoft AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305; CKA or CKAD, an asset. Observability as code with Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry; Azure cost optimization, an asset. 
 $120,000 - $140,000 a year

All hiring decisions are ultimately made by qualified human decision-makers, and AI tools are used to support â not replace â fair and equitable hiring practices. This position is a new role, created to support Smileâs continued growth and commitment to operational excellence. Some of the benefits we offer: * Remote Work Environment * Flexible Time Away From Work Policy including PTO, Personal and Sick Days * Competitive Salary and Health/Medical Benefits * RRSP/TFSA/401K Employee Contribution * Life and Disability * Employee Assistance Program * FHIR Study Program and Skillsoft Learning * Super HAPI Fun Club Smile's core values include respect, inclusion, embracing our differences, and celebrating shared values because our people are the foundation of our success. title: Billing & Analytics Software Engineer
description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. About the Role As a Billing & Analytics Engineer on the Console & Analytics team, you will own the systems that turn Deepgram’s raw API usage into accurate invoices, revenue-grade analytics, and the self-service billing experience our customers depend on. This is the financial backbone of a high-growth AI company: every dollar of revenue flows through the code you build and maintain. You will design and operate the full billing pipeline—from usage event ingestion and metering through aggregation, rating, invoicing, and integration with third-party billing and CRM platforms. You’ll also own the analytics surfaces that give customers visibility into their consumption and give internal teams the data they need to operate the business. This role pulls billing and analytics engineering out of the broader Console team, creating a dedicated function that insulates and accelerates Deepgram’s product-led growth (PLG) effort. What You’ll Do Usage Metering & Event Processing: Design, build, and maintain the pipeline that ingests, validates, and processes usage messages from Deepgram’s inference and voice agent services. Ensure events are captured with sub-second reliability at scale, with idempotency and exactly-once semantics to guarantee billing accuracy. Usage Aggregation & Summarization: Build the aggregation layer that rolls raw usage events into usage summaries—by customer, product, time window, and pricing dimension. Optimize for query performance so that both real-time dashboards and end-of-period billing runs operate within SLA. Billing System Integration: Own the integration with usage-based billing platforms (M3ter, Metronome, or equivalent). Implement rating, plan management, and invoice generation logic. Ensure billing data reconciles cleanly with usage records and that edge cases (overages, credits, mid-cycle plan changes, enterprise commitments) are handled correctly. CRM & RevOps Integration: Build and maintain integrations with Salesforce and RevOps tooling to synchronize customer accounts, contract terms, entitlements, and billing status. Partner with Finance and RevOps to ensure billing data supports revenue recognition, forecasting, and audit requirements. Console Billing Experience: Develop the customer-facing billing and usage views within the Deepgram Console. Build clear, actionable dashboards that show real-time and historical usage, current spend, billing history, and plan details. Design the self-service flows for plan upgrades, payment method management, and invoice retrieval. In-DC Access, Permissions & Token Management: Own the billing-adjacent authorization surfaces: API key and token management, usage-based access controls, entitlement enforcement, and the permission model that gates feature access based on customer plan and billing status. Ensure these systems are secure, auditable, and performant. Analytics & Reporting: Build internal analytics pipelines and dashboards that surface usage trends, cohort behavior, conversion funnels, and revenue metrics to Product, Growth, and Finance teams. Instrument the billing system for operational observability—alerting on anomalies, reconciliation failures, and SLA breaches. Data Integrity & Reconciliation: Implement automated reconciliation between usage events, aggregated summaries, billing records, and payment processor data. Build alerting and self-healing mechanisms to catch and resolve discrepancies before they impact customers or revenue reporting. What We’re Looking For 5+ years of experience building and operating billing, payments, metering, or financial data systems in a SaaS or usage-based pricing environment. Strong backend engineering skills, preferably in Rust, and in at least one of: Python, TypeScript/Node.js, Go, or similar. Comfort working across the stack when needed. Deep experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and data pipeline design—schema modeling, query optimization, and high-volume event processing. Hands-on experience integrating with billing or subscription platforms (e.g., Stripe, M3ter, Metronome, Chargebee, Zuora) and CRM systems (Salesforce). Understanding of usage-based pricing models, metering patterns, and the edge cases that come with them (proration, overages, commitments, credits, multi-currency). Experience building reconciliation and data integrity systems that ensure financial accuracy at scale. Strong communication skills—you can partner effectively with Finance, RevOps, Product, and Growth teams to translate business requirements into reliable systems. A security-conscious mindset, especially around authentication, token management, and access control. Nice to Have Experience with usage-based billing platforms (M3ter, Metronome) specifically, or building custom metering systems from scratch. Familiarity with product-led growth (PLG) patterns: self-serve signup, usage gating, upgrade flows, and conversion instrumentation. Experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka, SQS, Pub/Sub) for high-throughput usage event processing. Background in revenue operations, revenue recognition (ASC 606), or SOX-relevant billing controls. Experience with analytics/BI tooling (Looker, Metabase, dbt) and building internal data products. Prior work at a company where billing accuracy directly impacted customer trust and revenue at scale. Why This Role Matters Deepgram’s growth is powered by a usage-based model where customers pay for what they consume. Every usage event, every invoice, every plan upgrade flows through the systems this role owns. As Billing & Analytics Engineer, you’ll ensure that Deepgram gets paid accurately and on time, that customers have full visibility into their consumption, and that internal teams have the financial data they need to scale the business. By creating a dedicated billing engineering function, this role directly enables the Console and PLG teams to move faster on product innovation without billing complexity as a bottleneck. Notice : We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @ deepgram.com email address. raw.jobDescription:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

About the Role

As a Billing & Analytics Engineer on the Console & Analytics team, you will own the systems that turn Deepgram’s raw API usage into accurate invoices, revenue-grade analytics, and the self-service billing experience our customers depend on. This is the financial backbone of a high-growth AI company: every dollar of revenue flows through the code you build and maintain.

You will design and operate the full billing pipeline—from usage event ingestion and metering through aggregation, rating, invoicing, and integration with third-party billing and CRM platforms. You’ll also own the analytics surfaces that give customers visibility into their consumption and give internal teams the data they need to operate the business. This role pulls billing and analytics engineering out of the broader Console team, creating a dedicated function that insulates and accelerates Deepgram’s product-led growth (PLG) effort.

What You’ll Do

Usage Metering & Event Processing: Design, build, and maintain the pipeline that ingests, validates, and processes usage messages from Deepgram’s inference and voice agent services. Ensure events are captured with sub-second reliability at scale, with idempotency and exactly-once semantics to guarantee billing accuracy.

Usage Aggregation & Summarization: Build the aggregation layer that rolls raw usage events into usage summaries—by customer, product, time window, and pricing dimension. Optimize for query performance so that both real-time dashboards and end-of-period billing runs operate within SLA.

Billing System Integration: Own the integration with usage-based billing platforms (M3ter, Metronome, or equivalent). Implement rating, plan management, and invoice generation logic. Ensure billing data reconciles cleanly with usage records and that edge cases (overages, credits, mid-cycle plan changes, enterprise commitments) are handled correctly.

CRM & RevOps Integration: Build and maintain integrations with Salesforce and RevOps tooling to synchronize customer accounts, contract terms, entitlements, and billing status. Partner with Finance and RevOps to ensure billing data supports revenue recognition, forecasting, and audit requirements.

Console Billing Experience: Develop the customer-facing billing and usage views within the Deepgram Console. Build clear, actionable dashboards that show real-time and historical usage, current spend, billing history, and plan details. Design the self-service flows for plan upgrades, payment method management, and invoice retrieval.

In-DC Access, Permissions & Token Management: Own the billing-adjacent authorization surfaces: API key and token management, usage-based access controls, entitlement enforcement, and the permission model that gates feature access based on customer plan and billing status. Ensure these systems are secure, auditable, and performant.

Analytics & Reporting: Build internal analytics pipelines and dashboards that surface usage trends, cohort behavior, conversion funnels, and revenue metrics to Product, Growth, and Finance teams. Instrument the billing system for operational observability—alerting on anomalies, reconciliation failures, and SLA breaches.

Data Integrity & Reconciliation: Implement automated reconciliation between usage events, aggregated summaries, billing records, and payment processor data. Build alerting and self-healing mechanisms to catch and resolve discrepancies before they impact customers or revenue reporting.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience building and operating billing, payments, metering, or financial data systems in a SaaS or usage-based pricing environment.

  • Strong backend engineering skills, preferably in Rust, and in at least one of: Python, TypeScript/Node.js, Go, or similar. Comfort working across the stack when needed.

  • Deep experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and data pipeline design—schema modeling, query optimization, and high-volume event processing.

  • Hands-on experience integrating with billing or subscription platforms (e.g., Stripe, M3ter, Metronome, Chargebee, Zuora) and CRM systems (Salesforce).

  • Understanding of usage-based pricing models, metering patterns, and the edge cases that come with them (proration, overages, commitments, credits, multi-currency).

  • Experience building reconciliation and data integrity systems that ensure financial accuracy at scale.

  • Strong communication skills—you can partner effectively with Finance, RevOps, Product, and Growth teams to translate business requirements into reliable systems.

  • A security-conscious mindset, especially around authentication, token management, and access control.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with usage-based billing platforms (M3ter, Metronome) specifically, or building custom metering systems from scratch.

  • Familiarity with product-led growth (PLG) patterns: self-serve signup, usage gating, upgrade flows, and conversion instrumentation.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka, SQS, Pub/Sub) for high-throughput usage event processing.

  • Background in revenue operations, revenue recognition (ASC 606), or SOX-relevant billing controls.

  • Experience with analytics/BI tooling (Looker, Metabase, dbt) and building internal data products.

  • Prior work at a company where billing accuracy directly impacted customer trust and revenue at scale.

Why This Role Matters

Deepgram’s growth is powered by a usage-based model where customers pay for what they consume. Every usage event, every invoice, every plan upgrade flows through the systems this role owns. As Billing & Analytics Engineer, you’ll ensure that Deepgram gets paid accurately and on time, that customers have full visibility into their consumption, and that internal teams have the financial data they need to scale the business. By creating a dedicated billing engineering function, this role directly enables the Console and PLG teams to move faster on product innovation without billing complexity as a bottleneck.

We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Opportunity

Deepgram is looking for a backend software engineer to lead the design and implementation of Deepgram’s Voice Agent product. You will design and implement secure, robust, and scalable services for speech processing; build integrations supporting telephony providers, RAG systems, and diverse deployment scenarios; engineer for testability and observability within a complex chain of AI models; and more. Your skill at building highly reusable code that overcomes technical challenges is paired with an intuition for delightful user experiences. You will be a critical voice in Deepgram’s Product and Engineering teams, driving high impact products from start to finish.

  • Develop integrations with cutting edge in-house, third-party, and open-source AI models for perception and managing conversational dynamics

  • Debug complex system issues that include networking, scheduling, and highly concurrent workloads

  • Rapidly customize backend services to support our customer needs

  • Partner with Product to design and implement new services, features, and/or products end to end

Most engineering leaders are still deciding what AI means for their teams. Here, you get to answer that question at a real scale, in a regulated domain where quality, privacy and trust come first.

You'll shape two things at once:

  • What we build: AI-powered discovery, booking, engagement and payment experiences for patients and providers in 13 markets.

  • How we build it: an engineering organisation where AI-assisted development is simply how work gets done, from writing code to testing and review, with the discipline to know when it helps and when it doesn't.

What you'll do

  • Set the direction. Own the engineering strategy and roadmap across all three areas. Tie technical bets to product outcomes and to numbers that move.

  • Build product builders. Build a strong engineering team that thinks in terms of value. Make ownership clear, strengthen the leadership bench and give teams room to decide without waiting on each other.

  • Turn AI into a product. Work with Product and Design from discovery through delivery to bring AI into search, booking, engagement, continuity of care and payments, where it solves real patient and provider problems.

  • Own the architecture. Guide design and engineering standards across the portfolio, balancing pace with reliability, security, privacy and scale across markets.

  • Remove friction at its source. Improve how ideas become impact with clear priorities, a few useful measures and regular learning. Fix recurring problems at the root and keep the process light.

This isn’t a role where you lead from slides. You use AI coding tools yourself, take part in design and code reviews, and quickly prototype solutions when it helps unblock a hard problem. That technical credibility supports your leadership, while most of your impact comes through the people you develop.

  • Engineering managers have clear ownership and the tools to lead delivery, people growth and technical decisions on their own.

  • A small set of useful delivery and quality metrics shows where the bottlenecks are and drives better reliability.

You'll work on real problems for real people: 100 million patients a month and more than 300,000 doctors who depend on what you ship. You'll do it at a company that treats AI as central to how it builds products, not as an add-on.
