Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

About your role

As a Staff Software Engineer at Juniper Square, you are a technical leader - setting technical direction, driving architectural decisions, and raising engineering quality across your team. This is a player-coach role: you lead through code and architecture, not just direction. You'll write production code as a hands-on individual contributor while owning your team's technical strategy, roadmap, and growth, and you'll collaborate closely with product, design, and QA to turn complex workflows into delightful, intuitive experiences.

We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer for the following team:

  • Treasury: Join the team building Juniper Square's Treasury platform, the system that brings transactions, balances, and bank data into and across the platform. You'll work on expanding bank integrations, a visualization and reporting layer for payments and treasury data, and vendor exports that connect treasury data to accounting, on a team that has already processed $500M+ in transactions.

What you'll do

Own Technical Direction & Architecture

  • Set the technical direction and own the architecture for your domain's systems, from design through production

  • Lead technical design for ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives - evaluating tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders, and driving implementation

  • Be instrumental in your team's transition from monolith to service-oriented architecture

  • Evaluate and select technologies with a bias toward what ships well and scales sustainably

Build & Deliver

  • Write production code as a hands-on individual contributor - this is not a role that delegates implementation to others

  • Own end-to-end delivery of roadmap projects: design, coding, testing, and production

  • Manage your team's short-term roadmap (spanning the next two quarters), proactively surfacing execution, cost, and technical risks and driving pragmatic mitigation

  • Lead the development of complex, full-stack workflows, working across frontend and backend engineers

AI Fluency & AI-Native SDLC

  • Practice AI Fluency across the full software development lifecycle - deliberately choosing where AI versus traditional software is the right tool, and defending those tradeoffs against real criteria (latency, accuracy, cost, data sensitivity, explainability)

  • Champion and embed AI-native development practices and tools (e.g., Cursor, Augment) to drive significant productivity gains across your team

  • Adapt code review and testing practices for an AI-assisted SDLC - catching AI-specific failure modes (hallucinated dependencies, overconfident but incorrect logic) before they ship

  • Build and evaluate agentic workflows and AI-assisted systems where they add real value, with clear human-in-the-loop boundaries and monitoring for failure

  • Guard against over-reliance on AI tooling, in your own work and in the code you review, balancing velocity with system comprehension and accountability for outcomes

  • Foster a culture of rapid iteration, high velocity, and quality, and help raise AI fluency across the team

Lead & Grow the Team

  • Mentor engineers, raise the quality of technical decision-making, and help the team execute with consistency

  • Establish coding standards, review practices, and architectural documentation that scale as the team grows

  • Partner with recruiting to build and grow the team

Collaborate Cross-Functionally

  • Work closely with product, design, QA, and customer support to translate requirements into executable technical plans

  • Participate actively in design reviews and roadmap discussions with a grounded, implementation-level perspective

  • Handle most cross-team conflicts and technical decisions autonomously

Operational Excellence

  • Own monitoring, diagnosing, and resolving production issues within your team's services

  • Use observability tooling to measure and improve system performance and reliability

  • Implement and uphold best practices that maximize developer productivity across the team

Domain Expertise

  • Grow into a subject-matter expert in your domain, with an in-depth understanding of customer needs and the value your systems deliver

Qualifications

Required

  • 12+ years of experience in backend and/or full-stack software engineering, with a clear trajectory of increasing technical leadership, architectural responsibility, and mentorship

  • A portfolio of shipped production systems - be ready to walk through specific technical decisions you personally made and code you personally wrote; this is not a role for someone whose primary contribution has been directing others

  • Deep expertise in at least one server-side language (Python preferred, Node/TS, Java, C++, C#, or similar) and strong proficiency building production-grade backend services

  • Experience with modern front-end frameworks (React preferred) and comfort working full-stack when the problem calls for it

  • Experience with relational/NoSQL databases, including schema design, performance tuning, and data modeling

  • Experience building and operating cloud-native systems using AWS (or equivalent), Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD, observability, reliability, and operational excellence in production environments

  • Deep understanding of service-oriented architecture and experience evolving systems from monolith toward SOA

  • Demonstrated ability to raise engineering quality through technical standards, design reviews, mentoring, and reusable platform patterns

  • Hands-on experience with AI-native development tools (e.g., Cursor, Augment) and a track record of using them to accelerate personal and team velocity

  • Demonstrated AI Fluency: hands-on experience building AI-assisted or agentic systems with a deliberate, defensible point of view on when AI is (and isn't) the right tool; adapted code review practices to catch AI-specific failure modes; and concrete safeguards against over-reliance on AI tooling

  • Ability to work through ambiguity, break down complex problems, and drive alignment across engineering, product, and design

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience

Nice to Have

  • Reporting: experience with data integration platforms, ETL/ELT processes, business intelligence tools, or financial data

  • Production experience building AI/LLM-powered systems (RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, evaluation frameworks)

  • Background in financial document processing or fintech data pipelines

  • Prior experience in a technical lead or TLM capacity on a new or early-stage product team

At Juniper Square, we believe building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture makes us a better company. If you think this role sounds like a fit, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification.

Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $190,000 – $235,000 USD and the Canadian base salary range is $180,000 - $225,000 CAD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

Benefits include:

• Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

• Life insurance

• Mental wellness coverage

• Fertility and growing family support

• Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

• Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

• Retirement saving plans

• Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

• Annual professional development stipend

Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.

title: Growth Engineer
description: Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta. Role Overview As Cresta’s Growth Engineer , you'll own the systems behind how Cresta shows up on the internet. In this role, you will own the technical decisions behind cresta.com and help shape how Cresta puts its own AI agents to work for marketing use cases. You'll architect and build our web platform, create the tooling that lets marketers ship without an engineer in the loop, and develop custom AI agents on Cresta's platform. This position requires strong engineering fundamentals, high agency, and the ability to go deep in an unfamiliar domain quickly. If you are self-driven, AI-native, and eager to own something end to end, this role is for you. Responsibilities The web platform Own how cresta.com is built end to end: how it’s structured, how content flows through it, and how it connects to everything else. Set the technical vision for how our website stack and CMS should evolve to meet the growing needs of our business and the rapidly changing workflows of the marketing team. Our website runs on Webflow today. Partner with brand and design on the interactive experiences that carry our identity. They set the creative vision; you architect and build it. Own the component system so the site stays consistent as it grows. Own the instrumentation where the site meets our GTM stack — forms, gated content, event tracking, and attribution — so data lands cleanly downstream, in partnership with marketing ops. Build the technical foundation for localization as we scale into new markets, including locale routing, URL architecture, and hreflang, partnering with our web strategy lead on CMS translation workflows and content structure Put in the engineering practices that let us move quickly without breaking things. Enough to ship with confidence, not so much that it slows us down. Ship the technical work behind our SEO and AEO programs, in partnership with the owners of those programs AI Agent Creation Develop, configure, deploy, and optimize AI agents on Cresta's platform for marketing use cases, working alongside our forward deployed engineering team. Take agents from prototype to production, including the evaluation criteria, guardrails, and human review steps prospect-facing work requires. Provide a tight feedback loop to our product and engineering teams — identifying gaps, building custom tooling, and influencing the roadmap through what you learn deploying against a real audience. What We’re Looking For 7+ years working in software development, web development, AI/ML engineering, or growth engineering. Strong across the stack — application code, APIs, data, and infrastructure — in Python, TypeScript, Node, or similar. Familiarity with AI/ML concepts. Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs), and prompt engineering techniques are strongly preferred. A track record of learning a domain fast and going deep. You've been dropped into something unfamiliar and become the person other people come to. High agency. You define your own work, ship without being told what to build, and treat gaps as yours to close. Strong understanding of general AI agent frameworks, function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Comfortable as the deepest technical voice on a non-engineering team, scoping ambiguous requests and explaining tradeoffs to marketers. Ownership. You treat the outcome as yours, including when something breaks or was built badly before you arrived. Nice To Have Experience owning a marketing website. Useful context, not a hard requirement. Technical SEO and AEO experience grounded in tests rather than theory. Marketing and GTM systems integration: HubSpot, Salesforce, Marketo, Segment, GA4, GTM. Perks & Benefits: We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child Retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced In-office meal program and commuter benefits provided for onsite employees Compensation at Cresta: Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table. Compensation for this position includes a Base Salary + Equity. Base Salary Range: $160K - $280K + Equity Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. Your recruiter can provide further details. In addition, total compensation includes a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Cresta employee, reach out to recruiting@cresta.ai Our use of AI in recruiting: We may use AI tools in our recruiting process, which require human review and oversight. Recording & AI transcription: We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed.   • Own how cresta.com is built end to end: how it’s structured, how content flows through it, and how it connects to everything else.

  • Partner with brand and design on the interactive experiences that carry our identity. They set the creative vision; you architect and build it. Own the component system so the site stays consistent as it grows.
  • Own the instrumentation where the site meets our GTM stack — forms, gated content, event tracking, and attribution — so data lands cleanly downstream, in partnership with marketing ops.
  • Build the technical foundation for localization as we scale into new markets, including locale routing, URL architecture, and hreflang, partnering with our web strategy lead on CMS translation workflows and content structure
  • Put in the engineering practices that let us move quickly without breaking things. Enough to ship with confidence, not so much that it slows us down.
  • Ship the technical work behind our SEO and AEO programs, in partnership with the owners of those programs

AI Agent Creation

  • Develop, configure, deploy, and optimize AI agents on Cresta's platform for marketing use cases, working alongside our forward deployed engineering team.
  • Take agents from prototype to production, including the evaluation criteria, guardrails, and human review steps prospect-facing work requires.
  • Provide a tight feedback loop to our product and engineering teams — identifying gaps, building custom tooling, and influencing the roadmap through what you learn deploying against a real audience.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years working in software development, web development, AI/ML engineering, or growth engineering.

  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts. Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs), and prompt engineering techniques are strongly preferred.
  • A track record of learning a domain fast and going deep. You've been dropped into something unfamiliar and become the person other people come to.
  • High agency. You define your own work, ship without being told what to build, and treat gaps as yours to close.
  • Strong understanding of general AI agent frameworks, function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
  • Comfortable as the deepest technical voice on a non-engineering team, scoping ambiguous requests and explaining tradeoffs to marketers.
  • Ownership. You treat the outcome as yours, including when something breaks or was built badly before you arrived.

title: Solution Integrations Architect - Oracle
description: About Zip Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before. The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA. Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups. Your Role We’re looking for a Solution Integrations Architect to help build the technical foundation that powers Zip’s ERP and integration ecosystem. This role focuses on internal technical enablement, navigating complex customer environments to architect the cleanest possible solutions, partnering closely with Product, and driving best-in-class standards across all of Zip’s integration workflows - with a specific focus on the Oracle ecosystem. As Zip continues to scale rapidly across enterprise customers like Coinbase, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Snowflake, and Databricks, your impact will be foundational: creating reusable integration assets, defining standards of how the Zip product interacts with external systems. You Will You’ll work closely with our Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams while reporting to Engineering to design, maintain, and iterate on Zip-owned ERP and integration templates that power scalable, repeatable customer implementations. Your work will directly influence how hundreds of future implementations are delivered, raising the technical bar for both our EPD teams and our customer-facing technical consultant organization. Architect & standardize Oracle R12 integrations: Design, maintain, and iterate on Zip’s core Oracle EBS R12 integration templates, ensuring they deliver scalable, repeatable, and robust customer implementations. Bridge product & the field: Work closely with Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) to ensure integration templates stay perfectly aligned with core product architecture, field insights, and emerging customer needs. Turn nuance into scale: Analyze complex customer implementations to identify reusable data mapping patterns and system nuances, converting bespoke solutions into standardized internal assets. Support pre-sales engineering: Partner with account teams during pre-sales to design and vet integration architectures, ensuring prospective customers are set up for smooth, best-practice deployments. Drive technical implementation excellence: Define, document, and champion technical solution consulting best practices, raising the technical bar and driving consistency across all implementations. Become a Multi-ERP expert: Leverage your existing Oracle EBS, P2P, and financial systems expertise to build deep fluency across additional ERP ecosystems, ultimately becoming the ultimate subject matter expert on integration architecture, data models, and Zip’s App Studio. Build for permanent scale: Approach every technical challenge with an engineering mindset - designing and executing a solution thoroughly once so that future implementations happen effortlessly. You balance high-level architectural design with a willingness to dive directly into API configurations and template modifications to get the job done right. Qualifications 6+ years of hands-on experience delivering integrations with Oracle EBS or Oracle environments. Strong foundational knowledge of core Oracle EBS business processes, schema layouts, and data models, specifically within Oracle Purchasing (PO), Payables (AP), and General Ledger (GL). Familiarity with standard Oracle EBS integration methods, including Open Interface Tables, Public APIs/PL-SQL Packages, Oracle Integrated SOA Gateway (ISG), and REST/SOAP services. Familiarity with iPaaS tools is preferred, but we welcome candidates with strong core integration logic who can learn new platform tools quickly. Experience working with XML / REST based endpoints and standard authentication protocols. Past ERP implementation, integration, configuration or administration experience is required. Ability to translate highly technical information for audiences with varying degrees of technical knowledge. Comfortable working with API documentation. Comfortable testing and troubleshooting integration errors. Able to understand customer requirements and document that information quickly, with little oversight A continual learner and open to learning new technologies that Zip may integrate with in the future. Strong communication skills. Extreme attention to detail and pride yourself in being incredibly proactive. Experience working with product and engineering teams. Process-driven with a strong bias toward continuous improvement; you consistently look for opportunities to make systems better than you found them through systematic improvement. Perks & Benefits At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work. Start-up equity Health, vision & dental coverage ️ Catered lunches & dinners for TO employees Team building events & happy hours Flexible PTO Apple equipment plus home office budget We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. The role

Our CloudGate team is responsible for the software side of external network connectivity in our Cloud. We're building a traffic delivery system for a variety of scenarios: IPv4 connectivity, Cloud Interconnect, Egress NAT, and a network load balancer. They serve tens of millions of packets per second.

We have a control plane microservice architecture with gRPC transport and our own Database as our data warehouse.

What we do:

  • Increase service scalability
  • Developing service functionality with support for service endpoints and expansion of health check types
  • Improve the internal architecture, optimizing interaction with related services

In this position, your responsibility will be to:

  • Developing a data plane for Nebius Cloud network services
  • Improve service performance and reliability
  • Automate complex cross-service interaction scenarios
  • Perform load testing for services

We expect you to have:

  • Capable of writing reliable, high-performance code
  • Proficient in C and ready to learn Go/C++
  • Familiar with routing network traffic

It would be an added bonus if you had:

  • Worked with VPP, DPDK, and the Linux kernel network subsystem
  • Well-versed in virtual networks and overlays, SDN, NFV, DPI, network protocols, routing and tunneling, BGP, and MPL

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

#LI-JS1

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Frontend Leaning) - Studio
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role You’ll build the tools that make Studio a video editor people want to live in. These include transitions, color grading and elements libraries all built on top of our in-house engine. You’ll also build presets, so a user can get the effect they want without tweaking 20 individual controls. The work mixes greenfield features with polish on the existing editor. An example of the polish is letting editors coming from Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro rebind their keyboard shortcuts in one step. You’ll write proposals, get fast feedback, and own features through launch, including the marketing moment. You’re a product-minded, frontend-leaning full-stack engineer. Deep backend skills aren’t required. Requirements Strong frontend engineer who has built complex, interactive UIs. Enough full-stack ability to work across the stack, but deep backend expertise isn’t needed. Evidence of product responsibility: side projects, open source, or product-facing work. Thrives in a fast-moving, startup-style environment, and takes ownership with minimal hand-holding. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

The YDB Development Team at Nebius is hiring mid- and senior-level software developers with C++ expertise.

YDB is an open-source platform with two roles within Nebius:

  • Providing the binary object storage foundation for S3 Object Storage, Shared Filesystems and Network Block Storage
  • Serving as a distributed relational database and message broker for services such as IAM, billing, audit trails and logging

We operate YDB clusters in more than 10 regions using HDD and NVMe storage. Individual clusters span tens of thousands of nodes, manage hundreds of petabytes of data and deliver terabytes per second of throughput. Our infrastructure includes x86 and Arm-based systems, including NVIDIA GB300 nodes.

What you’ll work on

  • Evolve YDB’s architecture for new hardware, redesigning core components when incremental optimization is insufficient:
    • QLC NVMe drives: increase storage density while controlling RAM/CPU consumption and write amplification
    • Dual 800 Gb/s network adapters: reduce CPU overhead and memory bandwidth consumption to utilize the available NIC bandwidth
    • NVIDIA GB300-based systems: ensure efficient operation on Arm-based hosts and offload storage and networking processing to BlueField DPUs
  • Support high-capacity SMR HDDs by designing data placement, sequential writes, garbage collection and recovery around zoned-write constraints
  • Develop wide erasure-coding schemes to reduce space aplimfication while maintaining durability and availability
  • Reduce recovery and rebalancing times after device outages while limiting the impact on foreground workloads
  • Prevent, detect and recover from silent data corruption across memory, networking and storage
  • Provide the system capabilities and interfaces required by fleet-wide automation so that hundreds of production clusters can be deployed, configured, upgraded, diagnosed and operated consistently

We move quickly and focus on delivering practical value. Features and optimizations merged into the production branch are typically deployed within weeks. You’ll see your work solving real problems in live clusters—not waiting years to make an impact.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional experience developing high-load systems in C or C++. Candidates with 3+ years will also be considered if their experience includes relevant work on distributed storage systems
  • Experience developing high-performance, low-latency software components
  • Understanding of core dumps, flame graphs and sanitizer-enabled builds
  • Understanding of CPU caches, atomic operations and NUMA architectures

Nice to have:

  • Experience designing and developing production-grade distributed storage systems and/or databases
  • Experience with on-disk data structures such as LSM trees and B+ trees, and storage algorithms such as erasure coding and checksumming
  • Understanding of NVMe, conventional HDD and SMR HDD internals
  • Experience with debugging and profiling tools such as perf, VTune, bpftrace and gdb
  • Familiarity with the Linux kernel, SPDK/DPDK, libaio and io_uring
  • Knowledge of IP, TCP, UDP and DNS, and ideally InfiniBand or RoCE/RDMA
  • Experience with Kubernetes and Grafana
  • Experience responding to production incidents
  • Knowledge of availability and durability calculations

For Senior candidates, we offer hybrid working or the flexibility to work remotely within EU.

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible. We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work on the rendering infrastructure of a novel search engine tailored for agentic AI consumption.

In this role, you will focus on loading modern web pages in a browser that we patch and build ourselves, so that content is rendered completely and reliably at a cost that works across billions of pages. You will work inside Chromium to remove what we do not need, make the rest faster and cheaper, and keep our build current as Chromium moves. Your work ensures that high-quality content is consistently available to the indexing and retrieval systems downstream.

In this position, your responsibility will be to

  • Change Chromium in its heavy core (Blink, the V8 integration, the compositor, the network service) to cut CPU, memory and startup cost per page
  • Strip Chromium down for agent workloads: skip what nobody needs, such as image and media decoding, web font downloads, and rasterization and GPU work where no one needs pixels, while keeping what page scripts depend on to run correctly (style, layout, animation frames, observers), and work out what breaks, or renders differently, when you do
  • Keep the browser compatible with the web: make sure that what we remove does not change how the sites we load behave or render
  • Profile and tune fleets of browsers: the process model, memory per renderer, startup, isolation and crash handling
  • Build the production system around it: how browsers are launched, pooled, recycled and monitored

You may be a good fit if you

Have 5+ years of experience building production systems, and are an expert in several of the following areas.

Inside the browser

  • Strong C++ in a large, performance-critical codebase, ideally Chromium, Blink or V8, or a comparable browser engine (Rust is a plus)
  • Chromium architecture: the process model, Mojo IPC, the rendering pipeline (DOM, style, layout, paint, compositing), and the network service
  • Building, debugging and shipping custom Chromium builds: the build system, tracing, crash analysis, and maintaining patches across releases

Performance and systems

  • Profiling CPU, memory and I/O for browser fleets, with tools such as perf, tracing and flame graphs
  • Linux process isolation and resource management, concurrency, and memory management
  • Have run browsers in production, or built the infrastructure that does, and can describe where the time and memory went

Strong candidates may also have experience with

  • Contributions to Chromium, Blink, V8, Firefox, WebKit or another browser engine
  • Building or maintaining a patched browser that you wrote the patches for
  • Browser instrumentation, including the Chrome DevTools Protocol
  • Working familiarity with how modern frontend frameworks render (SSR, CSR, streaming, hydration)
  • Distributed systems, Kubernetes, and Go or Python

The kind of problems you will work on

  • Cut the cost of loading a page in half. Where do CPU and memory go, and what would you change in the browser?
  • Turn off the GPU and image decoding for agent workloads. What breaks, and what changes in how pages load and render?
  • A page runs a script that never yields. How do we detect and stop it without help from the page?
  • Chromium ships a new version. How do we bring a large set of patches forward in days, not weeks?
  • Decide when a page is finished, for pages with analytics beacons, long polling and endless scrolling.

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership

  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

description: 1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that. But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens. We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. You’re building a reliable abstraction layer over a fragmented healthcare system. What you could work on: The Modern AI-enabled Clinical System: Help design and build the systems that store and manage clinical data. This isn't just a database; it's a high-integrity system for treatment plans, progress notes, patient history, and AI-powered clinical intelligence - from session transcript-to-note generation to automated summaries that give providers their time back. The Insurance Billing Engine: We apply AI pragmatically ( blog ) to reduce administrative burdens for providers and handle the burden of traditional billing workflows. You’ll scale the systems that handle the unique, often nonsensical rules of every major insurance payer to accurately estimate and file claims hundreds of thousands of times per month. Patient-First Infrastructure: We’re moving toward a patient-centric model. Build the backend services that power personalized care recommendations, health tracking, and longitudinal data views as well as innovative user experiences to help patients find a therapist that meets their needs Financial Integrity: Work on the ledger systems that ensure 70,000+ providers get paid accurately. This requires building for idempotency and strict consistency in a multi-party marketplace. Our Stack Languages: Python, TypeScript Storage: Postgres, Redis, Snowflake Infrastructure: AWS, Temporal Ops: Datadog, Sentry, PagerDuty AI Tools: Cursor, Claude, Gemini, Eddy (our in-house cloud agent harness) Who You Are Owns Outcomes, Not Tasks: You've been handed ambiguous problems and turned them into shipped software. You know how to define the solution, pull in the right people across teams, and keep things moving when priorities shift. Sets the Technical Standard: You make technical decisions that optimize for maintainability and scale, not just shipping speed. You proactively improve your team's engineering velocity - whether that's refining tooling, improving automation, or establishing patterns that prevent entire categories of bugs. Mentor by Default: You pull engineers into design discussions without being asked. Your code reviews teach, not just gatekeep. You make sure knowledge gets shared across the team, not siloed in one person's head. Ships Fast, Iterates Faster: You can move from problem statement to working solution quickly. You'd rather ship a good v1 this week than a perfect v1 next month. Real feedback from therapists and patients is worth more than another round of design review. Quick Study in Complex Domains: Healthcare is a maze of payers, regulations, and exceptions. You don't need prior healthcare experience, but you need to be someone who dives into unfamiliar domains and builds a working mental model fast. Motivated by Impact: You want your engineering skills applied to problems that matter. Mental healthcare access is broken in America, and you want to be part of fixing it. Communicates with Precision: Whether it's a Slack thread, a design doc, or a cross-team meeting, you communicate clearly and concisely. You know that great engineering is wasted if you can't bring people along. AI Frontier Tinkerer: You don't just use AI tools - you push their limits. You've experimented with applying LLMs to real workflows, whether that's code generation, operational automation, or developer tooling. You bring a builder's mindset: what can we automate, what should stay human, and how do we ship it responsibly in healthcare?   • Sets the Technical Standard: You make technical decisions that optimize for maintainability and scale, not just shipping speed. You proactively improve your team's engineering velocity - whether that's refining tooling, improving automation, or establishing patterns that prevent entire categories of bugs.

  • Mentor by Default: You pull engineers into design discussions without being asked. Your code reviews teach, not just gatekeep. You make sure knowledge gets shared across the team, not siloed in one person's head.

  • Motivated by Impact: You want your engineering skills applied to problems that matter. Mental healthcare access is broken in America, and you want to be part of fixing it.

title: Engineering Manager - Feegow (100% Remote within Brazil)
description: Welcome to the good side of tech You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner . The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group . It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human? Where does Feegow fit here? In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare. Docplanner Group at scale We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 80 million patients trust us every month. 130.000 specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management, and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago. And why should you join us? Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs. We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote-friendly (you will work 100% from home, but you will also be welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro). Job Description Role As an Engineering Manager in this group, you’ll be fully responsible and accountable for managing your team(s), ensuring predictable, high-quality delivery with high operational standards. You’ll also actively partner with your Product counterparts and Staff Engineers to shape the direction of our area and the company as a whole. You will lead the Fintech team responsible for domains like clinic payments, invoices, financial reports, health insurance integrations and others. The role reports directly to the Engineering Director. We are committed to continuous improvement, open feedback, and working efficiently towards our goals. This role provides an opportunity to influence the strategic direction of the area while receiving mentorship and support as needed. While expertise in specific technologies isn’t required, this is a technical role, and a solid technical background is essential to effectively support the teams. raw.jobDescription:
Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 80 million patients trust us every month. 130.000 specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management, and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote-friendly (you will work 100% from home, but you will also be welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro).

Job Description

Role

As an Engineering Manager in this group, you’ll be fully responsible and accountable for managing your team(s), ensuring predictable, high-quality delivery with high operational standards. You’ll also actively partner with your Product counterparts and Staff Engineers to shape the direction of our area and the company as a whole. You will lead the Fintech team responsible for domains like clinic payments, invoices, financial reports, health insurance integrations and others. The role reports directly to the Engineering Director.

We are committed to continuous improvement, open feedback, and working efficiently towards our goals. This role provides an opportunity to influence the strategic direction of the area while receiving mentorship and support as needed.

While expertise in specific technologies isn’t required, this is a technical role, and a solid technical background is essential to effectively support the teams.

What you will be doing

  • Manage, coach, and develop team members through regular feedback and performance assessments.

  • Define and manage the technical vision and strategy for your area.

  • Ensure accountability for all team initiatives.

  • Serve as a point of reference for the Leadership team and key stakeholders.

Qualifications

You’re likely a great fit for this role if you

  • Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.

  • Strong technical background across the SDLC, with the ability to support and unblock your teams in complex technical discussions.

  • Experience modernizing legacy systems into modern architectures, as well as leading teams’ ways of working.

  • A lean, proactive, and positive approach to software development, balancing impact with long-term, sustainable development, and taking strong accountability for delivering high-quality solutions.

  • Embrace the “you build it, you run it” philosophy.

  • Believe in continuous learning and improvement.

  • Experience not only mentoring others, but also developing future mentors and leaders.

  • Previous experience in fintech is a plus.

Important: Docplanner is an international English-first company. Therefore, please be sure to send your CV in English

Additional Information

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience. The range is broad so that we can accommodate our roles for all levels of experience, but we will show you the career ladder to explain where we see your skills and impact within the company". Your salary will be, now and always, 100% transparent to you;

  • We offer a Meal Voucher worth R$800,00 a month, but if you enjoy cooking at home, you can replace it with a Food Voucher, for the same amount, or do half and half, making life easier for those who are 100% remote or hybrid.

  • For the commute to the office, we offer transportation vouchers.

  • We have a robust Partnerships Club, with agreements and discounts ranging from educational institutions. such as colleges and languages, to exclusive banking benefits.

  • Share options plan after 6 months of working with us.

  • Did you like working here? Then refer a friend or relative! We love having family and friends around! Our New Warrior Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months.

True flexibility and work-life balance

  • Remote or hybrid work model with our hub in.

  • Our working hours are Monday through Friday, from 9am to 6pm.

  • Need to work beyond your usual hours? We have a time bank so that you can use those hours as time off later.

  • Additional paid holiday on your birthday and work anniversary.

  • Our special leave policies are different here: if you’ve lost a loved one, we offer 10 days off; if you lose your PET, you have 2 days. Are you getting married? 7 days of rest! The baby’s here? We offer 1-month of paternity leave and 6 months of maternity leave.

Health comes first

  • Medical and Dental Assistance along with Group Life Insurance.

  • We have a robust Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services, all the way to exclusive banking benefits.

  • Access to the iFeel app, for emotional comfort, which combines traditional psychology with AI, helping you through those tough days.

  • ApoioPass offers free professional support and guidance in the psychological, legal, economic, and social areas, providing support in those more delicate issues.

  • A Gympass for you and 3 other people! Because working out alone is very boring, isn't it?

  • Did you think your PET would be left out? Of course not! We offer a Pet Plan extending the care to your pet as well.

  • Credits: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment.

Important: Docplanner is an international English-first company. Therefore, please be sure to send your CV in English

title: Senior IT Systems Engineer
description: Headquarters: Remote • Canada About Upsun Upsun is the software factory for human-AI workflows. We give teams one unified platform to create, review, deploy, and run software, with AI agents and humans working in sync. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build and ship with confidence, without wrestling with infrastructure. Upsun brings this together through two products: one that shapes the work, and one that runs it. Upsun Dispatch™: the AI-first product accelerator. Dispatch governs and simplifies collaboration between AI agents and cross-functional human teams, so work gets shaped, reviewed, and moved to production faster. Ship better code, not just more code. Upsun Cloud: the Cloud Application Platform for AI acceleration. Cloud is where that software runs. It helps organizations launch agentic software into production confidently and reliably, with: Predictable performance, even at scale Secure, compliant environments by default Real-time observability and profiling built in Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds Sandbox environments where AI agents can build and test safely The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation. What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work. Our values: We make a positive impact. We aim for the stars. We care for each other. Impact of a Senior IT Systems Engineer As a Senior IT Engineer, you help shape and improve the systems that our 250+ person remote company relies on every day. Your work spans identity and access, Google Workspace, device management, and our wider SaaS environment. Reporting to the IT Director, you take ownership of complex problems and lead improvements from initial assessment through delivery. You identify what needs attention, recommend priorities, and make thoughtful decisions that balance security, reliability, and employee experience. You also help the team build stronger practices through clear documentation, shared knowledge, and practical guidance. What to expect Identity platform: Improve our identity and access services, with Okta at the core. This includes single sign-on, automated account provisioning, multi-factor authentication, access policies, and emergency access. Work with IT and Security to make access secure, consistent, and straightforward. Google Workspace: Lead the administration and improvement of our Google Workspace environment, including users, groups, Gmail, Drive, shared drives, and security settings. Improve how people collaborate, manage sharing and access, and keep our configuration aligned with business needs. Device management: Help lead the rollout and ongoing development of JumpCloud and our device management practices across macOS, Windows, and Linux. Define and implement device configurations, security policies, software deployment, and onboarding processes in partnership with IT Operations and Security. Automation and employee lifecycle: Design and improve onboarding, role changes, and offboarding across identity, devices, and SaaS tools. Use tools such as Okta Workflows, n8n, Python, and APIs to reduce manual work and make processes more reliable. Continuous improvement: Assess our current systems, identify gaps, and turn findings into practical improvements. Investigate complex issues across connected services, address root causes, and follow through until changes are working well. SaaS administration and governance: Administer our core internal tools and help evaluate new applications. Establish clear practices for application setup, integrations, access requests, approvals, and access reviews. Security and compliance: Partner with Security and the Risk and Audit team to implement and maintain controls across identity, Google Workspace, devices, and SaaS tools. Automate evidence collection where practical to support ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2. Project delivery and mentoring: Lead projects from scoping and technical design through rollout and handover. Coordinate dependencies, communicate risks and progress, and help colleagues grow through documentation, reviews, and knowledge sharing. What you bring Broad IT engineering experience: You have hands-on experience across identity, collaboration tools, endpoint management, and SaaS administration. You understand how these systems connect and can troubleshoot problems across them. Depth in a core area: You bring strong expertise in at least one of Okta, Google Workspace, or JumpCloud, along with the ability to work across the others. We welcome different strengths; you do not need to be equally expert in all three. Device management deployment: You have helped deploy or significantly improve an MDM or endpoint management platform. You can turn security and operational requirements into workable configurations, test them, and roll them out with minimal disruption. Automation and scripting: You build reliable automation using workflow tools, APIs, webhooks, and Python or a comparable scripting language. You consider error handling, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance. A track record of improvement: You can share examples of systems or processes you assessed, improved, and delivered, with clear results for employees or the IT team. Proactive judgment and ownership: You work independently, make sound technical decisions, and know when to involve others. You can turn an unclear problem into a practical plan, explain trade-offs, and take responsibility for the outcome. Security and compliance awareness: You have implemented controls such as access reviews, secure configurations, or device policies, and understand how to document and demonstrate that they work. Experience supporting ISO 27001 or SOC 2 is valuable. Clear communication and collaboration: You work effectively in a fully remote team and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues across cultures. You share knowledge and help others become more effective. Experience: Typically six or more years in IT engineering, systems administration, identity, or endpoint management, with increasing responsibility for technical decisions and project delivery. Equivalent experience matters more than a specific number of years. Bonus points Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, including assessing and integrating identity systems, Google Workspace environments, devices, or SaaS tools. Experience in a developer-heavy or engineering-led company. Experience supporting both ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2, including automated evidence collection. Professional proficiency in French. Where we hire At Upsun, remote work isn’t just a trend. It’s our foundation. Upsunners are a global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We’re committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans more than 30 countries and a wide range of experience levels, and we’re currently hiring for this role in Canada . We’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, but we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries. How we hire Our interview process is a chance for us to understand how you think, what you’ve built, and what you want to take on next, and for you to get to know us. Together, we’ll explore where your strengths and interests meet the challenges our teams are solving. We know a great hire won’t meet every requirement above. If you can see yourself making the team better, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here if someone hadn’t taken a chance on us. You can expect 4 interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Director, IT) 60 Minutes with Team (Senior Director, Site Reliability Engineering, Senior IT Manager) 45 Minutes with Executive (Senior Director, FP&A & IT) All roles require background checks. What we offer A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud B Corp . An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women. ️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution. A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives Benefits and perks - Make the most of what matters to you Flexible PTO Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain) Company stock options Professional development budget Office equipment budget ‍️ Wellness budget Annual team gatherings Inclusive parental leave ️ Remote work travel program You belong here At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upsun-senior-it-systems-engineer

How we hire

Our interview process is a chance for us to understand how you think, what you’ve built, and what you want to take on next, and for you to get to know us. Together, we’ll explore where your strengths and interests meet the challenges our teams are solving.

We know a great hire won’t meet every requirement above. If you can see yourself making the team better, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here if someone hadn’t taken a chance on us.

We work with innovative, ambitious companies developing AI products. Our team members hold a range of opinions about whether AI is “good or bad” for humans, but at the end of the day, we embrace the plain fact that it is here, we must embrace it to evolve, and our clients increasingly depend on us to help them embrace it, too, to help them evolve and stay competitive. Our CEO's opinion: AI will not replace human labor any time soon; rather, AI is a new opportunity to either (a) get things done faster, or (b) get a much higher quality of output than before. If you’re an AI tinkerer, great! We want to hear how you’re using it and see your latest vibe project. If you’re allergic to AI or have no interest in learning new habits to work effectively with it, this is not the place for you. Compensation & logistics Base salary: Applicants outside the USA will be compensated according to your local employment market. For applicants closer to the junior side who are located in the USA, $50,000–$65,000/yr, depending on experience level and your local geographical price index. With experience, comp goes up from there. Genuinely experienced, more senior candidates can be slotted higher — let's talk. Type & location: Full-time, work from home, fully remote. Eastern or Pacific time zones. Benefits: Medical / dental / vision for the employee, 401(k) with employer contribution, 2 weeks of PTO annually to start, and a stipend for your home internet. How to apply The first step is really easy and only takes 10 minutes — no resume, no cover letter, no essays. Here's how: Take this online Culture Index assessment (about 10 minutes): We use it to screen for people whose natural wiring fits how our team works. If your profile lines up with what we're looking for, we'll reach out and ask you to complete a 60-minute TestGorilla assessment for critical thinking skills, send us your resume, and maybe a couple of other items. From there, we conduct between 2-4 video interviews. One of these might be a live technical assessment. If the Culture Index step feels like a strange way to start a job application — that's kind of the point. Remember the phrase Think Different? Ignition is an equal opportunity employer. Ping Identity is seeking a strategic, commercially minded, and highly influential Director, Global Alliances – Accenture to own and accelerate our relationship with Accenture worldwide.

This is a high-impact global leadership role—not a regional partner-management position. You will serve as Ping’s single accountable alliance leader for Accenture, shaping the global strategy, executive relationship, operating model, and joint go-to-market plan across Accenture’s Identity, Security, Technology, Song, industry, cloud, delivery, and managed-services organizations.

The successful candidate will turn a complex global relationship into a focused, repeatable growth engine—aligning executives, mobilizing Ping’s teams, and helping Accenture make Ping the identity platform of choice in strategic transformation programs.

This is a hands-on builder role. You will craft the strategy, create the operating model, and drive execution from executive alignment through customer outcomes. You will build top-down and bottoms-up engagement and convert shared priorities into strategic collaboration agreements, joint investment plans, and measurable results.

What you will own

Global alliance strategy and executive leadership

  • Define and execute a multi-year global Accenture alliance strategy aligned to Ping’s corporate priorities, growth objectives, product strategy, and regional plans.
  • Establish trusted relationships with Accenture’s global and regional executives across Identity, Cybersecurity, Technology, Song, cloud, industry, delivery, and managed services.
  • Act as Ping’s primary global Accenture leadership point and orchestrate executive alignment when priorities, resources, commercial interests, or customer pursuits require senior intervention.
  • Build and maintain a joint annual business plan with clear priorities, investments, owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
  • Create a global-to-local operating model that gives AMER, EMEA, and APJ teams a common strategy while allowing appropriate regional and country-level activation.
  • Drive GTM Acceleration, ensuring Ping is front-and-center with Accenture SAL’s and CAL’s across industry verticals.  

Strategic engagement and collaboration agreements

  • Build a deliberate, multi-threaded engagement model with Accenture’s global leadership, practice executives, industry leaders, regional sponsors, account executives, and delivery leaders.
  • Create executive alignment around a small number of strategic priorities, including the business case, mutual value, investment requirements, customer outcomes, and path to scale.
  • Develop, advance, and operationalize strategic collaboration agreements, memoranda of understanding, annual business plans, and related partnership frameworks with Accenture.
  • Translate agreements into clear gives-and-gets, governance structures, named owners, investment principles, milestones, escalation paths, and measurable success criteria.
  • Partner with Ping Finance, Legal, Operations, Product, Sales, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, and executive leadership to ensure agreements are commercially sound, executable, and connected to Ping’s broader strategy.
  • Establish a cadence of executive briefings, steering committees, business reviews, and working sessions that keeps both organizations aligned and accountable.
  • Identify when a relationship should progress from informal collaboration to a formal strategic agreement, and lead the internal and partner process required to make that progression successful.

Joint go-to-market and revenue growth

  • Develop a disciplined joint go-to-market motion spanning “to,” “with,” and “through” Accenture partner routes.
  • Build and manage a prioritized target-account strategy, including account mapping, install-base intelligence, whitespace analysis, opportunity hypotheses, and executive sponsorship.
  • Mobilize Ping account teams and Accenture sales, account, industry, and practice leaders around qualified opportunities and strategic pursuits.
  • Drive partner-sourced, partner-influenced, co-sell, resale, services-attach, and expansion revenue while establishing clear definitions for attribution and credit.
  • Create repeatable joint offers and sales plays that connect Ping’s identity security platform with Accenture’s consulting, implementation, transformation, and managed-services capabilities.
  • Improve pipeline quality, progression, forecast accuracy, win rates, deal velocity, and strategic account penetration through consistent inspection and action planning.
  • Ensure that the partnership produces referenceable customer outcomes—not only activity, meetings, or enablement attendance.

Governance, operating rhythm, and accountability

  • Establish a practical governance model with executive sponsorship, a named steering committee, working teams, escalation paths, and clear decision rights.
  • Lead monthly operating reviews, quarterly business reviews, and annual planning sessions with Ping and Accenture executives.
  • Maintain a shared scorecard covering pipeline, bookings, revenue, services attach, target-account engagement, enablement, certifications, delivery capacity, joint offers, lighthouse customers, customer outcomes, and referenceability.
  • Convert strategic intent into 30-, 60-, and 90-day execution plans with named owners and measurable milestones.
  • Identify execution gaps early, make trade-offs explicit, and hold both organizations accountable for commitments.
  • Partner with Finance, Legal, Operations, and leadership teams to establish sound commercial, investment, compliance, and reporting practices.

Enablement, delivery, and customer success

  • Work with the partner enablement team to build a scalable enablement strategy for Accenture sales, solution architects, consultants, and delivery professionals.
  • Align Ping Professional Services, Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Product, Support, Enablement and other partner delivery resources to improve implementation quality, customer outcomes, and feedback loops.
  • Connect enablement to pipeline, pursuits, implementations, services attach, and customer outcomes.
  • Set targets, identify gaps, coordinate Ping resources, and report progress through alliance governance and quarterly business reviews.

Cross-functional leadership inside Ping

  • Serve as Accenture’s connective tissue between Global Alliances and Sales, Sales Engineering, Product, Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Professional Services, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and Operations.
  • Create clarity on roles, resources, pursuit strategy, deal engagement, channel conflict, commercial guardrails, and escalation paths.
  • Champion partner-led execution across Ping’s global field organization and make it easy for sellers to understand when and how to engage Accenture.
  • Represent the voice of Accenture internally while protecting Ping’s strategic, customer, commercial, and operational interests.
  • Build a culture of ownership, transparency, urgency, and measurable execution across the virtual alliance team.

What success looks like

Success will be measured by:

  • An adopted global strategy, strong executive relationships, and effective governance.
  • Strategic collaboration agreements with clear mutual commitments, investments, and outcomes.
  • Growth in qualified pipeline, bookings, revenue, and services attach for both Ping and Accenture.
  • A measurable Accenture enablement and delivery capability, supported by training, certifications, and capacity.
  • Stronger field execution, forecast discipline, new logos, renewals and referenceable outcomes.

What you bring

  • Experience building and managing strategic relationships with Accenture, ideally across global or regional practices.
  • Experience in cybersecurity; experience with identity is a strong plus.
  • Experience building and scaling programs—from strategy and operating model through enablement, execution, and measurement.
  • International experience working across regions, cultures, and complex global organizations.
  • 12+ years of experience in channels, sales, or related fields

Base Hiring Range: $200,000-$215,000 + variable commission

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

  • Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

  • Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

  • 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams

  • Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)

  • Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments

  • Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

  • Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash)

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible)

  • Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)
